title: KUGENDANA NA YESU
publicationTitle: Ibyigisho bya Bibiliya mu Ishuri ryo ku Isabato by’Abakuze
abstract: Kugendana n’Imana binyuze mu Kugana Yesu

foreward.title: Ijambo ry’Ibanze

paragraph.text: Uruhererekane rw’ibyigisho tuziga muri iki gihembwe, “Kugendana na Yesu,” rushingiye ku gitabo cyitwa “Kugana Yesu”. Icyo gitabo gishobora gusomwa, igice ku kindi, kikaba nk’inyunganizi ku masomo y’Ibyanditswe.

Bamwe mu banyeshuri bo mu Ishuri ryo ku Isabato bashobora kwibuka igihe iki cyigisho giheruka gutambukira, koko hari mu gihembwe cya mbere cy’umwaka wa 1980. Twishimiye kongera kugishyira ahagaragara na none gifite imiterere mishya n’izindi nyandiko z’inyongera, ariko gifite kwa kuri kwimbitse kwavuzwe kera cyane.

Incuro nyinshi, abantu batekereza ko Se wo mu ijuru atabitaho kandi ko ari kure yabo, ko ari umucamanza w’intavumera kandi w’umunyabukana. Birengagiza urukundo rwimbitse abafitiye, n’ukuntu yita ku bana Be bose mu buryo burangwamo impuhwe.

Ikintu cya mbere cyakagombye kuvugwa, ni urukundo rw’Imana. Hanyuma hagakurikiraho uburyo umunyabyaha aba ari umuntu utagira kirengera kandi utagira ibyiringiro, kandi akaba akeneye Umukiza. Imibereho ya Kristo, waje gukiza abanyabyaha, igaragaza ko hari inzira nyakuri yo kugarukira Data wa twese wo mu ijuru.

Insanganyamatsiko zikubiye muri ibi byigisho zivuga ku bintu by’ingenzi biba mu buzima bwa Gikristo kandi zihuje mu buryo bwihariye n’umwizera mushya mu kwizera ushaka gukurira mu buntu. Abizera bose bakwiriye kujya biyibutsa izo nsanganyamatsiko buri gihe, kandi atari ku bw’inyungu zabo gusa, ahubwo no kugira ngo bamenye inzira nziza yo gufasha abandi gusanga Kristo.

Gushyiraho inyigisho z’ukuri mu buryo bufite gahunda bishobora gutuma umuntu azisobanukirwa neza kandi akazemera, kandi bigatuma umuntu yemererwa kuba umwe mu bagize itorero. Ariko iyo umuntu nk’uwo atagiranye umushyikirano na Kristo, nta bugingo nyakuri aba afite - ni ukuvuga ko aba adafite ubugingo buhoraho. Mu by’ukuri, umuntu “wizera Umwana ni we ufite ubugingo buhoraho” (Yohana 3:36).

Buri wese mu banyeshuri b’Ishuri ryo ku Isabato, Umwuka w’Imana akwiriye kuba ahamanya n’umutima we bwite, ko mu by’ukuri yemerewe kuba mu muryango w’Imana. Buri wese agomba gusobanukirwa ko urugero rwe bwite, ukuntu we ubwe akomeza kwishingikiriza kuri Se wo mu ijuru igihe cyose no mu bintu byose, bikwiriye kuba ari ibintu nyakuri kandi bifatika. Hakenewe ibirenze urukundo rw’abantu b’abanyantege nke. Abantu bose bakeneye urukundo rw’Imana – urukundo rw’Imana rutikanyiza – rwatewe mu mitima yabo no mu bugingo bwabo kugira ngo bakundane nk’uko [Kristo] yabakunze.
Nimutyo ibe ariyo iba imibereho ya buri mwigishwa w’Ishuri ryo ku Isabato.

lessons.title: Urukundo Imana ifitiye Abantu
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Nimurebe urukundo ruhebuje Data wa twese yadukunze, rwatumye twitwa abana b’Imana kandi ni ko turi. Ni cyo gituma ab’isi batatumenye kuko batayimenye.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Nimurebe urukundo ruhebuje Data wa twese yadukunze, rwatumye twitwa abana b’Imana kandi ni ko turi. Ni cyo gituma ab’isi batatumenye kuko batayimenye.”

keyNote.text: “Imana ni urukundo. Nk’uko imirasire y’umucyo ituruka ku izuba, ni ko urukundo n’umucyo n’umunezero bitemba bituruka ku Mana bigana ku byo yaremye byose”. — Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.77.

q.text: a. Ni ikihe gihamya kigaragaza urukundo rw’Imana cyahawe abantu?

note.text: “Ijambo ry’Imana rihishura imico ya Nyiraryo. Imana ubwayo niyo yagaragaje urukundo n’impuhwe. Igihe Mose yasabaga ati: “Nyereka ubwiza bwawe burabagirana”, Uwiteka yaramusubije ati: “Ubwanjye nzanyuza kugira neza kwanjye kose imbere yawe”. Kuva 33:18, 19. Ubwo nbwo bwiza bw’Imana. Uwiteka yanyuze imbere ya Mose arivuga ati: “Uwiteka, Uwiteka, Imana y’ibambe n’imbabazi, itinda kurakara ifite kugira neza kwinshi n’umurava mwinshi, igumanira abantu imbabazi ikageza ku buzukuruza babo b’ibihe igihumbi, ibababarira gukiranirwa n’ibicumuro n’ibyaha.” Kuva 34:6,7. Imana yacu “igira ubuntu n’imbabazi, itinda kurakara, ifite kugira neza kwinshi”, “kuko yishimira kubabarira.” Yona 4:2; Mika 7:18.” — Kugana Yesu, p.10.

q.text: b. Ni uwuhe mugambi Imana yari ifite mu kohereza Umwana Wayo?

note.text: “Satani atuma abantu batekereza ko Imana ikiyiranga gikomeye ari uguca imanza zitarimo ubutabera, ikaba ari umucamanza w’umunyabukana, n’umwishyuza w’intavumera uhutiraho. Agereranya Umuremyi n’umunyeshyari ugenzura abantu kubashakaho ibicumuro n’ibyo bafuditse kugirango abone uko yabagirira nabi. Kugira ngo Yesu akureho icyo gicucu cy’umwijima, binyuze mu guhishurira isi urukundo rw’Imana rutagira akagero, byatumye [Yesu] aza kuba mu bantu.” – Ibid., p.11.

q.text: a. Ni gute Yesu yasobanuye umurimo We wo ku isi?

note.text: “[Luka 4:18]. Uwo niwo murimo Yesu yaje gukora. Yajyaga ajya hose akora ibyiza, agakiza abantu bose Satani atwaza igitugu. Yesu akiri mu isi, hariho ibirorero byarimo amazu atarangwamo iminiho y’uburwayi; kubera ko yari yarabinyuzemo akavura abarwayi babirimo bose. Umurimo We wagaragaje ko yari yarasizwe n’Imana. Urukundo, imbabazi, n’impuhwe byagaragariraga muri buri gikorwa cyose cyaranze ubuzima Bwe, yari afite umutima w’imbabazi wo gukunda abana b’abantu. Yenze kamere y’abantu kugirango abone uko amara ubukene bw’abantu. Nta mukene cyangwa se umwinazi watinyaga kumwegera. Ndetse n’abana bato bumvaga bareshywa kumusanga. Bakundaga kumwurira maze bakicara ku bibero Bye, bakitegereza mu maso He, bakumva baramukunze.” — Kugana Yesu, p.11,12.

“Yesu yabonaga muri buri muntu ubugingo bugomba kurarikirwa Ubwami Bwe. Yagendereraga abantu bakumva ineza Ye ibagera ku mutima kandi bakamubona nk’ubashakira ibyiza. Yabasangaga mu nzira nyabagendwa, mu mazu yabo, mu bwato, mu rusengero, ku nkengero z’inyanja, no mu birori by’ubukwe. Yabasanze mu mirimo yabo ya buri munsi, kandi agaragaza kwishimira imirimo yabo isanzwe. Yajyanye inyigisho Ze mu ngo, ashaka ko imiryango yamenya ko Imana yari kumwe nabo. Impuhwe Ze zikomeye zigaruriye imitima ya benshi. Kenshi yajyaga ku musozi ahitaruye akiherera agasenga, ariko ibi byari ibyo kwitegurira umurimo We mu bantu. Muri ibyo bihe yagiye akiza abarwayi, ajijura abadasobanukiwe, no kubohora ababoheshejwe ingoyi za Satani.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.151.

q.text: b. Nubwo Kristo yari yuzuye urukundo n’impuhwe, ni uruhe rugero rugaragaza ubudahemuka Bwe mu gucyaha ikosa?

note.text: “Yesu nta jambo na rimwe ry’ukuri yigeze yirengagiza, ahubwo buri gihe yakuvugaga mu rukundo. Igihe cyose yabaga ahuye n’abantu, yakoreshaga uburyo bukomeye bwo guhangana n’ingorane, kandi iteka ryose akerekana ubugwaneza no gutekereza neza iyo yabaga ari kumwe n’abantu. Ntawe yigeze abwira nabi, ntiyigeze avuga amagambo akarishye mu gihe kitari ngombwa, nta n’umuntu ubabaye mu mutima yigeze akomeretsa. Nta muntu yigeze agaya kubw’intege nke ze. Yavugaga ukuri, nyamara buri gihe akakuvuga mu rukundo. Yacyahaga uburyarya nta bwoba, akamagana kutizera no gukiranirwa, nyamara amarira yumvikanaga mu ijwi rye igihe yabaga avuga amagambo yo kugaya no gucyaha….. Buri mutima wose wari uw’agaciro mu maso Ye. We yari afite icyubahiro cy’Imana, nyamara yicishaga bugufi afite umutima w’imbabazi kandi akita kuri buri mwana wese wo mu muryango w’Imana. Buri muntu wese yamubonagamo umutima yaje gukiza.” — Kugana Yesu, p.12.

q.text: a. Ni uwuhe mutwaro wari uremereye Umukiza wacu yikoreye mu gihe cy’ubuzima Bwe?

note.text: “Yesu yikoreye umutwaro uremereye w’inshingano yo guhesha abantu agakiza. Yari azi ko hatabayeho guhindura amateka n’imigambi y’inyokomuntu, bose bari kurimbuka. Uyu niwo wari umutwaro umuremereye, kandi nta n’umwe wari kwemera uwo mutwaro yari yikoreye. Mu gihe cy’ubwana, mu busore, ndetse amaze no gukura, Yesu yagendaga wenyine. Nyamara yahoraga ahanze amaso ku ijuru. Yahuraga n’ibigeragezo n’ibishuko buri munsi, kandi ntiyaburaga guhura n’ikibi buri munsi, ndetse akibonera imbaraga zacyo kubo yashakaga kugirira neza no gukiza. Nyamara ntiyigeze atsindwa cyangwa ngo acike intege.

“Yashyiraga ibyifuzo Bye mu bintu byose bikagerwaho n’umurimo We. Yubahirije ubugingo Bwe binyuze mu gushyira ibintu byose byari bibugize mu bushake bwa Se. Igihe yari akiri muto, nyina yamusanze mu ishuri ry’abigisha b’Abayuda maze aramubwira ati “Mwana wanjye, ni iki cyatumye utugenza utya?” Yaramusubije, kandi igisubizo Cye gihatse ikintu cy’ingenzi yakoze mu buzima Bwe bwose – “Mwanshakiraga iki? Ntimuzi yuko binkwiriye kuba mu rugo rwa Data?”

“Ubuzima Bwe bwaranzwe no kwitanga igihe cyose. Nta rugo yari afite atahamo muri iyi si, keretse kugirirwa neza n’incuti zikamuha aho kwikinga nk’umugenzi. Yabayeho ubuzima bwa gikene cyane mu cyimbo cyacu, yagendereraga kandi agakorera abakene n’abababaye. Yagiye yinjira kandi asohoka mu bantu yari yarakoreye ibintu byinshi, ariko ntibamumenye kandi ntibanamwubahe”. – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.42,43.

q.text: b. Kuba Imana yaragaragaje urukundo rwinshi bitwigisha iki ku birebana na Data wa twese wo mu ijuru?

note.text: “Nta kintu cyakwerekana uko Data wa twese yakunze abantu cyaruta uko yashakaga kubakiza, keretse iki gitambo gihebuje [cya Kristo] cyabatangiwe. Oya, oya! “Imana yakunze abari mu isi cyane, byatumye itanga Umwana wayo w’ikinege.” Yohana 3:16. Igituma Data wa twese adukunda ntabiterwa n’impongano ikomeye, ahubwo yatanze iyo mpongano kubera ko adukunda. Kristo ni we yakoresheje kugira ngo asendereze urukundo Rwe rutagira akagero ku isi yaguye. “Kuko muri Kristo ari mo Imana yiyungiye n’abari mu isi.” 2Abakorinto 5:19. Imana yababaranye n’Umwana wayo. Mu gahinda gakomeye yagiriye i Getsemani, urupfu rw’i Kaluvari, umutima w’Urukundo Rutarondoreka watanze ikiguzi cyo gucungurwa kwacu.” — Kugana Yesu, p.13.

q.text: a. Mbese agakiza k’ubugingo bwacu gashingiye ku ki?

note.text: “Mbega ukuntu Kristo yari afite umutima usonzeye kandi wifuza cyane gukiza uwari wazimiye! Umubiri we wabambwe ku musaraba, ntiwagabanyije ubumana Bwe, ububasha Bwe bw’Imana bwo gukiza abemera gukiranuka Kwe bose, binyuze mu gitambo cy’umuntu. Igihe yapfiraga ku musaraba, yavanye icyaha ku muntu w’umunyabyaha agishyira ku Uwamubereye umwishingizi wavuye mu ijuru binyuze mu kwizera ko ari Umucunguzi we bwite. Ibyaha by’isi yashayishije, bigereranywa mu ishusho “y’umutuku nk’umuhemba” byabazwe ku Ncungu yavuye mu ijuru”. – This Day With God, p.236.

q.text: b. Ni iki Kristo yakoze kugira ngo aducungure kirenze imbaraga cyangwa ubwenge bw’umuntu uwo ari we wese?

note.text: “Data yarabakunze cyane, kandi yarankunze bihebuje kuko natanze ubugingo bwanjye kugira ngo mbacungure. Mu guhinduka inshungu yanyu ndetse n’ubwishingizi bwanyu, mu gutanga ubugingo bwanjye ndetse nkikorera ibicumuro byanyu, bituma Data ankunda cyane, kubera ko kubw’igitambo Cyanjye, Imana ishobora kuba ikiranuka kandi igatsindishiriza uwizera Yesu.

“Nta n’umwe washoboraga gusohoza umurimo wo kuducungura rwose uretse Umwana w’Imana gusa, kuko ari nta wundi wajyaga kutumenyesha Data wa twese uretse uwo wari mu gituza cye. Uburebure bw’igihagararo n’uburebure bw’ikijyepfo bw’urukundo rw’Imana nta wundi wabashaga kubumenyesha abantu, keretse gusa Uwari ubuzi. Nta kintu cyakwerekana uko Data wa twese akunda abazimiye, cyaruta igitambo gihebuje cya Kristo cyatambiwe inyokomuntu yaguye.” — Kugana Yesu, p.14.

q.text: c. Ni iki Yohana yashoboraga guhamya ku byerekeranye n’umuvugizi wacu ku ntebe ya cyami y’Imana?

note.text: “Abantu bake gusa ni bo basobanukiwe ububi buteye agahinda bwa kamere y’icyaha, kandi ni bo basobanukiwe uburemere bw’ingaruka mbi zatewe no kugomera amategeko y’Imana. Binyuze mu gusuzumana ubushishozi inama y’ugucungurwa yabereyeho kugirango umunyabyaha yongere kugarurirwa ishusho y’Imana, tubona ko uburyo bwonyine rukumbi bwarokora inyokomuntu bwabonetse binyuze mu kwitanga, ukwicisha bugufi n’urukundo bitagereranywa by’Umwana w’Imana. Ni we wenyine wari ufite imbaraga zo kurwana intambara n’umwanzi ukomeye w’Imana n’abantu, kandi kubera ko ari we mwishingizi wacu n’incungu yacu, yahaye ubushobozi abamunambaho kubwo kwizera, kugirango babe abaneshi mu izina Rye kandi baneshe binyuze mu buntu Bwe”. — Uburezi bwa Gikristo, p.112.

q.text: a. Ni iki cyatumye Kristo ashobora gutanga ikiguzi cy’ugucungurwa kwacu?

note.text: “Igitambo kitagira akagero Data wa twese wo mu ijuru yatangiye mu Mwana We kugirango adupfire, gikwiriye kutwumvisha urugero ruhanitse dukwiriye kugeraho binyuze muri Kristo. Ubwo intumwa Yohana yari ahumekewe n’Umwuka w’Imana, yitegereje uburebure bw’igihagararo, n’uburebure bw’ikijyepfo, n’ubugari bw’urukundo Data wa twese yakunze inyokomuntu yari iyo kurimbuka, ibyo byamuteye kuramya Imana no kuyiha icyubahiro, nuko abura amagambo yakoresha mu gusobanura ingano y’urwo rukundo rukomeye, biramutangaza, arumirwa; niko guhamagarira abari mu isi kurwitegereza….. Mbega uburyo kwitwa abana b’Imana byatumye abantu bagira agaciro! Ibicumuro nibyo bituma abantu baba imbata za Satani. Nyamara bene Adamu bashobora kuba abana b’Imana binyuze mu kwizera impongano y’igitambo cya Kristo. Kubwo kugira kamere y’umuntu kwa Kristo, niko kwatumye azahura inyokomuntu. Abantu baguye iyo biyunze na Kristo, babasha rwose kuba bakwiriye kwitwa ‘abana b’Imana.’ ” — Kugana Yesu, p.15.

q.text: b. Ni ayahe magambo intumwa Yohana yakoresheje kugira ngo agaragaze ukuntu urukundo rw’Imana rwagutse?

note.text: “Urukundo nk’urwo ntacyo twarugereranyaho. Nirwo rwatumye twitwa abana b’Umwami wo mu ijuru! Mbega isezerano ry’agahebuzo! Mbega inkuru nziza y’inkoramutima dukwiriye kuzirikana kuruta byose! Mbega urukundo rutagira akagero Imana yakunze ab’isi batayikundaga! Gutekereza kuri urwo rukundo bigira imbaraga yigarurira umutima w’umuntu maze bikawutera gukora ibihuje n’ubushake bw’Imana. Uko turushaho gushimikira kwiga kugirango tumenye imico y’Imana mu mucyo w’umusaraba, niko turushaho kumenya impuhwe, ibambe, n’imbabazi byomatanye n’ukuri n’ubutabera, kandi ni nako turushaho gusobanukirwa neza ibindi bihamya byinshi bigaragaza urukundo rutagira akagero n’impuhwe Imana idufitiye, biruta ibyo umubyeyi agirira umwana we wararutse.” — Ibid., p.15.

reviewQuestions: 1. Vuga imico y’ingenzi cyane igize kamere y’Imana.
2. Igihe Yesu yari ku isi, yahishuye ate imico y’Imana?
3. Ni gute umurimo wa Kristo wagize ingaruka ku mahitamo Ye?
4. Ni iki twakwigira ku kuba Yesu yarabaye Umwishingizi wacu?
5. Sobanura impano y’agahebuzo kuruta izindi zose Kristo yaduhaye.

fso.title: Amaturo y’Isabato ya Mbere
fso.subtitle: Azagenerwa Kwagura Urusengero rwa Cenayi, mu Buhinde
fso.writer: Bene so na bashiki banyu bo muri Cenayi

paragraph.text: Cenayi yahoze yitwa Madarasi, ni umurwa mukuru w’intara ya Tamili Nadu iri mu majyepfo y’u Buhinde, kandi ni na wo mujyi munini muri iyo leta. Iherereye ku cyambu cya Koromandeli yo mu kigobe cya Bengali. Dukurikije ibarura ry’abaturage ryo mu Buhinde ryo mu 2011, Cenayi ni umujyi wa gatandatu utuwe cyane mu Buhinde kandi ni umujyi wa kane uri kwiyubaka mu buryo bwihuse. Ikigo gikuru cy’ubucuruzi cya Cenayi cyashinzwe mu 1688, kikaba aricyo kigo cya kera cyane mu Buhinde kandi ni icya kabiri gikuru ku isi nyuma y’icyo mu Bwongereza. Uwo mujyi ufite ihuriro ry’ubucuruzi hamwe n’inganda zigera ku 15,000 kandi ni ihuriro rikomeye ry’ubukerarugendo mu buvuzi, bwaje guhabwa izina “Umurwa mukuru w’ubuzima bw’Ubuhinde”. Umujyi kandi urimo igice kinini cy’inganda zikora imodoka zo mu Buhinde, niyo mpamvu ufite n’irindi zina “Deturuwa yo mu Buhinde.” Cenayi niwo mujyi wonyine wo muri Aziya y’Amajyepfo washyizwe mu mijyi 10 ya mbere y’ibiribwa mu mwaka wa 2015 kandi yashyizwe ku mwanya wa cyenda mu mijyi myiza iteye amabengeza ku isi.

Abaturage b’umujyi wa Cenayi ubu basaga miliyoni 12, bakaba biyongera ku kigero cya 2.34% buri mwaka. Uwo mujyi ni umujyi utuwe n’abaturage bafite amoko n’amadini bitandukanye. Nk’uko ibarura ry’abaturage rya 2011 ribigaragaza, umubare munini w’abaturage ba Cenayi wari Abahindu (80.73%) bakurikiwe n’Abayisilamu (9.45%), Abakristo (7.72%), Abandi (1.27%), n’abavuga ko nta dini bagira (0.83%).

Kuva mu mwaka wa 2019, 40% by’imiryango miliyoni 1,788 mu mujyi iba munsi y’umurongo w’ubukene. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2017, umujyi wari ufite ingo miliyoni 2.2, aho 40% by’abaturage ntibafite aho baba. Muri uwo mujyi hari utuzu tw’amacumbi tugera ku 1,131, turimo ingo zisaga 300,000. Abantu b’ingeri zose batuye hano, kandi bose bakeneye kumva ubutumwa bwiza bw’iteka bwa Yesu Kristo muri iyi minsi y’imperuka.

Kubera ibibazo by’ubukungu, ntitwashoboye gusoza kubaka urusengero rwa Cenayi mu gihe twari twiteze. None ubu, kubera ko imirimo yo kubaka irimo ikorwa, twabonye ko ari ngombwa kwagura uwo mushinga twubaka amacumbi y’abapasiteri, inzu y’inama n’ibyumba by’Ishuri ryo ku Isabato by’abana. Kugira ngo ibyo tubigereho, nta gushidikanya ko dukeneye kwiyambaza ugutangana Ubuntu kw’abagize amatorero yacu dukunda bo ku isi yose.
Turasaba bene data, bashiki bacu n’urubyiruko tubikuye ku mutima ko batanga impano ziturutse ku mutima wabo wose kugira ngo uyu mushinga ukorwe.
Murakoze cyane, Uwiteka abahundagazeho imigisha mwese.

lessons.title: Uko Umunyabyaha akeneye Kristo
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndakubwira yuko umuntu utabyawe ubwa kabiri, atabasha kubona ubwami bw’Imana.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndakubwira yuko umuntu utabyawe ubwa kabiri, atabasha kubona ubwami bw’Imana.”

keyNote.text: “Ibyiringiro rukumbi byo gucungurwa kw’imibereho yacu yacumuye biri muri Kristo”. — Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.147.

q.text: a. Sobanura uko umuntu yari ameze akiri muri Edeni.

note.text: “Mbere umuntu akiremwa, yahawe imico myiza n’umutima uhugutse. Yari atunganye adafite inenge kandi yashyiraga hamwe n’Imana.” — Kugana Yesu, p.17.

“Umuntu yagombaga kugaragaza ishusho y’Imana, ari inyuma mu bigaragara ndetse no mu mico. Kristo gusa ni we “shusho ya kamere ya Data wa twese” (Abaheburayo 1:3); ariko umuntu we yaremwe asa n’Imana. Kamere ye yari ihuje n’ibyo Imana ishaka. Ubwenge bwe bwari bufite ubushobozi bwo gusobanukirwa ibintu by’ubumana. Urukundo rwe rwari rutunganye; kandi yategekaga irari ry’umubiri we. Yari intungane kandi akanezezwa no gusa n’Imana ndetse akagendera mu bushake Bwayo.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.45.

q.text: b. Ni gute Satani yagerageje kuburizamo umugambi Imana yari ifite mu kurema umuntu?

note.text: “Binyuze mu kutumvira, imbaraga [z’umuntu] zarononekaye, maze kwikunda gusimbura urukundo yakundaga Imana. Kamere ye yaciwe intege n’igicumuro, bituma abura uko yahangana n’imbaraga z’ikibi mu bushobozi bwe bwite. Yabaye imbohe ya Satani, kandi rero yajyaga kugumya kuba yo iteka iyo Imana itamugoboka ngo imuhagarareho. Intego y’umushukanyi yari iyo kugwabiza umugambi Imana yari ifitiye umuntu ikimurema. Icyatumye Satani yuzuza isi agahinda n’umuze, kwari ukugirango abiherereze ku Mana ko ari ingaruka y’umurimo Wayo wo kurema umuntu.” — Kugana Yesu, p.17.

q.text: a. Adamu na Eva bamaze gukora icyaha, babyitwayemo bate igihe bumvaga ijwi ry’Imana?
b. Kuki abantu b’abanyabyaha badashobora guhagarara imbere y’Imana Ishoborabyose?

note.text: “Mu mimerere ye itarangwamo icyaha, umuntu yagiranaga umusabano unejeje “n’Uwo ubutunzi bwose bw’ubwenge no kumenya bwahishwemo.” (Abakolosayi 2:3). Ariko aho amariye gucumura, ntiyari agishoboye kongera kugira ibyishimo bituruka ku kwera, kandi yashatse kwihisha Imana. Uko ni nako bimeze ku mutima utarahindutse mushya. Ntushobora gushyira hamwe n’Imana, kandi ntiwabonera umunezero mu gusabana na Yo. Umunyabyaha ntiyashoboraga kunezezwa no kuba imbere y’Imana, yakumva abangamiwe kuburyo yakwikura imbere y’ibiremwa byera. Aramutse yemerewe kujya mu ijuru, nta munezero yahabonera. Umwuka w’urukundo rutikanyiza uhaba; aho buri mutima uba uhuje n’umutima w’urukundo rutagira iherezo, byabusanya n’umutima we wikunda. Ibitekerezo bye, ibimushishikaza, n’impamvu zimutera kugira icyo akora, byabusana rwose n’abatagira icyaha bahatuye. Yaba ijwi ridahuje n’ayandi mu ndirimbo yo mu ijuru. Ijuru ryamubera ahantu ho kubabarizwa; yakwifuza kwihisha Uhabereye umucyo, akaba n’izingiro ry’umunezero waho. Kuba inkozi z’ibibi zitazajya mu ijuru, si itegeko ry’Imana ry’akarengane, ahubwo ni ukubera ko bo ubwabo badakwiriye kujya mu ijuru. Ubwiza bw’Imana bwababera umuriro ukongora.” — Kugana Yesu, p.17,18.

q.text: c. Kuki bidashoboka ko umuntu ubwe yakwikiza igihano cy’icyaha?

note.text: “Twebwe ubwacu ntitwashobora kwikura mu rwobo rw’ibyaha twarohamyemo. Imitima yacu ni mibi, kandi ntidushobora kuyihindura. “Ni nde wabasha kuvana igitunganye mu kintu cyanduye? Nta we.” Yobu 14:4….. Ubwenge buhanitse, imico mbonera, gukoresha ubushishozi, kugira umuhati, bifite umumaro ukwiriye, ariko nta bushobozi bfite bwo guhindura kamere y’umuntu. Icyakora ibyo byose byabasha gutuma umuntu agira imyifatire myiza igaragarira inyuma, ariko ntibishobora guhindura umutima we wa kamere. Ntibyakweza amasoko y’ubugingo. Niba umuntu ashaka gucika ku byaha akera, akwiriye kwakira ubugingo bushya buva mu ijuru. Ubwo bugingo buri muri Kristo. Ubuntu Bwe bwonyine nibwo bubasha guhembura ingeso nziza z’umutima, no kuwegereza Imana, ngo were.” — Ibid., p.18.

q.text: a. Ni iki dukwiriye kumenya cyerekeranye n’umutima w’umuntu?

note.text: “Ijambo ry’Imana rivuga ritya: “Kuko bose bakoze ibyaha, ntibashyikira ubwiza bw’Imana” (Abaroma 3:23). “Ntawe ukora ibyiza n’umwe” (Abaroma 3:12). Benshi barishuka ku birebana n’uko imitima yabo imeze. Ntibabona yuko umutima w’umuntu urusha ibintu byose gushukana, kandi ari mubi bikabije. Bifubika gukiranuka kwabo bwite kandi banyuzwe no kugera ku rugero rwabo bwite rw’imico; ariko iyo bananiwe kugera ku rugero Imana ishaka baba batsinzwe bikomeye, kandi bo ubwabo, ntibashobora kwigeza ku byo Imana ibasaba.” – Ubutumwa Bwatoranyijwe, vol 1, p.320.

q.text: b. Kuki twebwe abantu tudashobora gusobanukirwa ibintu byo mu buryo bw’umwuka no kubona ubwami bw’Imana?

note.text: “Umukiza yaravuze ati: “Umuntu utabyawe ubwa kabiri (udafite umutima mushya, ibyifuzo bishya, n’imigambi mishya kuburyo byatuma agira ubugingo bushya) ntabasha kubona ubwami bw’Imana.” Yohana 3:3. Kwibwira ko umuntu hari iterambere yageraho ry’ikintu cyiza binyuze muri kamere ye, ni ukwishuka bikomeye. ‘Umuntu wa kamere ntiyemera iby’Umwuka w’Imana kuko ari ubupfu kuri we, akaba atabasha kubimenya kuko bisobanurwa mu buryo bw’Umwuka.’ ‘Witangazwa n’uko nkubwiye yuko bibakwiriye kubyarwa ubwa kabiri.’ 1Abakorinto 2:14; Yohana 3:7. Kristo yandikiwe ngo: ‘Muri we harimo ubugingo, kandi ubwo bugingo bwari Umucyo w’abantu.’ ‘Kandi nta wundi agakiza kabonerwamo, kuko ari nta rindi zina munsi y’ijuru ryahawe abantu, dukwiriye gukirizwamo.’ Yohana 1:14; Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa 4:12.” — Kugana Yesu, p.18,19.

q.text: c. Nubwo tudashobora kwikiza, ni iki dushobora gukora?

note.text: “Imana yigaragarije muri Kristo, “yiyungira muri We n’abari mu isi” 2Abakorinto 5:19. Umuntu yari yarangijwe cyane n’icyaha ku buryo atashobora ubwe kwiyunga n’Uwari ufite kamere yera kandi y’ineza. Ariko Kristo amaze gucungura umuntu mu bubata bwo kwica amategeko, yashoboye kunga imbaraga z’ubumana n’iz’umuntu. Nuko rero, kubwo kwihana imbere y’Imana no kwizera Kristo, urubyaro rwa Adamu wacumuye rwashoboye kongera guhinduka ‘abana b’Imana’ 1Yohana 3:2.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.64.

q.text: a. Ni ikihe kibazo intumwa Pawulo yari afite igihe yamenyaga mu buryo bwuzuye ko ari umunyabyaha imbere y’Imana?

note.text: “Ntibihagije kumenya ubugwaneza bw’Imana no kwitegereza ubugiraneza n’impuhwe za kibyeyi by’imico Yayo. Ntibihagije kumenya ubwenge n’ubutabera by’amategeko Yayo, no kwitegereza uburyo bifite urufatiro ku ihame rihoraho ry’urukundo. Intumwa Pawulo yitegereje ibyo byose, niko kuvuga ati: ‘Noneho amategeko ni ayera, ndetse n’itegeko ryose ni iryera, rirakiranuka kandi ni ryiza.’ ‘Ariko ubwo nkora ibyo ndashaka, nemera ko amategeko ari meza.’ Hanyuma abishimangira ababaye, afite agahinda mu mutima ati: ‘Tuzi yuko amategeko ari ay’umwuka, ariko jyewe ndi uwa kamere ndetse naguriwe gutegekwa n’ibyaha.’ Abaroma 7:16,12,14. Pawulo yifuzaga cyane kubonera no gukiranuka, nyamara we ubwe akananirwa kubyigezaho; niko gutera hejuru arataka ati: ‘Yemwe, mbonye ishyano! Ni nde wankiza uyu mubiri untera urupfu?’ Abaroma 7:24. Uko gutaka guturuka mu mitima iremerewe y’abantu bo mu bihugu byose n’ab’ibihe byose. Abo bose igisubizo bahabwa ni kimwe: ‘Nguyu Umwana w’Intama ukuraho ibyaha by’abari mu isi.’ Yohana 1:29.” — Kugana Yesu, p.19.

“Hariho benshi bazi uburyo batishoboye kandi bifuza imibereho y’iby’umwuka yo gutuma bahuza n’Imana; barushywa n’ubusa bahatanira kuyigeraho…. Umukiza yubitse umutwe areba uwo yaguze amaraso Ye akamubwirana ineza n’impuhwe bitarondoreka agira ati, “Mbese urashaka gukira?” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.203.

q.text: b. Ni mu buhe buryo Imana yijeje Yakobo ko itigeze imutererana igihe yahungaga mwene se Esawu?

note.text: “[Yakobo] yumvaga ari igicibwa, kandi yamenye ko amakuba ye yose yayatewe n’imigirire ye mibi. Umwijima wo kwiheba watsikamiye umutima we ku buryo bitari bimworoheye no gusenga. Ariko kandi yari ari mu bwigunge buteye ubwoba ku buryo yumvaga akeneye cyane uburinzi bw’Imana kurusha mbere hose. Yihana icyaha cye arira kandi aciye bugufi cyane maze yingingira Imana kumwereka ikimenyetso cy’uko itamuretse. Na none kandi umutima we wari uremerewe ntiworohewe. Nta byiringiro byari bikimurimo, kandi yatinyaga ko Imana ya ba sekuruza yamugize igicibwa.

“Nyamara Imana ntiyari yaretse Yakobo. Imbabazi Zayo zari zikiri ku mugaragu Wayo wari wahabye kandi utari uwo kwiringirwa. Uwiteka ku bw’urukundo rwinshi, yagaragaje ko Yakobo yari akeneye gusa Umukiza. Yari yaracumuye, ariko umutima we wari wuzuye ishimwe kubwo guhishurirwa uburyo yakongera kugirirwa neza n’Imana.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.183.

q.text: a. Ni iki twakwigira ku rwego Yakobo yabonye mu butayu?

note.text: “Muri izo nzozi, inama y’ugucungurwa yerekwa Yakobo atari mu buryo burambuye, ahubwo yeretswe umugabane w’ingenzi yari akeneye icyo gihe. Urwo rwego rw’amayobera yeretswe mu nzozi, rwari rumwe n’urwo Yesu yavuze igihe yaganiraga na Natanayeli [Yohana 1:51]. Mbere y’uko umuntu yigomeka ku butegetsi bw’Imana, umuntu yari afite umudendezo usesuye wo gusabana n’Imana. Ariko icyaha cya Adamu na Eva cyatandukanyije isi n’ijuru, ku buryo umuntu atagishobora kugirana umushyikirano n’Umuremyi we. Nyamara isi ntiyasigaye mu bwigunge idafite ibyiringiro. Urwo rwego rugereranya Yesu, ari We watoranyijwe kuduhuza n’Imana.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.184.

q.text: b. Sobanura isano ishyirwaho n’ubuhuza bwa Kristo.

note.text: “Umuntu yitandukanyije n’Imana, isi nayo yitandukanya n’ijuru binyuze mu buhakanyi. Imanga yaciwe hagati, niyo yatumye umubano wo gusabana udashoboka. Ariko binyuze muri Kristo, isi yongeye guhuzwa n’ijuru. Ubuntu Bwe burangwamo ineza, nibwo Kristo yatindishije imanga yaciwe n’ibyaha; kugirango abamarayika batumwa gukora umurimo ku isi bashobore gusabana n’abantu. Kristo niwe uhuza umunyabyaha w’intege nke agatuma ashyikira imbaraga z’Imana zitagira akagero.” — Kugana Yesu, p.20.

“Umutima w’Imana ugirira abana Bayo bo mu isi urukundo rurusha imbaraga urupfu. Mu gutanga Umwana Wayo, Imana yaduhaye ijuru ryose muri iyo mpano. Imibereho y’Umukiza, urupfu Rwe, ubuhuza Bwe, umurimo w’abamarayika, uko Umwuka Wera adusabira, umurimo Data wa twese akorera mu ijuru ndetse n’ibindi byose; bikubira hamwe kugirango bizanire abantu agakiza.” — lbid., p.21.

reviewQuestions: 1. Gereranya imimerere abantu barimo mbere na nyuma yo kugwa mu cyaha.
2. Nyuma yo gucumura, mbese ni iki umuntu yakoze kandi ni ukubera iki?
3. Ni ikihe gisubizo rukumbi cy’ikibazo cy’icyaha?
4. Tanga ubusobanuro bw’ikimenyetso gitangaje Yakobo yabonye mu nzozi ze.
5. Ni ubuhe buryo bw’itumanaho Imana ikomeza gukoresha mu gushyikirana n’abantu?

lessons.title: Kwihana
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Nuko mwihane muhindukire, ibyaha byanyu bihanagurwe ngo iminsi yo guhemburwa ibone uko iza ituruka ku Mwami Imana.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Nuko mwihane muhindukire, ibyaha byanyu bihanagurwe ngo iminsi yo guhemburwa ibone uko iza ituruka ku Mwami Imana.”

keyNote.text: “Imana ntizigera itererana abariganyijwe bakagwa mu cyaha ariko bakayigarukira kandi bakihana by’ukuri”. — Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.202,203.

q.text: a. Ni ikihe gihamya cyo kwihana nyakuri cyasabwe na Yohana Umubatiza?

note.text: “Kwihana ni ukubabazwa n’icyaha maze ugahindukira ukagicikaho. Ntabwo twazinukwa icyaha tutabanje kubona ububi bwacyo, kandi kugicikaho bya nikize ntibyatuma habaho impinduka mu mibereho.” — Kugana Yesu, p. 23.

q.text: b. Ni iki kigomba kumenyekana ku byerekeranye no kwihana nyakuri, kwa kundi guhindura umutima n’imibereho?

note.text: “Kubabazwa n’icyaha by’ukuri bituruka ku murimo w’Umwuka Wera. Mwuka ashyira ahagaragara ubuhemu bw’umutima wasuzuguye kandi ukababaza Umukiza, maze akadutera kubabarira munsi y’umusaraba. Buri cyaha gikozwe cyongera gukomeretsa Kristo, nuko rero iyo twitegereje Uwo twakomerekeje, dushavuzwa n’ibyaha byatumye agerwaho n’intimba. Bene iryo shavu rizadutera kuzinukwa icyaha.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.300.

“Igihe umutima wemeye icyo ubwirijwe n’Umwuka w’Imana, umutimanama urakanguka, umunyabyaha agira icyo asobanukirwa cyerekeranye no kwimbika no kwera kw’amategeko yera y’Imana, yo rufatiro rw’ubutegetsi Bwayo mu ijuru no mu isi.” — Kugana Yesu, p. 24.

q.text: a. Ni ukuhe gusaba kwa Dawidi igihe yamenyaga uburemere bw’igicumuro cye?

note.text: “Isengesho rya Dawidi amaze gucumura, ryerekana imiterere yo kubabazwa n’icyaha k’ukuri. Kwihana kwe ntikwarimo uburyarya kandi kwari kwimbitse. Ntiyigeze apfobya igicumuro cye; kandi isengesho rye ntiyaritewe no gutinya iteka yari agiye gucirwaho. Ahubwo Dawidi yabonye ko igicumuro cye cyari gikabije; yabonye uko cyahumanyije umutima we, maze azinukwa icyaha cye. Ntiyasenze asaba imbabazi gusa, ahubwo yanasabye ko umutima we ubonezwa. Yifuzaga cyane umunezero uzanwa no kwera – kugirango abone uko asabana n’Imana, bashyikirane.” — Kugana Yesu, p. 24,25.

q.text: b. Mbese ni ukuhe kwihana nyakuri Dawidi yagize tugomba gushaka?

note.text: “‘Undememo umutima wera.’ Ibyo bitangirira hano, mu rufatiro rw’imico ya Gikristo; kuko mu mutima ariho haturuka iby’ubugingo. Iyaba abantu bose, abagabura n’abizera b’amatorero, babyitegerezaga neza kugirango barebe niba imitima yabo itunganiye Imana, twabona umusaruro urushijeho kuba mwinshi uturutse mu mihati tugira. Uko umurimo ukora urushaho kuba uw’ingenzi kandi ukaba ufite inshingano, ni nako birushaho kuba ngombwa ko ugira umutima uboneye. Ubuntu bukenewe buratangwa, kandi imbaraga z’Umwuka Wera zizakorana n’imihati yose uzashyiraho kugira ngo ubigereho. Iyo buri mwana w’Imana aza kuyishaka abishishikariye kandi yihanganye, hari kubaho ukurushaho gukurira mu buntu. Amakimbirane yari kurangira; abizera bari guhuza umutima n’intekerezo; mu matorero hari kubamo ubutungane n’urukundo. Kubwo kwitegereza, turahinduka. Uko uzagenda urushaho kwitegereza imico ya Kristo, niko uzagenda urushaho kumera nka We. Sanga Yesu uko uri, na we azakwakira, kandi azashyira indirimbo nshya mu kanwa kawe, ndetse no guhimbaza Imana” — Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, (ingeri ya 1892/1893), p.451,452.

q.text: c. Mbese ni iki Bibiliya yigisha cyerekeranye no kwihana no kwiyegurira Kristo utizigamye?

note.text: “Uko tutabasha kubabarirwa tudafite Kristo, ni nako tutabasha kwihana tudafite Umwuka We ukangura umutimanama.

“Kristo ni we soko y’imigambi yose itunganye. Ni we wenyine ubasha gutera umutima kwanga icyaha. Buri gushishikarira ukuri n’ubutungane, buri kwemezwa ibyaha byacu, ni igihamya cyerekana ko Umwuka wa Kristo akorera mu mitima yacu.” — Kugana Yesu, p.26.

q.text: a. Ni iyihe miterere yo kwihana kwa Esawu, Farawo, na Yuda igihe basobanukirwaga ingaruka z’icyaha cyabo?

note.text: “Abantu benshi baterwa agahinda n’uko bacumuye, ndetse bagahinduka bya nikize kuko batinya ingaruka yabyo. Bene uko si ko kwihana Bibiliya yigisha. Barizwa n’ishyano bagusha aho kurizwa n’ibyaha; nkuko Esawu yagenje abonye ko abuze umugisha wo kuragwa ibya se…..Yuda Isikaryota, amaze kugambanira Umwami we, yaratatse ati “Nakoze icyaha, kuko nagambaniye amaraso atariho urubanza.” Matayo 27:4.

“Yemejwe n’umutima ucumuye, yumva urubanza ruteye ubwoba rumuriho, atinya amateka y’Imana. Amaherezo y’ibyo yari yakoze yatumye amarwa n’ubwoba, ariko mu mutima we nta shavu rikomeye rishengura umutima ryari rimurimo. Yari yagambaniye Umwana w’Imana utagira icyaha, yihakana Uwera wa Isirayeli. Farawo na we ubwo yababazwaga n’amateka yari yaciriweho n’Imana, yemeye ibicumuro bye, kugira ngo akire ibindi byago, ariko iyo icyago cyashiraga, yongeraga kwigamba ku Wo mw’ijuru. Abo bose barizwaga n’ingaruka y’ibyaha, ntibarushye barizwa n’ibyaha ubwabyo.” — Kugana Yesu, p.23,24.

“Imana yahaye Farawo ibihamya bikomeye cyane byerekana imbaraga Zayo, nyamara umwami arinangira yanga kumvira umucyo. Buri kwigaragaza kw’imbaraga ihoraho kwirengagijwe na we; kwatumye arushaho kugambirira kwigomeka. Imbuto zo kwigomeka yabibye igihe yangaga kwemera igitangaza cya mbere, zabyaye umusaruro wazo.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.268.

q.text: b. Mbese bizagendekera bite umunyabyaha utihana kandi agakomeza kuragiriza agatinda kwihana kugeza mu gihe cy’ahazaza?

note.text: “Abo bakristo ku izina bazaba bageze mu gihe giheruka cy’akaga gakomeye batiteguye, bazatura ibyaha byabo bihebye, mu ijwi ry’akababaro n’amagambo y’ubwihebe, nyamara ababi bazaba babaha inkwenene. Kwicuza kwabo kuzaba kumeze nk’ukwa Esawu cyangwa ukwa Yuda. Abakora ibyo, baganyishwa n’ingaruka z’ibicumuro byabo, aho kurizwa n’icyaha bakoze. Ntibicuza by’ukuri, kuko badatinya gukora ikibi. Bemera ibyaha byabo kubera gutinya igihano; ariko nkuko byabaye kuri Farawo wa kera, urubanza ruramutse rukuweho bakongera gusuzugura Imana.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.620,621.

q.text: a. Ni irihe tandukaniro riri hagati y’Umufarisayo n’Umukoresha w’ikoro mu nkuru ya Kristo?

note.text: “Mu mugani w’Umufarisayo n’umukoresha w’ikoro, isengesho ryo kwiyemera ngo: “Mana, ndagushimiye yuko ntameze nk’abandi,” rihabanye cyane n’isengesho ry’umukoresha w’ikoro wihanaga agira ati: ‘Mana, mbabarira kuko ndi umunyabyaha.’ (Luka 18:11,13).” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.495.

q.text: b. Ni iki Yesu yavuze ku musaruro w’isengesho ry’Umukoresha w’ikoro?

note.text: “Wa mukoresha w’ikoro wasenze ati: ‘Mana, mbabarira kuko ndi umunyabyaha’ (Luka 18:13), we yibonaga nk’inkozi y’ibibi yasayishije, kandi yibwiraga ko n’abandi ari ko bamubona; nyamara yari azi ubukene bwe, nuko asanga Imana afite umutwaro w’ibyaha kandi akozwe n’isoni, ayisaba imbabazi. Umutima we yari awugururiye Umwuka w’Imana kugirango abone uko amukoreramo umurimo w’ubuntu, amubature mu bubata bw’imbaraga y’icyaha. Ariko isengesho ry’Umufarisayo wirata, wihangiraga gukiranuka; ryagaragaje ko umutima we utifuza guturwamo n’Umwuka Wera. Kubera kuba kure y’Imana kwe, ntiyiyumvagamo uko yanduye, ntiyari aziko Imana iboneye kandi yera. Yumvaga ntacyo akennye, nuko ntiyagira n’icyo ahabwa.” — Kugana Yesu, p. 30,31.

q.text: c. Mu kuvuga iyi nkuru, mbese ni iyihe nyifato kirimbuzi Yesu yashakaga gukosora?

note.text: “Idini ry’Umufarisayo ntabwo rikora ku mutima. Ntaharanira kugira imico isa n’iy’Imana, ndetse no kugira umutima wuzuye urukundo n’impuhwe. Anyurwa n’idini ireba ku bigaragara inyuma gusa. Gukiranuka kwe ni ukwe bwite, ni umusaruro uvuye mu mirimo ye bwite, kandi ishimwa hashingiwe ku rugero rwa muntu.

“Uwiringira ko ari umukiranutsi wese ntazabura gupfobya abandi. Nk’uko Umufarisayo yishimagizaga yigereranya n’abandi bantu, niko na we anenga abandi abigereranyaho. Gukiranuka kwe akugereranya n’ukwabo, kandi uko barushaho kugaragara ko ari babi niko we agaragara ko akiranuka yigereranyije na bo. Kwigira umukiranutsi kwe kumutera ‘kurega abandi bantu’ abashinja ko bagomera amategeko y’Imana. Bityo agaragaza wa mutima wa Satani, umurezi wa bene data. Ufite umutima umeze utyo, ntibyashoboka ko asabana n’Imana.” – Imigani ya Kristo, p.151.

q.text: a. Ni akahe kaga kari mu kwinangira cyangwa gutinda kwitaba irarika?

note.text: “Benshi bahumuriza imitimanama ihangayitse bibwira ko bashobora guhindura imigirire yabo mibi igihe babishakiye; bibwira ko bashobora gukerensa irarika ry’imbabazi, nyamara rigakomeza kubagarukira rikongera rikaza. Bibwira ko nibamara guhinyura Umwuka w’ubuntu, bagahitamo guhagarara mu ruhande rwa Satani, ngo nibabona ishyano ribagwiriye, bashobora guhindura imigirire yabo mu kanya gato nk’ako guhumbya. Ariko ibyo ntibikunze gushoboka mu buryo bworoshye. Ibyo umuntu yigishijwe n’akamenyero ko mu mibereho iyo bimaze kurema imico, bituma ari gake umuntu yifuza kwakira ishusho ya Yesu.” — Kugana Yesu, p. 33,34.

q.text: b. Ni iki tugomba gukora igihe dusobanukiwe ko umutima wacu n’imibereho yacu bidashyize hamwe n’Imana?

note.text: “Mwige ijambo ry’Imana musenga. Iryo jambo ribagaragariza amahame akomeye yo kwera aboneka mu mategeko y’Imana no mu mibereho ya Kristo, ‘kuko utejejwe atazareba Umwami Imana’ (Abaheburayo 12:14). Ijambo ry’Imana ritwemeza ibyaha, riduhishurira rwose inzira y’agakiza. Mujye muryitaho ribabere ijwi ry’Imana rivugana n’imitima yanyu.” — Ibid., p. 35.

“Natwe twari abanyabyaha bikabije, ariko Kristo yapfiriye kugirango tubabarirwe. Ibyo igitambo Cye cyadukoreye birahagije kuri Data wa twese. Abo Kristo yababariye byinshi, nibo bazarushaho kumukunda cyane, nibo bazegera intebe Ye ya cyami bamushimira urukundo Rwe rukomeye n’igitambo Cye kitagira akagero. Iyo turushijeho gusobanukirwa urukundo rw’Imana, nibwo turushaho kumenya ububi bw’icyaha. Iyo turebye uburebure bw’umunyururu wamanuriwe kudutabara, iyo dusobanukiwe ho hato igitambo cya Kristo kitagira akagero cyatambwe kubwacu, niho umutima ushenjagurwa n’urukundo n’ishavu.” — Ibid., p.36.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni iyihe mpano ihebuje Imana iduha kugira ngo dushobore guhabwa ubuntu mvajuru?
2. Kuki tudashobora kwihana by’ukuri ku bwacu?
3. Ni iki cyari kibuze mu kwihana kwa Esawu, Farawo na Yuda?
4. Kuki Yesu yaciye umugani w’Umufarisayo n’umukoresha w’ikoro?
5. Ni iyihe ntambwe y’ingenzi cyane yatuma umuntu asabana n’Imana mu buryo bwimbitse?

lessons.title: Kwatura Ibyaha
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Uhisha ibicumuro bye ntazagubwa neza, ariko ubyatura akabireka azababarirwa.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Uhisha ibicumuro bye ntazagubwa neza, ariko ubyatura akabireka azababarirwa.”

keyNote.text: “Kwatura ibyaha kuvuye ku mutima witanze byimazeyo kuzagera ku Mana nyirimbabazi zihoraho”. — Kugana Yesu, p.38.

q.text: a. Mbese ni iki tugomba gukora igihe twemejwe icyaha?

note.text: “Ibisabwa kugirango umuntu abone imbabazi z’Imana biroroshye, biraboneye kandi birumvikana. Ntabwo Uwiteka adusaba gukora ibintu bimwe bitubabaza kugirango tubone kubabarirwa ibyaha. Ntabwo dukeneye gukora ingendo nyobokamana ndende kandi zinaniza cyangwa kwiha ibihano bitubabaza umubiri kugirango imitima yacu ibe yakwemerwa n’Imana nyir’ijuru cyangwa ngo ibicumuro byacu bikunde bihanagurwe; ahubwo uwatura icyaha cye kandi akakireka azababarirwa.” — Kugana Yesu, p.37.

q.text: b. Mbese ibi bidusaba kugira iyihe nyifato?

note.text: “Abataracishirije bugufi imitima yabo imbere y’Imana ngo bemere icyaha cyabo ntabwo barabasha kuzuza igisabwa cya mbere kugira ngo babashe kwemerwa. Niba tutaragize bene uko kwihana kuticuzwa, kandi tukaba tutaratuye ibyaha byacu dufite kwicisha bugufi nyakuri ko mu mutima ndetse dufite n’umutima umenetse, kandi tuzinutswe igicumuro cyacu, ntabwo turigera tumaramaza gushaka imbabazi z’icyaha; kandi niba tutarashaka izo mbabazi ntabwo turigera tubona amahoro y’Imana. Impamvu imwe rukumbi tudashobora kubabarirwa ibyaha byo mu gihe cyashize ni uko tudashaka gucisha bugufi imitima yacu y’ubwibone ngo duhuze n’ibisabwa n’ijambo ry’ukuri. Hari amabwiriza asobanutse rwose yatanzwe ku byerekeye iki kibazo. Kwatura ibyaha kwaba gukorewe mu ruhame cyangwa se umuntu yiherereye, gukwiriye kuba kuvuye ku mutima kandi kugakorwa nta gahato.” — Ibid., p. 37,38.

q.text: a. Iyo tugiriye nabi mugenzi wacu, ni nde wundi tuba duhemukiye?

note.text: “Intumwa iravuga iti: “Mwaturirane ibyaha byanyu kandi musabirane kugirango mukizwe.” (Yakobo 5:16). Aturira Imana ibyaha byawe, yo yonyine ishobora kubibabarira, kandi mubwirane amakosa yanyu. Niba warahemukiye inshuti yawe cyangwa umuturanyi ugomba kwemera ikibi wakoze, kandi na we afite inshingano yo kukubabarira mu mudendezo we. Ubwo nibwo rero uzaba ugomba gusaba Imana imbabazi kuko uwo mugenzi wawe wakomerekeje ari umwana w’Imana, kandi mu kumukomeretsa wacumuye ku Muremyi n’Umucunguzi we.” — Kugana Yesu, p.37.

q.text: b. Ni ukubera iki dukwiriye kubabarira abandi?

note.text: “Umuntu utagira imbabazi aba aciye umuyoboro umwe rukumbi ashobora kuboneramo imbabazi z’Imana. Ntidukwiriye gutekereza yuko dushobora gutsindishirizwa tutababariye abandi, ngo ni uko batadusabye imbabazi kuko ari bo batugiriye nabi. Si ugushidikanya, guca bugufi mu mitima yabo bakihana kandi bakicuza, ni umurimo wabo; ariko dukwiriye kugira umwuka w’imbabazi ku baducumuyeho baba batwicujijeho cyangwa se batatwicujijeho. Nubwo baba baradukomerekeje bimeze bite, ntabwo dukwiriye guha icyicaro imibabaro yacu ngo twigirire impuhwe kubwo kugirirwa nabi; ahubwo uko twiringira kubabarirwa ibyo twakiraniwe ku Mana ni ko dukwiriye kubabarira abantu bose batugiriye nabi.” – Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.113,114.

q.text: c. Ni iki gikwiriye kutwigisha inshingano dufite ku kiremwamuntu?

note.text: “Mureke Kristo, we Bugingo bw’Imana, abe muri mwe kandi abagaragarizemo urukundo rwo mu ijuru ruzahesha ibyiringiro abatabigira n’amahoro yo mu ijuru umutima wakomerekejwe n’ibyaha. Uko turushaho kwegera Imana, ikintu gikwiriye guhamya yuko twababariwe n’Imana ni uko natwe dukwiriye kubabarira abandi.” — Ibid., p.114,115.

“Kugaragariza mugenzi wacu inyifato itari iya kimuntu nicyo cyaha cyacu gikomeye cyane. Abantu benshi batekereza ko bahagarariye ubutabera bw’Imana, mu gihe mu by’ukuri bananirwa rwose kugaragaza ubugwaneza Bwayo n’urukundo Rwayo rwinshi. Incuro nyinshi, abo bahura na bo bakagaragaza ubukana n’umwaga, bahangayikishwa n’ibishuko. Satani ari kurwanya abo bantu, kandi amagambo mabi atarangwamo impuhwe abaca intege agatuma baba umuhigo w’imbaraga z’umushukanyi.” – Umurimo wo Gukiza, p.163.

dailyLessons.sectionTitle: 3. MU BURYO BURASA KU NTEGO KANDI BW’UKURI

q.text: a. Ni ibihe byaha bikwiriye kwaturwa ku mugaragaro mu gihe ibindi byo bigomba kwaturirwa Imana yonyine?

note.text: “Ukwatura ibyaha k’ukuri iteka kuraromboreza kukarasa ku ntego, kandi kukemera ibyaha byihariye. Bishobora kuba ari ibyaha byajyanwa imbere y’Imana yonyine, hari nubwo byaba ari n’ibyaha bikwiriye kwaturirwa imbere y’abantu bakomerekejwe binyuze muri ibyo bibi byakozwe, cyangwa se bishobora kuba ari ibyaha biri rusange bikwiriye kuvugirwa mu iteraniro ry’abantu. Ariko kwatura kose kugomba kuba gusobanutse kandi kurasa ku ntego, ukemera ibyaha nyakuri biguhama.” – Kugana Yesu, p.38.

“Icyaha cyakozwe mu ibanga kigomba kwaturirwa Kristo, umuhuza umwe rukumbi uri hagati y’Imana n’abantu….. Icyaha cyose ni uguhemukira Imana, kandi kigomba kwaturirwa Imana binyuze muri Kristo. Icyaha cyose gikozwe ku mugaragaro kigomba kwaturirwa mu ruhame.” – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.216.

q.text: b. Ni uwuhe mugambi wo kwatura nyakuri?

note.text: “Mu gihe cya Samweli Abisirayeli bagiye kure y’Imana. Bari bari kugerwaho n’ingaruka z’icyaha, bitewe n’uko bari bararetse kwizera Imana, batakaza gusobanukirwa imbaraga n’ubwenge Bwayo mu kuyobora ishyanga, batakaza kwiringira ubushobozi Bwayo bwo kurengera no kurinda umurimo Wayo. Bateye umugongo Umutware ukomeye w’ibiriho byose mu isanzure maze bifuza kuyoborwa nk’uko andi mahanga abakikije ayobowe. Mbere y’uko bagira amahoro, babanje kwatura beruye bati: “Kuko twongereye ku byaha byacu byose iki cyaha cyo kwisabira umwami.” (1Samweli 12:19). Icyaha nyakuri cyabahamaga bagombaga kucyatura.” – Kugana Yesu, p.38,39.

q.text: c. Ni iyihe migirire igomba gukurikizwa mu kwatura ibyaha?

note.text: “Kwatura icyaha ntikuzemerwa n’Imana hatabayeho kwihana no kwivugurura kuvuye ku mutima. Mu buzima hagomba kubamo impinduka zidakebakeba, ikintu cyose gitukisha Imana kigomba kwigizwayo. Ibi bizaba umusaruro wo kubabazwa n’icyaha by’ukuri.” — Ibid., p.39.

“Nk’uko byagenze kuri Zakayo, umuntu wese wihannye azagaragaza ko Kristo yinjiye mu mutima we abihamishije kureka imikorere idatunganye yagiye iranga imibereho ye. Nk’uko byagenze kuri uyu mukoresha w’ikoro mukuru, azagaragaza ko amaramaje agarura ibyo yambuye.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.556.

q.text: a. Igihe Uwiteka yabazaga Adamu na Eva iby’icyaha cyabo, ni gute batanze urwitwazo berekana ko mu by’ukuri batakosheje?

note.text: “Adamu, ntiyashoboye guhakana cyangwa ngo asabe imbabazi z’icyaha cye [ngo agaragaze ko kimubabaje], ahubwo yaherereje icyaha ku mugore we, aba agiherereje no ku Mana ubwayo: ‘Umugore wampaye ngo tubane, ni we wampaye ku mbuto z’icyo giti, ndazirya.’ ” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.57.

“Adamu na Eva bamaze kurya ku mbuto z’igiti cyabuzanyijwe, buzuwe n’ikimwaro n’ubwoba. Ubwa mbere igitekerezo kimwe rukumbi cyabajemo ni ukuntu bari gutangira urwitwazo icyaha cyabo imbere y’Imana maze bagakira urubanza rwo gupfa. Igihe Uwiteka yababazaga iby’icyaha bakoze, Adamu yarasubije, ariko ku ruhande rumwe agashyira icyaha ku Mana, no rundi ruhande akagishyira ku mufasha we Eva. Yaravuze ati: “Umugore wampaye ngo tubane, ni we wampaye ku mbuto z’icyo giti, ndazirya.” Umugore nawe yashyize umugayo ku nzoka, aravuga ati: “Inzoka yanshukashutse, ndazirya”. Itangiriro 3:12,13. Kuki waremye inzoka? Kuki wemeye ko iza muri Edeni? Ibi ni ibibazo byari byihishe inyuma yo kwisobanura ku cyaha yari yakoze, bityo ashinja Imana kuba ari yo nyirabayazana wo gucumura kwabo.” – Kugana Yesu, p.40.

q.text: b. Ni ukubera iki kwitsindishiriza bituma kwatura icyaha ntacyo bimara?

note.text: “Umwuka wo kwitsindishiriza wakomotse kuri se w’ibinyoma kandi wagiye ugaragazwa n’abahungu n’abakobwa bose ba Adamu. Kwatura muri ubu buryo ntikuba guturutse ku Umwuka w’Imana, kandi ntikuzemerwa imbere y’Imana. Kwihana nyakuri kuzayobora umuntu ku kwemera icyaha cye kandi acyemere nta buriganya cyangwa uburyarya.” — Ibid., p.40.

“Ntabwo dukwiriye kugerageza gupfobya ibicumuro byacu dushakira ibyaha urwitwazo. Dukwiriye kwemera icyaha uko Imana ikivuga, kandi mu by’ukuri kiraremereye. I Kaluvari honyine ni ho hashobora kugaragaza ububi bw’icyaha buteye ubwoba. Iyaba twari abo kwiyikorerera igicumuro cyacu, cyabasha kuduturitsa. Ariko Uwera utagira icyaha yagiye mu mwanya wacu; nubwo atari abikwiriye, yikoreye gukiranirwa kwacu. “Nitwatura ibyaha byacu, Imana ni iyo kwizerwa kandi ikiranukira kutubabarira ibyaha byacu, no kutwezaho gukiranirwa kose.” (1Yohana 1:9). Mbega ukuri gutangaje! Nk’uko itegeko Ryayo riri, ni Yo itsindishiriza abizera Yesu bose. “Ni iyihe Mana ihwanye na we, ibabarira gukiranirwa, ikirengagiza ibicumuro by’abasigaye b’umwandu wayo? Ntihorana uburakari bwayo iteka, kuko yishimira kugira imbabazi.” Mika 7:18.” – Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.116.

q.text: a. Ni gute Pawulo yicishije bugufi akemera icyaha cye atazuyaje?

note.text: “Ingero zo mu ijambo ry’Imana zigaragaza kwihana nyakuri no kwicisha bugufi zihishura umwuka wo kwatura aho nta rwitwazo na ruto rutangwa cyangwa kugerageza kwitsindishiriza. Ntabwo Pawulo yashatse kwihishira; [ahubwo] yerekanye icyaha cye mu bubi bwacyo bwose, habe no kugerageza koroshya inkomanga yo mu mutima we. [Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa 26:10,11].” – Kugana Yesu, p.41.

q.text: b. Ni iki Pawulo yavuze mu rwandiko rwe rwa mbere yandikiye Timoteyo?

note.text: “Ntacyo dushobora kwibonamo kitari intege nke gusa, nta cyiza twabona ko Imana yadushimira, kubw’ibyo Satani akatubwira ko turushywa n’ubusa, ko imico yacu idashobora kugira ikiyitunganya. Igihe tugerageza gusanga Imana, umwanzi ajya atwongorera ati: “Ntacyo bikumariye gusenga”; kandi ati: “Harya si wowe wakoze cya kintu kibi? Ntiwagomeye Imana kandi ugakiranirwa no ku mutimanama wawe?” Dushobora kubwira umwanzi yuko “amaraso ya Yesu Kristo Umwana wayo atweza akatumaraho icyaha cyose.” (1Yohana 1:7). Igihe twiyumvamo yuko twakoze icyaha kandi yuko tudashobora gusenga, icyo ni cyo gihe tuba dukwiriye gusenga. Nubwo twaba dukozwe n’isoni kandi tunyinyiriwe, tuba dukwiriye gusenga kandi tukizera [1Timoteyo 1:15]. Kubabarirwa n’Imana….. ni impano duhabwa ikomoka mu gukiranuka kutagira ikizinga kwa Kristo.” – Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.115,116.

q.text: c. Ni iki Imana yadusezeraniye nituramuka twatuye ibyaha byacu?

note.text: “Umutima uciye bugufi kandi umenetse, wuzuwe no kwihana nyakuri, uzanyurwa kandi wishimire urukundo rw’Imana n’ikiguzi cyatanzwe i Kaluvari; kandi nk’uko umwana yaturira se umukunda, niko umunyabyaha wihana by’ukuri azajyana ibyaha bye imbere y’Imana. Kandi byanditswe ngo [1Yohana 1:9].” – Kugana Yesu, p.41.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni gute duhagarara imbere y’Imana igihe tuyaturira ibyaha byacu mu budahemuka?
2. Ni mu yihe mimerere ibyaha byacu bimwe na bimwe bigomba kwaturirwa abandi bantu, kandi ni ukubera iki?
3. Ni ukubera iki ari iby’ingenzi kwatura icyaha udaciye ku ruhande?
4. Sobanura akaga gaterwa no kwitsindishiriza.
5. Ni uwuhe musaruro uturuka mu kwatura ibyaha byawe wicishije bugufi?

lessons.title: Kwiyegurira Imana
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Muzanshaka mumbone, nimunshakana umutima wanyu wose.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Muzanshaka mumbone, nimunshakana umutima wanyu wose.”

keyNote.text: “Mu mbaraga zacu bwite kurwana iyo ntambara ntibyadushobokera; kandi ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose giteshura intekerezo z’umuntu ku Mana, ikintu cyose gitera umuntu kwikuza no kumva yihagije, kiba kidutegurira inzira yo kugwa burundu. Bibiliya yigisha kutiringira ubushobozi bw’umuntu maze igakangurira abantu kwiringira imbaraga y’Imana.” — Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.717.

q.text: a. Ni gute Pawulo yasobanuye urugamba rwa Gikristo n’intwaro zikenewe muri rwo?

note.text: “Satani yateze Yesu ngo amugeragereshe ibishuko biteye ubwoba, ariko mu kigeregezo cyose, umwanzi yaratsinzwe. Izo ntambara zarwanywe ku bwacu; uko gutsinda kwatubereye inzira yo kunesha. Kristo yiteguye guha umuntu wese ubishaka imbaraga yo gutsinda. Nta muntu ushobora gutsindwa na Satani atamutije umurindi. Umushukanyi ntafite ububasha bwo gutegeka ubushake cyangwa guhatira umutima gukora icyaha. Ashobora guteza umubabaro mu mutima w’uwo bahanganye, ariko ntashobora kumwanduza. Ashobora kumuca intege, ariko ntashobora kumuhumanya. Kuba Kristo yaratsinze bikwiye gutera abamwizera barwana urugamba rwo kunesha icyaha na Satani bashikamye.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.510.

q.text: b. Ni hehe Satani ageragereza kubona insinzi?

note.text: “‘Kuko uko [umuntu] atekereza ku mutima ari ko ari.’ (Imigani 23:7). Umutima ugomba kugirwa mushya n’ubuntu bw’Imana, nibitaba bityo, gushaka ubutungane bw’ubugingo bizaba imfabusa. Umuntu wese ugerageza gukuza imico iboneye kandi itunganye adafashijwe n’ubuntu bwa Kristo, aba yubaka inzu ye ku musenyi. Mu mugaru ukaze w’ibigeragezo, nta kabuza iyo nzu izasenyuka.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.460.

q.text: a. Ni iki gikwiriye kurekwa kugirango umuntu abe umwigishwa wa Kristo?

note.text: “Iyo twiyeguriye Imana, ni ngombwa ko tureka ibintu byose bishobora kudutandukanya na Yo. Niko Umukiza avuga [Luka 14:33]. Ikintu cyose cyakura umutima wacu ku Mana kigomba kurekwa rwose. Ikigirwamana cya benshi ni mamoni. Gukunda amafaranga no kwifuza ubutunzi, ni umurunga w’izahabu ubaboheye kuri Satani. Kwifuza kuratwa n’abandi no kurarikira icyubahiro cyo mu isi bibera abandi ikigirwamana. Imibereho yo kwikunda no kwihunza inshingano nayo ibera abandi ikigirwamana. Ariko izo ngoyi zitugira ibiretwa zikwiriye gucibwa. Ntidushobora kwitanga igice ngo tube ab’Imana uruhande rumwe naho urundi tube ab’isi. Ntituri abana b’Imana, keretse tubaye bo mu buryo bwuzuye.” – Kugana Yesu, p.44.

q.text: b. Ni irihe rarika mvajuru Uwiteka aha abantu bose bifuza kugira umutima mushya n’imibereho mishya?

note.text: “Ingoma y’Imana si iy’ubuhake bw’abayoboke bameze nk’impumyi, batwazwa igitugu nk’uko Satani yagiye ashaka kuyigaragaza. Ahubwo ingoma y’Imana isaba ko abayirimo bagengwa n’ubwenge n’umutimanama... Imana ntihata ubushake bw’abo yaremye. Ntishobora kwemera ko tuyiha icyubahiro bitavuye ku mutima ukunze kandi kidatanganywe ubwenge. Guhatirwa kubaha ku gahato bibuza umuntu iterambere ry’ubwenge cyangwa ry’imico, bikaba byatuma umuntu amera nk’imashini igengwa n’abandi. Uwo siwo mugambi w’Umuremyi. Ahubwo yifuza ko umuntu agira iterambere agashyikira urugero ruhanitse, kuko ariwe kamba ry’umurimo w’imbaraga Ye irema. Yadushyize imbere umugisha utagira uko usa kandi yifuza kuwuduha binyuze mu buntu Bwayo. Iturarikira kuyiyegurira, kugirango ishobore gusohoreza muri twe ubushake Bwayo. Ubwo rero ni ahacu guhitamo kubohorwa ingoyi z’ibyaha kugirango tubone gusangira n’abana b’Imana umudendezo usesuye.” — Ibid., pp. 43,44.

“Kristo yerekanywe ari Umukiza w’abantu. Abantu ntibagombaga kwiringira imirimo yabo ubwabo, gukiranuka kwabo bwite, cyangwa bo ubwabo mu buryo ubwo aribwo bwose, ahubwo bagombaga kwiringira Umwana w’Intama w’Imana ukuraho ibyaha by’abari mu isi. Muri we niho hahishuriwe Umuvugizi utuvuganira kuri Data wa twese. Irarika ryatanzwe binyuze muri We rigira riti: ‘Nimuze tujye inama, ni ko Uwiteka avuga, Naho ibyaha byanyu byatukura nk’umuhemba birahinduka umweru bise na shelegi, naho byatukura tukutuku birahinduka nk’ubwoya bw’intama bwera.’ Iri rarika ni twebwe ribwirwa muri iki gihe. Ntitukagire ubwibone cyangwa ngo twishyire hejuru, ntitukihangire gukiranuka ahubwo buri wese akomeze kwatura ibyaha bye, kugirango ashobore kwishyuza isezerano.” – Amahameshingiro y’Uburezi bwa Gikristo, p.239.

q.text: a. Ni iki cyahaye Kristo uburenganzira bwo kujyana abana Be mu ijuru?

note.text: “Muri wa mwijima uteye ubwoba, igihe Kristo yasaga n’uwaretswe n’Imana, nibwo yiranguje ibyari bisigaye mu gikombe cyuzuye umubabaro wa muntu. Muri ayo masaha ateye ubwoba yari yishingikirije ku kwemerwa na Se nk’uko byari bisanzwe. Yari asobanukiwe neza n’imico ya Se; yari azi neza ubutabera bwa Se, imbabazi Ze, ndetse n’urukundo Rwe rutarondoreka. Kwizera kwe kwari mu wo yashimishwaga no kumvira iteka. Kandi mu kumvira yishyize mu maboko y’Imana, maze igitekerezo cyo kurekwa na Se nticyaba kikiri muri we. Kubwo kwizera, Kristo yabaye umuneshi.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.756.

“Mu gutanga Yesu, Imana yatanze ijuru ryose. Mu myumvire ya kimuntu, igitambo nk’icyo cyari ugupfusha ubusa mu bupfapfa. Mu mitekerereze ya kimuntu gahunda yose y’agakiza igaragara nk’impuhwe nyinshi zapfushijwe ubusa. Kwitanga n’igitambo cyuzuye urukundo twatangiwe bitugeraho aho turi hose. Ingabo zo mu ijuru zitangazwa cyane no kubona abatuye isi banga kuzahurwa no gukungahazwa n’urukundo ndetse n’imbabazi bitagira akagero byagaragarijwe muri Kristo. Abamarayika bashobora kuvuga bati: Kuki habayeho gupfusha ubusa kungana gutya?

“Nyamara impongano yatangiwe isi yacumuye yagombaga kuba yuzuye, isendereye kandi ishyitse. Igitambo cya Kristo cyari gihagije cyane kugira ngo kigere ku bo Imana yaremye bose. Igitambo cya Kristo nticyashoboraga gushyirwaho imbibi kugira ngo kingane gusa n’umubare w’abazakira iyo mpano ikomeye. Abantu bose ntabwo bakiriye agakiza; nyamara inama y’agakiza si imfabusa nubwo idasohoza ibyo ubuntu Bwayo bwateganyije byose. Hari byinshi bihagije ndetse bisagutse.” — Ibid., p.565,566.

q.text: b. Ni iki Yesu asaba abantu bose bifuza kuba abana Be kandi bashaka guhabwa Umwuka We?

note.text: “[Yesu] ategerezanyije impuhwe kumva ukwatura kw’impabe no kwakira ugusenga kwe yihana. Ategereje abamugarukira bafite ishimwe, nk’uko umubyeyi yitegerezanya ukumwenyura umwana we akunda. Imana ikomeye itwigisha kuyita Data wa twese. Yifuza ko dusobanukirwa uburyo itwitaho mu bigeragezo byacu byose n’ibishuko byose tunyuramo.” – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.210.

“Mbese twebwe iyo dutanze byose tuba turetse iki? Nta kindi uretse umutima uhumanijwe n’ibyaha, dushaka kubonezwa na Yesu, akatwejesha amaraso Ye, kandi akadukirisha urukundo Rwe rutagira akagero. Nyamara abantu bibwira ko biruhije guhara byose! Kubyumva ntyo bintera agahinda, ndetse mfite isoni zo kubyandika.” — Kugana Yesu, p.46.

q.text: a. Ni ikihe cyifuzo gikomeye Pawulo yari afitiye abizera?

note.text: “Nubwo ayo magambo yabwirwaga Abisirayeli ba kera, natwe ubwoko bw’Imana aratureba muri iki gihe. Kandi dukwiriye no kwita ku magambo y’intumwa aduhamagarira, kubwo imbabazi z’Imana, gutanga imibiri yacu ho “ibitambo bizima, byera, bishimwa n’Imana.” Uko ni ko kwezwa nyakuri. Ntabwo ari ibyo ku rurimi gusa, amarangamutima, cyangwa amagambo, ahubwo ni ihame rizima, rigomba kuranga imibereho yacu ya buri munsi. Bisaba ko ingeso zacu mu mirire, iminywere, n’imyambarire biba ibyo kurinda imibiri yacu, intekerezo zacu, n’umutimanama by’ubuzima bwacu. Kugira ngo duhe Imana imibiri yacu itameze nk’ibitambo byononwe n’ingeso mbi, ahubwo ari ‘ibitambo bizima byera bishimwa n’Imana.’ ” – Imibereho Yejejwe, p.27,28.

“Tugomba kwitangira umurimo w’Imana, kandi dukwiriye guharanira gutanga ituro ritunganye uko dushoboye kose. Ntabwo Imana izanezezwa n’ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose giciye munsi y’icyiza kuruta ibindi dushobora gutanga. Abakundisha Imana umutima wabo wose bazifuza kuyikorera umurimo mwiza uruta iyindi mu mibereho yabo, kandi bazahora bashaka guhuza imbaraga zabo zose n’amategeko azabashoboza gukora ibyo Imana ishaka.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.352,353.

q.text: b. Igihe imbaga y’abantu yumvaga ikibwirizwa cya Petero ku munsi wa Pentekote, mbese ni iki cyabereye umutwaro imitima yabo?

note.text: “[Iyo mbaga y’abantu] biyumviye abigishwa batangaza ko ari Umwana w’Imana wari warabambwe. Abatambyi n’abakuru bahinze umushyitsi. Abantu bumvise batsinzwe kandi bagira umubabaro. “Abo bantu bumvise ibyo bibacumita mu mitima, nuko babaza Petero n’izindi ntumwa bati “Bagabo bene Data, mbese tugire dute?” Muri abo bari bateze intumwa amatwi harimo Abayuda bashikamye mu myizerere yabo. Imbaraga yari mu magambo y’uwavugaga yabemeje ko Yesu yari Mesiya koko….

“Petero yihanangirije abari banyuzwe n’amagambo ye ko bari baranze Kristo kubera ko bari barayobejwe n’abatambyi n’abakuru b’idini ya Kiyuda; kandi ko nibakomeza kugirwa inama n’abatambyi n’abakuru, kandi bagategereza kuzemera Kristo ari uko abatambyi n’abakuru babanje kumwemera, nta na rimwe bazigera bamwemera. Abo bantu bakomeye n’ubwo berekanaga ko ari abantu bazi Imana, bari buzuye umururumba w’ubutunzi bw’isi n’ibyubahiro. Ntibifuzaga gusanga Kristo kugira ngo bahabwe umucyo.” – Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa, p.43,44.

q.text: a. Ni iki kitwemeza ko twiyeguriye Uwiteka mu buryo bwuzuye kandi ko dushobora kugira ishusho ya Kristo?

note.text: “Ntabwo Imana igusaba gutinya ko itazasohoza amasezerano yayo, ko kwihangana Kwayo kuzacogora cyangwa ngo impuhwe Zayo zishireho. Ahubwo utinye ko ubushake bwawe bubura kuyoborwa n’ubushake bwa Kristo, n’uko ibiranga imico yawe n’ibya karande wimenyereje bigenga imibereho yawe. “Imana niyo ibatera gukunda no gukora ibyo yishimira.” Bityo rero, tinya ko ukwikunda kwawe kwakwitambika hagati y’umutima wawe n’umurimo w’Umutware ukomeye. Utinye ko kwikunda kwawe gushobora kurogoya umugambi ukomeye Imana ishaka gusohoreza muri wowe. Irinde kwiringira imbaraga zawe bwite, tinya kuvana ikiganza cyawe mu cya Kristo kandi utinye kugerageza kunyura mu nzira zo mu mibereho y’ubu buzima utari kumwe na We.” – Imigani ya Kristo, p.161.

q.text: b. Ni gute gushikama mu kwizera no kwitangira amahame atunganye utizigamye bigomba gusigasirwa?

note.text: “Abashaka kubona umugisha wo kwezwa bagomba kubanza kumenya icyo kwitanga bisobanuye. Umusaraba wa Kristo ni wo nkingi “ubwiza bw’iteka ryose bukomeye” bushamikiyeho.” – Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa, p.560.

“Ntiwabasha guhindura umutima wawe, ntiwabasha kandi kwitera icyifuzo cyo gukunda Imana; ariko icyo ubasha cyo ni uguhitamo kuyikorera. Ushobora kuyegurira ubushake bwawe, kuko aribwo izagukoreramo kandi igasohoreza ubushake Bwayo muri wowe….

“Nukoresha neza ubushake bwawe, imibereho yawe izahinduka ukundi rwose. Iyo weguriye Kristo ubushake bwawe, uba wifatanyije n’ubutware burusha ubushobozi abatware bose n’abategetsi bose. Uzagira imbaraga ivuye mu ijuru yo kugukomeza, maze kandi uko uzajya wiyegurira Imana niko uzajya ubashishwa kugira ubugingo bushya, ariyo mibereho yo kwizera.” — Kugana Yesu, p.47,48.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni ikihe kintu cya ngombwa kugirango tugere ku nsinzi mu rugamba duhanganyemo n’umwanzi w’ubugingo bwacu?
2. Mbese ni iyihe ntambara nyakuri igomba kurwanwa kugirango umwanzi aneshwe?
3. Ni iki twakwigira ku mpano ya Kristo kubw’agakiza kacu?
4. Ni uwuhe mugambi Imana ifitiye abizera haba mu by’umubiri no mu by’umwuka?
5. Ubushake bwacu nibuba buhuje n’ubushake bw’Imana, ni iyihe mibereho izaturanga buri munsi?

fso.title: Amaturo y’Isabato ya Mbere
fso.subtitle: Azagenerwa Icyiciro cy’Uburezi mu Nteko Nkuru Rusange
fso.writer: Icyiciro cy’Uburezi mu Nteko Nkuru Rusange

paragraph.text: “Menyereza umwana inzira akwiriye kunyuramo, azarinda asaza atarayivamo.” Imigani 22:6.

Turiho mu bihe bikomeye. Muri iyi si igenda irushaho kudashishikarira iby’idini, inshingano yo kwigisha abana bacu n’urubyiruko kubaha Uwiteka yabaye iy’ingenzi cyane kuruta mbere hose. Kubera ko turi ababyeyi, abigisha n’abagize umubiri wa Kristo, dufite inshingano yera yo gutegura abari kubyiruka kuzashobora kurwanirira ukwizera bafite ubutwari, kwicisha bugufi no kwizera.
“Siyansi y’ubumenyi nyakuri ni ukuri, kwa kundi kugomba gucengezwa mu bugingo, ku buryo kudashobora gusibanganywa n’ibinyoma biganje ahantu hose.” – Ibihamya by’Itorero, vol 6, p.131.

Ni muri ubwo buryo, Icyiciro cy’Uburezi mu Nteko Nkuru Rusange cyakoranye umwete kugira ngo cyongerere imbaraga kandi cyagure amashuri yacu y’ivugabutumwa ku isi yose. Ibigo byinshi by’amashuri byacu ntibirimo ibikorwa remezo bihagije, gahunda z’amasomo zigezweho, n’ibitabo birimo ukuri kw’iby’umwuka by’abanyeshuri bacu. Byongeye kandi, ibihugu byinshi byasabye ko hashyirwaho ibigo bishya by’amashuri bidateza imbere ubumenyi bwo mu ishuri gusa, ahubwo na none bishyigikira amahame y’ubutumwa bwiza bw’iteka ryose.
Iri turo ridasanzwe rizafasha mu buryo butatu:
1. Kuvugurura imikorere y’Amashuri y’Ivugabutumwa asanzwe ahari;
2. Gushyiraho amashuri mashya mu turere dukeneye kubona uburezi bwa Gikristo bw’Itorero ry’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi Bavugurura;

3. Guteza imbere umushinga wo gusemura ibitabo byifashishwa mu burezi bikozwe n’itsinda ry’abarimu bacu kugira ngo bikoreshwe mu mashuri yigisha iby’isi n’ivugabutumwa mu ndimi zitandukanye no mu mico itandukanye.

“Uburezi nyakuri ni uguhugurirwa kuba umubwirizabutumwa. Buri muhungu n’umukobwa w’Imana ahamagarirwa kuba umubwirizabutumwa. Duhamagarirwa gukorera Imana ndetse na bagenzi bacu; kandi intego y’uburezi bwacu yakagombye iyo kudutegurira kugirango tube dukwiriye gukora uyu murimo.” – Umurimo wo Gukiza, p.395.

Ku bw’ibyo rero, bene data na bashiki bacu dukunda, turabinginga ngo mutange mubikunze kandi mufite intego yo kuba abavugabutumwa. Gushora imari mu burezi bw’abana bacu n’urubyiruko ni ugutegura ahazaza h’itorero, mu kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza, no mu isarura riheruka.
Uwiteka agwize inkunga yanyu kandi akomeze uyu murimo w’ingenzi, kandi amashuri yacu abe koko amatara amurika mu mwijima, ategurira urubyiruko rw’indahemuka kugaruka k’Umukiza wacu kwegereje.

lessons.title: Kwizera no Kwemera
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Nzabaha n’umutima mushya, mbashyiremo umwuka mushya, nzabakuramo umutima ukomeye nk’ibuye, mbashyiremo umutima woroshye.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Nzabaha n’umutima mushya, mbashyiremo umwuka mushya, nzabakuramo umutima ukomeye nk’ibuye, mbashyiremo umutima woroshye.”

keyNote.text: “Ntiwashobora guhongerera ibyaha wakoze mu gihe cyahise; ntiwashobora guhindura umutima wawe no kuwuboneza ngo were. Ahubwo Imana yasezeranye ko izabigukorera byose binyuze muri Kristo.” — Kugana Yesu, p.51.

q.text: a. Ni irihe sezerano ry’Imana ry’agahebuzo ry’imbabazi n’amahoro?

note.text: “Urabona ko imibereho yawe yuzuyemo ibyaha no kwikanyiza. Wifuza cyane kubabarirwa ngo ubonere, ukurwe mu bubata. Ariko se ukwiriye kugenza gute kugirango ubone gushyira hamwe n’Imana, use na Yo?

“Ukeneye kugira amahoro – amahoro y’ijuru, imbabazi mvajuru, n’urukundo mu mutima. Ibyo ntibigurwa amafaranga, ntibiboneshwa no kugira ubwenge, ntabwo wakwiringira kubyishyikiriza wowe ubwawe. Ariko Imana ishaka kubiguhera Ubuntu, “ari nta feza, ari nta biguzi.” Yesaya 55:1. Byaba ibyawe, urambuye ukuboko ukabyakira.” – Kugana Yesu, p.49.

q.text: b. Ni irihe sezerano rindi ry’ingenzi rihindura umuntu wese uko yakabaye agahinduka mushya kuburyo ashyira hamwe n’Imana?

note.text: “Wamaze kwatura ibyaha byawe; umutima wawe urabizinukwa. Wahisemo kwiyegurira Imana. Noneho yisange, uyisabe kubikuhagira, iguhe umutima mushya. Maze wizere ko izabikora kuko yabisezeranye. Icyo nicyo cyigisho Yesu yigishije igihe yari ku isi. Impano Imana yadusezeraniye ko izaduha dukwiriye kwizera ko tuyihawe, kandi ko ari iyacu.” — Ibid., pp. 49,50.

q.text: a. Mbese ni iki Yesu yabwiye ikirema cyo ku kidendezi cy’i Betesida gukora, kandi ni iki twakwigira kuri ubu buhamya?

note.text: “Nimutyo turebe igitekerezo cy’ikirema cy’i Betesida. Iyo mbabare ntiyagiraga shinge na rugero, yari amaze imyaka mirongo itatu n’umunani amugaye. Ariko Yesu aramutegeka ati: ‘Byuka wikorere uburiri bwawe, ugende.’ Uwo murwayi yashoboraga kuvuga ati: ‘Mwami numara kunkiza, ndakora icyo uvuga.’ Ariko siko yabigenje. Yizeye ijambo rya Kristo, yizera ko akijijwe, ashyiramo umuhati agerageza gutambuka, abona arabishoboye. Yashyize mu bikorwa ijambo rya Kristo, maze Imana imuha imbaraga. Yarakijijwe.” – Kugana Yesu, p.50.

“Yesu ntiyigeze amuha ubwishingizi bw’uko Imana iri bumufashe. Uwo muntu byari kumushobokera gushidikanya maze akaba atakaje amahirwe rukumbi yari abonye yo gukira. Ahubwo yizeye ijambo Kristo amubwiye, maze abonera imbaraga mu kurikurikiza.

“Dushobora kwakira gukira mu by’umwuka binyuze mu kwizera nk’uko. Icyaha cyadutandukanyije n’ubugingo bw’Imana. Ubugingo bwacu bwaguye ikinya. Twebwe ubwacu nta bushobozi dufite bwo kubaho imibereho itunganye burengeje ubwo icyo kirema cyari gifite bwo kwigenza. Hariho benshi bazi uburyo batishoboye kandi bifuza imibereho y’iby’umwuka yo gutuma bahuza n’Imana; barushywa n’ubusa bahatanira kuyigeraho. Bataka bihebye bati, “Yemwe, mbonye ishyano! Ni nde wankiza uyu mubiri untera urupfu?” Abaroma 7:24. Bene abo bantu bihebye kandi bari mu ntambara nibararame barebe hejuru. Umukiza yubitse umutwe areba uwo yaguze amaraso Ye akamubwirana ineza n’impuhwe bitarondoreka agira ati, “Mbese urashaka gukira?” Aragutegeka ngo uhaguruke ufite ubuzima buzira umuze n’amahoro.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.203.

q.text: b. Ni iki cyasezeraniwe umunyabyaha binyuze muri Kristo? 2Ngoma 7:14;

note.text: “Ntiwashobora guhongerera ibyaha wakoze mu gihe cyahise; ntiwashobora guhindura umutima wawe no kuwuboneza ngo were. Ariko Imana yasezeranye ko izabigukorera byose binyuze muri Kristo. Wizere iryo sezerano. Wature ibyaha byawe kandi wiyegurire Imana. Niwizera iryo sezerano; ukizera yuko ubabariwe kandi ko wejejwe – Imana izabigusohoreza. Uzasanga wakijijwe koko, nk’uko Kristo yahaye ikirema imbaraga zo kugenda kimaze kwizera. Nawe niko bizamera nta kabuza nubyizera.
“Ntukarindire kwiyumvamo ko wakijijwe, ahubwo uvuge uti: ‘Ndizeye, niko biri, si uko mbyiyumvamo, ahubwo ni ukubera ko Imana ariyo yabisezeranye.’ ” – Kugana Yesu, p.51.

q.text: a. Iyo Yesu yakiriwe nk’Umukiza, bigenda bite ku byaha byo mu gihe cyahise?

note.text: “Yesu yaravuze ati: ‘Ibyo musaba byose mubishyizeho umutima mwizere yuko mubihawe, kandi muzabibona.’ Mariko 11:24. Hariho igisabwa kugirango iryo sezerano risohore – ni ugusaba dukurikije ubushake bw’Imana. Ariko Imana irashaka kutwezaho ibyaha, kugirango itugire abana Bayo, kandi idushoboze kubaho imibereho yera. Kubw’ibyo rero dushobora gusaba iyo migisha kandi tukizera ko tuyihawe, maze tugashimira Imana ko tuyakiriye. Ni ihirwe ryacu gusanga Yesu kugirango atuboneze, tubone guhagarara imbere y’amategeko tudafite ipfunwe cyangwa ikimwaro.” – Kugana Yesu, p.51.

q.text: b. Ni iki gituma umwizera ahagarara imbere y’Imana?

note.text: “Nubwo imibereho ya Gikristo izarangwa no kwicisha bugufi, ntikwiriye kubamo kwitangira itama, cyangwa kwitesha agaciro. Ni amahirwe ya buri wese kubaho mu buryo Imana yemera kandi igaha umugisha. Ntabwo ari ubushake bwa Data wo mu ijuru ko duhora dusa n’abaciriweho iteka kandi tubundikiwe n’umwijima. Nta gihamya cyo kwicisha bugufi nyakuri cyaba kiriho igihe umuntu agenda yubitse umutwe kandi afite umutima wuzuye ibitekerezo by’inarijye. Dukwiriye gusanga Yesu tukezwa, tugahagarara imbere y’amategeko tudafite ipfunwe n’ikimwaro.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.477.

“Iyo twiyeguriye Imana burundu kandi tukizera tumaramaje, amaraso ya Kristo atwezaho ibyaha byose. Umutimanama ushobora kubohorwa ku gucirwaho iteka. Kubwo kwizera amaraso ye, abantu bose bashobora gutunganyirizwa muri Kristo Yesu….. Ntabwo tugomba guhangayikishwa n’ibyo Kristo n’Imana badutekerezaho, ahubwo ibyo Imana itekereza kuri Kristo, Inshungu yacu. Mwemererwa muri Yesu Ukundwa.” – Ubutumwa Bwatoranyijwe, vol 2, p.32,33.

q.text: c. Ni iyihe mpinduka igomba kugirwa n’abantu bose binjiye muri iri sezerano ryo kugirana isano n’Imana?

note.text: “Kandi ntimuri abanyu ngo mwigenge, kuko mwaguzwe igiciro. [1Petero 1:18,19]. Binyuze muri iki gikorwa cyoroheje cyo kwizera Imana, nicyo cyatumye Umwuka Wera ashyira ubugingo bushya mu mutima wawe. Umeze nk’umwana wavukiye mu muryango w’Imana, kandi Imana igukunda nk’uko ikunda Umwana Wayo.” – Kugana Yesu, p.51,52.

q.text: a. Mbese umwizera aba yitezweho kwitwara gute?

note.text: “Noneho ubwo wiyeguriye Yesu, ntugasubire inyuma, ntukongere kumujya kure, ahubwo iminsi yose ujye uvuga uti: “Ndi uwa Kristo, naramwiyeguriye.” Umusabe kuguha Umwuka We, akurindishe ubuntu Bwe. Nk’uko waheshejwe kuba Umwana w’Imana kubwo kuyiyegurira no kuyizera, abe ari nako uba muri Yo. Intumwa Pawulo yaravuze ati: “Nuko rero nk’uko mwakiriye Kristo Yesu Umwami wacu abe ari ko mugendera muri we.” Abakolosayi 2:6.

“Bamwe bibwira ko bakwiriye kubanza kugeragezwa, no kugaragariza Uwiteka yuko bahindutse, ngo babone gushyikira umugisha. Ariko nta cyababuza kuwuhabwa ndetse n’ubu ngubu. Icyakora bakwiriye kugira ubuntu bw’Imana n’Umwuka wa Kristo, kugirango batabarwe mu ntege nke zabo, bitagenze bityo ntibashobora gutsinda ikibi. Yesu akunda ko tumusanga uko turi, turi abanyabyaha, tutagira kivurira, ntacyo twishingikirijeho. Dushobora kumusanga mu ntege nke zacu zose, mu bupfapfa bwacu bwose, n’ibicumuro byacu byose, maze tukikubita imbere y’ibirenge Bye tukihana. Anezezwa no kuduhoberesha amaboko Ye y’urukundo no kudupfuka inguma zacu, no kutwuhagira gukiranirwa kwacu kose.” – Kugana Yesu, p.52.

q.text: b. Mbese amakosa akozwe mu gihe cyo kwiga agenzwa ate?

note.text: “Reka gukeka ko amasezerano y’Imana atari ayawe. Ni ay’umunyabyaha wese wihana. Imbaraga n’ubuntu bibonerwa muri Kristo bihabwa buri muntu wese wizera bizanwe n’abamarayika bakorera abantu. Nta munyabyaha n’umwe nubwo yasayisha ate udashobora kubona imbaraga, ubutungane, no gukiranuka muri Yesu wadupfiriye. Ategereje kubambura imyambaro y’ibizinga yandujwe n’ibyaha, kugirango abambike imyambaro yera yo gukiranuka. Abingingira kubaho kugirango badapfa.” — Ibid., p.52,53.

q.text: c. Sobanura uko dukomerezwa muri uru rugendo.

note.text: “Abagendera mu nzira z’ubwenge bagira ibyishimo bitavugwa nubwo baba bababazwa; kuko uwo bakunda abagenda iruhande batamureba. Ku ntambwe yose batera bazamuka bashobora kumva ikiganza Cye kibakoraho; kuri buri ntambwe batera, umucyo urabagirana w’ikuzo uturuka ku Itabonwa umurika mu nzira bacamo; maze indirimbo zabo zo guhimbaza zikarangururwa, zikazamukira gufatanya n’iz’abamarayika imbere y’intebe y’ubwami.” – Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.140.

dailyLessons.sectionTitle: 5. URUKUNDO RWA DATA WA TWESE RWADUCUNGUYE

q.text: a. Ni ibiki bisabwa kugirango umuntu yemerwe n’Imana?

note.text: “Imana ntitugenza nk’uko twebwe abantu bapfa tugirirana. Ibitekerezo Byayo birangwa n’imbabazi, urukundo, n’ibambe rihebuje.” – Kugana Yesu, p.53.

“Umuntu wese uzacyahwa n’Imana akicisha bugufi mu mutima we afite kwihana no kwatura nk’uko Dawidi yabigenje, akwiriye kumenya adashidikanya ko agifite ibyiringiro. Umuntu wese uzizera akemera amasezerano y’Imana, azababarirwa. Uwiteka ntazigera yirukana umuntu n’umwe wihana by’ukuri” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.726.

q.text: b. Ni iyihe nyifato nyakuri ya Data wa twese wo mu ijuru agirira abantu bose bahabiye kure ye?

note.text: “Satani yiteguye kutunyaga amasezerano meza y’Imana. Yifuza gukuraho buri kambi kose k’ibyiringiro na buri murasire w’umucyo urabagiranira mu mutima; ariko ntukamukundire ko agenza atyo. Ntugategera amatwi kumva umushukanyi avuga, ahubwo ujye uvuga uti: “Yesu yapfiriye kugirango mbone ubugingo, arankunda ntabwo ashaka ko ndimbuka….” Umugani w’umwana w’ikirara utubwira uko yakiriwe: [Luka 15:18 – 20].

“Ariko nubwo uwo mugani uteye imbabazi n’agahinda, ntubasha gushyikira ku gusobanura neza impuhwe za Data wa twese uri mu ijuru. Uwiteka yavugiye mu muhanuzi ati: ‘Ni ukuri nagukunze urukundo ruhoraho, ni cyo cyatumye ngukuruza ineza nkakwiyegereza’ Yeremiya 31:3. Umunyabyaha akiri kure y’urugo rwa Se, agapfusha ubusa umutungo we mu gihugu cya kure, umutima wa Se uramukumbura; urukumbuzi ruza mu mutima rumurehereza kugarukira Imana; nyamara burya Umwuka Wera ni we uba uri kwireherezaho uwo munyabyaha, amuhendahendera kugaruka, iyo mpabe akayegereza umutima wa Se wuje urukundo.” – Kugana Yesu, p.53,54.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni iki cyinjira mu mutima w’uwababariwe ibyaha?
2. Ni ukubera iki ikirema cy’i Betesida cyahise gishobora kugenda ako kanya?
3. Igihe twakiriye Kristo nk’Umukiza wacu bwite, ni irihe sezerano rihita riba iryacu?
4. Ni irihe banga ryo kugendana na Kristo kutugeza ku nsinzi?
5. Sobanura itandukaniro riri hagati y’igomwa rya Satani n’urukundo rwa Data wa twese rwaducunguye.

lessons.title: Igipimo cy’Ubuyoboke
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Umuntu wese iyo ari muri Kristo aba ari icyaremwe gishya, ibya kera biba bishize. Dore byose biba bihindutse bishya.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Umuntu wese iyo ari muri Kristo aba ari icyaremwe gishya, ibya kera biba bishize. Dore byose biba bihindutse bishya.”

keyNote.text: “Imico ntigaragazwa n’imirimo myiza cyangwa mibi dukora rimwe na rimwe, ahubwo igaragazwa n’amagambo twamenyereye kuvuga n’ibikorwa twamenyereye gukora.” — Kugana Yesu, p.57,58.

q.text: a. Ni ikihe cyigisho Kristo yigishije mu gusobanura umurimo wo guhinduka?

note.text: “Umuntu abasha kudasobanura neza igihe n’aho byabereye, cyangwa ngo arondore uko byagenze mu guhinduka kwe; ariko ibi ntibivuze ko atahindutse….. Nubwo umuyaga utagaragara, ariko ubyara ibikorwa bigaragara kandi byumvikana. Ni ko umurimo w’Umwuka w’Imana umera ku mutima w’umuntu. Niwo mbaraga ihembura itabonwa n’ijisho ry’umuntu, ibyara ubugingo bushya mu mutima w’umuntu; ikarema umuntu bundi bushya mu ishusho y’Imana.” — Kugana Yesu, p.57.

q.text: b. Ni izihe mpinduka zizaboneka mu mibereho y’umuntu wihannye by’ukuri?

note.text: “Nubwo tudashobora kugira icyo dukora twebwe ubwacu kugirango duhindure imitima yacu cyangwa kwiyuzuza n’Imana; nubwo tudakwiriye kwiyiringira cyangwa gutega amakiriro ku mirimo yacu myiza, imibereho yacu izagaragaza niba ubuntu bw’Imana buri muri twe. Impinduka zizagaragarira mu mico, mu ngeso twamenyereye, no mu bidushishikaza. Guhabana kwabyo kuzagaragara rwose, tumenye uko byari biri mbere n’uko biri ubu…..

“Ni iby’ukuri ko hari ubwo twagira ingeso nziza zigaragarira amaso, zitazanywe n’imbaraga ihindura ya Kristo. Gukunda icyubahiro no gushaka kuratwa n’abandi, haba ubwo bibasha gutuma tugira ukubaho kuboneye. Kwiyubaha kwashobora gutuma umuntu yigengesera ngo adasa n’ukora ibibi. Haba n’ubwo umutima wikanyiza ukora ibikorwa by’ubugiraneza. None se ubwo bigenze bityo twabwirwa n’iki uruhande turimo?
“Umutima wacu ufitwe na nde? Ibitekerezo byacu byo se bifitwe na nde?” — Ibid., p.57,58.

q.text: a. Mbese abantu buzuye Umwuka ni izihe mbuto bera?

note.text: “Abahinduka ibyaremwe bishya muri Kristo Yesu bazera imbuto z’Umwuka…. Iyo bangaga kera noneho babikunde, kandi ibyo bakundaga kera noneho abe aribyo banga. Uwirariraga akishyira imbere, noneho azaba umugwaneza wicisha bugufi mu mutima. Umupfapfa n’umunyagasuzuguro bahinduka abantu bitonda bacisha make. Abasinzi bahinduka abirinda ibisindisha, inzererezi zihinduka abantu baboneye. Imigenzo y’imburamumaro n’akamenyero k’ab’isi birekwe. Abakristo ntibazongera gushaka ‘Umurimbo w’inyuma, uwo kuboha umusatsi cyangwa uwo kwambara izahabu cyangwa uwo gukānisha imyenda, ahubwo bazashaka uw’imbere uhishwe mu mutima, umurimbo utangirika w’umwuka ufite ubugwaneza n’amahoro.’ 1Petero 3:3,4.” — Kugana Yesu, p.58,59.

“Imbaraga ihindura y’Umwuka Wera niyo bugingo bwa Kristo mu mutima w’umuntu. Ntitwabona Kristo nta nubwo twavugana na We, keretse Umwuka We Wera uba uri iruhande rwacu ubera hose icyarimwe. Akorera muri buri wese wakira Kristo. Abantu batuwemo n’Umwuka bagaragaza imbuto z’Umwuka arizo: urukundo, ibyishimo, amahoro, kwihangana, kugira neza, ingeso nziza, no gukiranuka.” — Ellen G. White, Ubusobanuro bwa Bibiliya bw’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi, vol. 6, p.1112.

q.text: b. Ni iki kigaragaza kwihana nyakuri?

note.text: “Nta gihamya cy’uko umuntu yihannye by’ukuri keretse gusa iyo bimuteye guhinduka. Kwihana nyakuri gutera umuntu gutanga icyo yarahiriye, akagarura ibyo yibye, akihana ibyaha bye, agakunda Imana na bagenzi be, icyo gihe nibwo umunyabyaha aba avuye mu rupfu ageze mu bugingo.

“Iyo twebwe abayobye, b’inkozi z’ibibi dusanze Kristo, tukemera ubuntu Bwe bukiza, urukundo rutangira gushora imizi mu mitima yacu. Buri mutwaro wose uroroha, kuko umutwaro Kristo adukorera woroshye. Tunezezwa n’inshingano yacu ndetse tugashimishwa no kugira ibyo twigomwa. Inzira yahoze isa n’igoswe n’umwijima ihindurwa umucyo na Zuba ryo Gukiranuka.

“Imico y’igikundiro ya Kristo izagaragarira no mu bayoboke Be. Yanezezwaga no gukora ibyo Imana ishaka. Imbaraga yayoboraga imibereho y’Umukiza wacu yari urukundo yakundaga Imana, n’ishyaka yagiraga ryo kuyihesha icyubahiro. Urukundo nirwo rwatumaga ibyo yakoraga byose bibonera. Urukundo rukomoka ku Mana. Urukundo ntirushobora kuboneka mu mutima utariyeguriye Imana. Ruboneka mu mutima utuwemo na Yesu gusa. ‘Turayikunda, kuko ariyo yabanje kudukunda.’ 1Yohana 4:19. Iyo umutima uhinduwe mushya n’ubuntu bw’Imana, urukundo nirwo ruba ihame rigenga ibikorwa. Ruhindura ingeso, rutegeka amarangamutima, rukagenga ibyo umuntu ararikira, rucubya urwango, ahubwo rukaboneza ibyiyumvo. Urwo rukundo iyo ruhawe umwanya mu mutima, rugusha neza imibereho y’umuntu kandi rugatuma agira icyitegererezo kinogeye abamuzengurutse bose.” — Kugana Yesu, p.59.

q.text: a. Ni ubuhe buyobe kirimbuzi bukorwa na benshi mu bavuga ko ari Abakristo?

note.text: “Hariho ubuyobe bubiri abana b’Imana bakwiriye kwirinda – cyane cyane abatangiye vuba kwiringira ubuntu Bwayo. Ubuyobe bumwe bwamaze kuvugwa; ni ukwiringira imirimo yabo bwite, bakiringira ko hari icyo bashobora kwikorera cyatuma bashyira hamwe n’Imana. Umuntu ugerageza kugera ku kwera kubw’imirimo ye akora yo gukomeza amategeko, ari kugerageza ibidashoboka. Icyo umuntu yakora cyose adafite Kristo cyakwanduzwa no kwikanyiza n’ibyaha. Ubuntu bwa Kristo gusa nibwo bushobora kutuboneza binyuze mu kwizera.
