“Ubuyobe bwa kabiri ntaho buhuriye n’ubwo. Ni ukwibwira ko iyo umuntu yizeye Kristo bimukuraho gukomeza amategeko y’Imana; ngo kwizera konyine niko gutuma duhabwa ubuntu bwa Kristo, naho imirimo yacu ntacyo yatumarira mu gucungurwa kwacu.” — Kugana Yesu, p.59,60.

q.text: b. Ni gute isezerano rishya rihamya ko ubuntu bwa Kristo butaduha uburenganzira bwo kureka kumvira amategeko y’Imana?

note.text: “Amategeko y’Imana agaragaza kamere Yayo; niyo shingiro ry’ihame rikomeye ry’urukundo, nicyo gituma ariyo rufatiro rw’ingoma Yayo mu ijuru no mu isi. Iyo imitima yacu ivugururiwe kugira ishusho y’Imana, kandi iyo urukundo Rwayo rwashoye imizi mu mitima yacu, none se twabuzwa n’iki gusohoreza amategeko y’Imana mu mibereho? Iyo ihame ry’urukundo rimaze gushora imizi mu mutima, iyo umuntu amaze guhinduka mushya akagira ishusho y’Iyamuremye, nibwo ibyasezeranywe by’isezerano rishya bisohora [Abaheburayo 10:16]. Mbese amategeko abaye yanditswe mu mutima, yabuzwa n’iki guhindura ubugingo? Kumvira – ari ko gusohoza umurimo w’urukundo; ni ikimenyetso cy’ukuri cy’ubuyoboke.” — Kugana Yesu, p.60.

“Muri iki gihe Imana idusaba icyo yasabaga Adamu na Eva muri Edeni, aricyo: kumvira gutunganye ibyo ishaka. Amategeko Yayo ntahinduka mu bihe byose. Urugero ruhanitse rwo gukiranuka rwagaragajwe mu Isezerano rya Kera, ntabwo ruri munsi y’urwo mu Isezerano Rishya. Umurimo w’ubutumwa bwiza si uwo gupfobya ibivugwa n’amategeko yera y’Imana, ahubwo ni uwo gushyira abantu aho bashobora kubahiriza ibyo avuga.

“Ntabwo benshi berekana kwizera Kristo kubasha gukiza imitima. Baravuga bati: “Mwizere, mwizere gusa Kristo, murakizwa. Nicyo kintu mugomba gukora. Nyamara kwizera nyakuri kwiringira byimazeyo ko Kristo ariwe utanga agakiza, niko kuzerekeza umuntu ku kumvira amategeko y’Imana mu buryo buboneye.” – Ellen G. White, Ubusobanuro bwa Bibiliya, vol 6, p.1073.

q.text: a. Ni iki cyitezwe ku baragwa b’ubugingo buhoraho?

note.text: “Iyo wiyeguriye [Kristo] kandi ukamwakira nk’Umukiza wawe, azaguhindura umukiranutsi nubwo waba waragize imibereho yuzuyemo ibyaha byinshi. Imico ya Kristo ibarwa mu kigwi cy’imico yawe, noneho Imana ikakwemera nk’aho utigeze ukora icyaha.

“Ikirutaho kandi ni uko Kristo ahindura umutima. Aba mu mutima wawe kubwo kwizera. Ukwiriye guhora ugirana umushyikirano na Kristo kubwo kwizera, no kujya umwegurira umutima wawe iminsi yose, kandi nugenza utyo azajya agutera gukora ibihuye n’ubushake Bwe. Nibwo uzabasha kuvuga uti: ‘Ibyo nkora byose nkiriho mu mubiri, mbikoreshwa no kwizera Umwana w’Imana wankunze akanyitangira.’ Abagalatiya 2:20.Yesu yabwiye abigishwa Be ati: ‘Kuko atari mwe muzaba muvuga, ahubwo ari Umwuka wa So uzabavugisha.’ Matayo 10:20. None uko Kristo azajya akorera muri wowe, uzagaragaza umwuka nk’uwe kandi ukore imirimo myiza nk’iye – ariyo mirimo yo gukiranuka no kumvira.

“Ubwo rero ntacyo dufite muri twe twakwiratana. Nta mpamvu dufite yo kwishyira hejuru. Icyo dufite gusa cyo kwiringirwa ni ugukiranuka kwa Kristo tubarwaho, ndetse n’uko duhabwa n’Umwuka We udukoreramo.” – Kugana Yesu, p.62,63.

q.text: b. Nubwo Uwiteka yahaye abantu bose amahirwe yo kubona agakiza, ni ukubera iki bamwe bayoba inzira?

note.text: “Kwizera, ukwizera gusa niko kutugira abasangiye ubuntu bwa Kristo, kukadushoboza kumvira aho kugirango kubuze umuntu kumvira….

“Kwizera Kristo by’urumamo gusa gukura abantu ku kumvira Imana, si ukwizera ahubwo ni ukwishuka. ‘Mwakijijwe n’ubuntu kubwo kwizera’ kandi ‘kwizera kutagira imirimo kuba gupfuye.’ Abefeso 2:8; Yakobo 2:17. Yesu ataraza mu isi yarivugiye ati: ‘Mana yanjye nishimira gukora ibyo ukunda, ni koko amategeko yawe ari mu mutima wanjye.’ Zaburi 40:8. Kandi agiye gusubira mu ijuru yaravuze ati: ‘Nitondeye amategeko ya Data nguma mu rukundo rwe.’ Yohana 15:10. Ibyanditswe biravuga biti: ‘Iki ni cyo kitumenyesha yuko tumuzi, ni uko twitondera amategeko ye…. kuko uvuga ko ahora muri we akwiriye na we kugenda nk’uko yagendaga.’ 1Yohana 2:3 – 6. ‘Kandi ibyo nibyo mwahamagariwe, kuko na Kristo yabababarijwe akabasigira icyitegererezo, kugira ngo mugere ikirenge mu cye.’ 1Petero 2:21.” — Ibid., p.60 – 62.

q.text: a. Ni gute Pawulo yabayeho imibereho irangwaho no kunesha?

note.text: “Ukwiriye guhora ugirana umushyikirano na Kristo kubwo kwizera, kujya umwegurira ubushake bwawe iminsi yose; kandi nugenza utyo azajya agutera gukora ibihuye n’ubushake bwe n’ibimunezeza.” – Kugana Yesu, p.62,63.

“Mu bumuntu Bwe, Kristo yari afite imico itunganye, kandi yiyemeje kuyiduha. “Ibyo twakiranutse byose bimeze nk’ubushwambagara.” (Yesaya 64:6). Ikintu cyose dushobora gukora ubwacu cyandujwe n’icyaha. Ariko umwana w’Imana “yerekaniwe gukuraho ibyaha byacu, kandi nta cyaha kimurimo.” ….. Kristo yumviraga ikintu cyose amategeko asaba. Ubwe yarivugiye ati: “Mana yanjye, nishimira gukora ibyo ukunda, amategeko yawe ari mu mutima wanjye.” Zaburi 40:8…. Kumvira Kwe kutagira amakemwa kwatumye bishobokera buri muntu wese kumvira amategeko y’Imana. Iyo twiyeguriye Kristo, umutima womatana n’uwe, ibyo dushaka bihuzwa n’ibyo ashaka, ubwenge bukaba bumwe n’ubwe, agafata mpiri ibyo dutekereza; bityo tukagira imibereho nk’iye. Uko niko kwambara umwambaro wo gukiranuka Kwe.” – Imigani ya Kristo, p.311,312.

q.text: b. Mbese Umunyezaburi yerekanye ko anezezwa n’iki mu buzima bwe?

note.text: “Igihe tuganiriye ibyo kwizera, hariho itandukaniro dukwiriye kuzirikana mu ntekerezo. Habaho kwizera kutagira aho guhuriye n’ukwizera nyakuri. Kwizera ko Imana ibaho kandi ko ifite imbaraga, no kwizera ko ijambo Ryayo ari ukuri, ntawe ubihakana ndetse na Satani n’ingabo ze ntibashobora kubihakana. Bibiliya ivuga ko ‘abadayimoni na bo babyizera bagahinda imishyitsi.’ Yakobo 2:19. Ariko ibyo si ukwizera nyakuri. Ahubwo kwizera nyakuri ni ukwizera ijambo ry’Imana, kwegurira Imana ubushake bwawe, ukayerekezaho umutima wawe, kandi ukayikunda. Ukwizera nyakuri gukorera mu rukundo kandi kukeza ubugingo. Kwizera nk’uko niko guhindura umutima mushya, ukagira ishusho y’Imana.” – Kugana Yesu, p.63.

reviewQuestions: 1. Sobanura igihamya cyerekana ko umuntu yahindutse.
2. Ni irihe tandukaniro riri hagati y’umuntu wa kera n’umuntu mushya?
3. Sobanura ubuyobe bubiri bugomba kwirindwa mu mibereho yacu y’iby’umwuka?
4. Igihe tubeshejweho n’ubuntu, mbese kumvira kugira uwuhe mwanya?
5. Ni ibihe bitekerezo, ibyifuzo, n’imigambi bihabwa umwanya igihe Kristo atuye mu mutima?

lessons.title: Gukurira muri Kristo
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Yantumye no gushyiriraho itegeko ab’i Siyoni barira, ryo kubaha ikamba mu cyimbo cy’ivu, n’amavuta yo kunezerwa mu cyimbo cy’ubwirabure, n’umwambaro w’ibyishimo mu cyimbo cy’umutima wihebye, kugira ngo bahereko bitwe ibiti byo gukiranuka byatewe n’Uwiteka ngo bimuheshe icyubahiro.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Yantumye no gushyiriraho itegeko ab’i Siyoni barira, ryo kubaha ikamba mu cyimbo cy’ivu, n’amavuta yo kunezerwa mu cyimbo cy’ubwirabure, n’umwambaro w’ibyishimo mu cyimbo cy’umutima wihebye, kugira ngo bahereko bitwe ibiti byo gukiranuka byatewe n’Uwiteka ngo bimuheshe icyubahiro.”

keyNote.text: “Nk’uko ishami ryishingikiriza ku giti kugirango rikure kandi ryere imbuto, niko namwe mugomba kwishingikiriza kuri Kristo kugirango mubeho imibereho yera.” — Kugana Yesu, p.69.

q.text: a. Ni gute Ibyanditswe bisobanura imikurire ya Gikristo?

note.text: “Nubwo umuntu yagira ubwenge bwahe n’ubuhanga, ntiyabasha kurema akantu na kanzinya gafite ubugingo. Ubugingo Imana yatanze nibwo bwonyine buha ikimera cyangwa inyamaswa kubaho. Uko ni nako rero ubugingo bukomoka ku Mana bubyarira mu mitima y’abantu ubuzima bw’iby’umwuka.” – Kugana Yesu, p.67.

q.text: b. Ni iki gisobanura uburyo twishingikiriza kuri Kristo kugirango dukure kandi tugere ku iterambere?

note.text: “Kubw’impano itagira akagero y’Umwana Wayo, Imana yazengurukije isi imbabazi nk’uko izengurutswe n’umwuka. Abantu bose bahitamo guhumeka uwo mwuka utanga ubugingo bazabaho kandi bakurire gushyikira igihagararo cy’abagabo n’abagore muri Kristo Yesu.

“Nk’uko ururabo rwerekera izuba, kugirango imirasire yaryo irufashe kuba rwiza no gutungana, niko dukwiriye kwerekera Zuba ryo Gukiranuka kugirango umucyo wo mu ijuru utumurikire, bityo imico yacu ishobore gukurira mu gusa na Kristo.” — Ibid., p.68.

q.text: a. Ni iyihe ngingo y’ingenzi Umwami wacu yashishikarije abigishwa Be mbere yuko asoza umurimo We wo ku isi?

note.text: “Benshi bibwira ko hari uruhare runaka bakwiriye kwikorera ubwabo. Bari biringiye Kristo kugirango bababarirwe ibyaha, ariko bagakubitiraho kugerageza ubwabo gushyiraho imihati yo kubaho imibereho iboneye. Nyamara buri muntu wese ugenza utyo ntiyabura kunanirwa. Yesu aravuga ati: ‘Ntacyo mubasha gukora mutamfite.’ Ibyacu byose: ari ugukurira mu buntu, cyangwa umunezero wacu, cyangwa akamaro kacu, byose uko bingana tubikesha kubana na Kristo. Igituma dukurira mu buntu ni ugusabana na Yesu buri munsi na buri saha, no kuguma muri We. Ni we Banze ryo kwizera kwacu kandi ni we ugusohoza rwose. Kristo ni we Tangiriro kandi ni we Herezo, ni we uhoraho iteka. Akwiriye kubana natwe atari mu itangira ry’urugendo gusa, cyangwa mu iherezo ryarwo gusa, ahubwo tumukeneye kuri buri ntambwe yose.” — Kugana Yesu, p.69.

“Niba ushaka kwigira mu ishuri rya Kristo ubugwaneza no kwiyoroshya mu mutima, nta kabuza azaguha uburuhukiro n’amahoro. Ni urugamba ruteye ubwoba kureka ubushake bwawe n’imigirire yawe bwite. Ariko niwiga iki cyigisho uzabona uburuhukiro n’amahoro. Ubwibone, kwikanyiza, no kurarikira, bigomba gutsindwa; ubushake bwawe bukazimirira mu bushake bwa Kristo. Imibereho yose uko yakabaye ikwiriye kurangwa n’ubwitange bukoranywe urukundo, buri gikorwa kigakoranwa urukundo, buri kiganiro kikarangwamo urukundo. Nk’uko umuzabibu ukenera icyo wuriraho, ukishingikiriza ku giti uhereye hasi ukageza hejuru, niko ubuntu n’urukundo bya Kristo bigurumanira mu mutima, bikawusabamo, bikohereza imbaraga yabyo ibeshaho muri buri rugingo rw’umubiri, kandi bigakoresha umubiri n’intekerezo.” – Ellen G. White, Ubusobanuro bwa Bibiliya bw’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi, vol. 5, pp. 1091,1092.

q.text: b. Ni irihe banga riri mu gukurira muri Kristo?

note.text: “Mwiyegurire Imana mube Abayo rwose, kugirango muyikorere kandi muyumvire, kuko Kristo mwamugize Umukiza wanyu. Mwebwe ubwanyu ntimwashobora guhongerera ibyaha byanyu cyangwa guhindura imitima yanyu; ariko noneho ubwo mwiyeguriye Imana, mwizera yuko yabibakoreye kubwa Yesu Kristo. Kwizera niko kwabahesheje kuba abantu ba Kristo, kandi kwizera niko gutuma mukurira muri We. Mukwiriye gutanga byose – aribyo mutima wanyu, ubwenge bwanyu, n’ubushake bwanyu; mukitangira kuyumvira mu byo ibasaba byose, maze kandi mukwiriye no kwakira Kristo, Nyir’imigisha yose, ngo agume mu mitima yanyu, abe imbaraga zanyu, abe no gukiranuka kwanyu, n’umufasha wanyu iteka, kugirango abahe imbaraga yo kumwumvira.” – Kugana Yesu, p.69,70.

q.text: a. Ni iyihe nshingano y’ibanze abana b’Imana bafite buri uko batangiye umunsi?

note.text: “Mujye mwiyegurira Imana uko bukeye; abe aribyo mugira nyambere buri gitondo mutaragira ikintu mukora. Mujye musenga muti: ‘Mwami, nyakira ungire uwawe rwose. Imigambi yanjye yose nyirambitse ku birenge byawe. Unkoreshe umurimo wawe uyu munsi. Ungumane, kandi imirimo yanjye yose nyikorane nawe.’ Uko niko mukwiriye kugenza uko bukeye. Buri gitondo mujye mwiyegurira Imana kubw’uwo munsi. Muyegurire imigambi yanyu yose, muyishyire imbere yayo kugirango abe ariyo iyisohoza cyangwa se wenda iyireke. Ni muri ubwo buryo mushobora gushyira imibereho yanyu mu biganza by’Imana buri munsi, bityo imibereho yanyu igasa n’imibereho ya Kristo.” – Kugana Yesu, p.70.

q.text: b. Ni irihe rarika Kristo atanga buri munsi?

note.text: “Kuba muri Kristo bihesha umuntu kugira imibereho y’ihumure. Ahari nta binezaneza by’ibyiyumvo bishobora kuharangwa, ariko haba ibyiringiro birangwamo amahoro atagira impinduka. Ibyiringiro byanyu ntibiri muri mwebwe ubwanyu, ahubwo biri muri Kristo. Mureke intege nke zanyu zifatanye n’imbaraga Ze, ubujiji bwanyu bufatanye n’ubwenge Bwe, ugucogora kwanyu gufatanye n’ukwihangana Kwe. Nicyo gituma mudakwiriye kwihangaho amaso, intekerezo zanyu ntizikwiriye kwerekeza kuri mwebwe ubwanyu, ahubwo muhange amaso Kristo. Mujye muhora mutekereza ku rukundo Rwe, ubwiza Bwe, ubutungane Bwe, n’imico Ye. Imitima yanyu ikomeze kuzirikana uburyo Kristo yigomwe, uko yicishije bugufi, ubutungane Bwe no kwera Kwe, ndetse n’urukundo Rwe rutagira akagero. Kumukunda, kumwigiraho, kumutegaho amakiriro, nibyo bikwiriye kuduhindurira gusa na We.” — Ibid., p.70,71.

q.text: c. Ni iki gituma umuntu agira amahoro yo mu mutima?

note.text: “Abantu bategera Kristo ku magambo yivugiye ubwe, bakamwegurira ubugingo bwabo ngo abe ari we uburinda kandi imibereho yabo bakayegurira kumvira amabwiriza Ye, bazagira amahoro n’ituze. Nta kintu na kimwe cyo ku isi gishobora kubababaza igihe we abanezeresheje kubana na bo. Mu kumwemera by’ukuri harimo uburuhukiro bushyitse…. Ubuzima bwacu bushobora kumera nk’ubugoswe n’inzitane y’ibibazo, nyamara nitwiyegurira byimazeyo Umutware w’abakozi bose, imibereho yacu azayihinduramo imibereho y’icyitegererezo n’imico yo kumuhesha icyubahiro.

“Iyo twinjiye mu buruhukiro binyuze muri Kristo, ubwo ijuru tuba turitangiriye hano ku isi. Twitaba irarika Rye riturarikira kumusanga ngo tumwigireho maze mu kumusanga tukaba dutangiye ubugingo buhoraho.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.331.

q.text: a. Ni uwuhe musaruro uturuka mu kureka intekerezo zikaguma kuri Yesu mu cyimbo cyo kuziyerekezaho twebwe ubwacu?

note.text: “Nidukomeza kurebesha Kristo amaso yo kwizera, tuzarushaho gukomezwa. Imana izereka ibikomeye abantu Bayo bafite inzara n’inyota. Bazabona neza ko Kristo ari Umukiza wabo. Uko bakomeza kugaburirwa n’ijambo Rye, barushaho kubona ko ritanga umwuka n’ubugingo. Ijambo Rye risenya iby’isi n’ibya kamere yayo, maze rigatanga ubugingo bushya muri Kristo Yesu. Umwuka Wera aza mu mutima ari Umuhumuriza. Binyuze mu mbaraga ihindura y’ubuntu Bwe, ishusho y’Imana yigaragariza mu bayoboke Bayo; maze bagahinduka ibyaremwe bishya. Ahari urwango hajya urukundo, maze umutima ukakira ubwiza bw’ijuru.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.391.

“Iyo umutima witekerejeho ubwawo, uva kuri Kristo, kandi ariwe soko y’imbaraga n’ubugingo. Nicyo gituma Satani adahwema kugerageza guhuza ibitekerezo byacu kugirango abikure ku Mukiza bityo atubuze gushyikirana na Kristo no gusabana na We. Ibinezeza by’isi, kwiganyira iby’ubu bugingo, guhangayika n’ishavu, ibicumuro by’abandi n’ibicumuro byanyu, ibyo nibyo Satani azajya agerageza gukoresha kugirango yigarurire imitima yanyu. Ntimukayobywe n’amayeri ye. Hariho benshi batari indyarya, bifuza kubana n’Imana, bene abo Satani ahora ashaka uburyo yaberekeza ku gutekereza ku makosa yabo n’intege nke zabo, yiringiye ko nabasha kubatandukanya na Kristo atazabura kugera ku nsinzi. Ntidukwiriye gutwarwa n’inarijye n’ubwoba, kuko bidutera gushidikanya ko tutazakizwa. Ibyo byose bikura imitima yacu kuri Soko y’imbaraga zacu. Umutima wawe uwugumishe ku Mana kandi uyiringire. Mujye muganira Yesu kandi abe ariwe mutekereza. Ibye abe aribyo bibatwara umutima.” – Kugana Yesu, p.71,72.

q.text: b. Ni iki twakwigira ku mpinduka yabaye ku bigishwa nyuma yo kubana na Kristo mu murimo w’ivugabutumwa wa buri munsi?

note.text: “Kandi iyo tugumye kwitegereza [Yesu], ‘duhindurirwa gusa na We, tugabahwa ubwiza buruta ubundi kuba bwiza nk’ubw’Umwami w’Umwuka.’ 2Abakorinto 3:18.

“Uko niko abigishwa ba mbere bahawe gusa n’Umukiza bakundaga cyane. Abo bigishwa bamaze kumva amagambo ya Yesu, basobanukiwe uko bamukeneye. Baramushatse, baramubona, maze baramukurikira. Bahoranaga na We mu nzu, bagasangira, babaga bari kumwe na We ahiherereye no mu gasozi [ari kumwe n’abantu benshi]. Babanaga na We nk’uko abanyeshuri babana n’umwarimu wabo, bakakira ibyigisho bivuga ukuri kwera byaturukaga mu kanwa Ke buri munsi. Bamuhangaga amaso nk’uko abagaragu bayahoza kuri shebuja, bakamwigiraho icyo bakwiriye gukora. Abo bigishwa ‘bari abantu bameze nka twe’ Yakobo 5:17. Bahoraga ku rugamba barwanya icyaha. Bari bakeneye kugirirwa ubuntu nk’uko natwe tubikeneye, kugirango bagire imibereho yera.” — Ibid., p.72,73.

q.text: a. Ni irihe sezerano ry’agahebuzo Yesu yasigiye abayoboke Be bari guhangana n’ibizazane by’ab’isi b’abanyamahane?

note.text: “Igihe Yesu yajyaga mu ijuru, abayoboke Be basigaye bameze nk’aho ari kumwe na bo. Bari basigaranye ingeso Ze zuzuye umucyo n’urukundo. Yesu, wa Mukiza wahoraga agendana na bo bakaganira, bagasengana, wari warabahumurije, akabakomeza imitima, mu gihe ubutumwa bw’amahoro bwari bukiri ku minwa Ye, yari agiye kubakurwamo ngo ajyanwe mu ijuru, ubwo abamarayika bamwakiraga yaravuze ati: ‘Dore ndi kumwe namwe iminsi yose kugeza ku mperuka y’isi.’ Matayo 28:20.” – Kugana Yesu, p.73,74.

q.text: b. Ni iyihe mpuguro y’ingirakamaro Yesu yasigiye abigishwa Be kugirango bamenye icyo gukora mu gihe bari kuba bamukeneye?

note.text: “Ubwo bari bateraniye hamwe Yesu amaze kuzamurwa mu ijuru, bari bafite umwete wo gusaba Data wa twese mu izina Rye….. Ukuboko kwabo ko kwizera bagutungaga ku ijuru bagira bati: ‘Kristo Yesu ni we wadupfiriye, ikirutaho yarazutse, ari iburyo bw’Imana aradusabira.’ Abaroma 8:34. Kandi Pantekote yabazaniye Umufasha, uwo Yesu yari yaravuzeho ati: ‘Azabana namwe.’ Na none kandi yaravuze ati: ‘Ikizagira icyo kibamarira ari uko ngenda, kuko nintagenda Umufasha atazaza aho muri, ariko ningenda nzamuboherereza.’ Yohana 14:17; 16:7. Uhereye ubwo Kristo yari agiye kugumya kuba mu mitima y’abana Be mu buryo bw’Umwuka Wera. Uko bari bameze igihe babanaga n’Umwuka Wera, byarushaga uko bari bameze igihe babanaga na Yesu. Umucyo n’urukundo n’imbaraga bya Kristo byarabagiraniraga muri bo, ndetse byatumaga abantu batangara ‘bakibuka ko babanye na Yesu.’ Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa 4:13.” — Ibid., p.74,75.

reviewQuestions: 1. Niba dukura nk’uko igihingwa gikura, ni ukubera iki dukeneye ubufasha buturutse mu ijuru?
2. Nk’uko ibimera bikenera imvura kugirango bikure, twebwe se dukeneye iki kugirango dukurire mu Mwuka?
3. Ni iki gituma kwiyegurira Imana buri munsi biba ingirakamaro kuri twe buri muntu ku giti cye?
4. Ni ukubera iki Imana idusaba kwiyambura inarijye ahubwo tugahora dutekereza kuri Yesu?
5. Ni irihe sezerano rigomba kuba impamo mu mibereho ya buri munsi ya buri mwizera?

lessons.title: Imirimo n’Ubugingo
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Icyakora abamwemeye bose bakizera izina rye, yabahaye ubushobozi bwo kuba abana b’Imana.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Icyakora abamwemeye bose bakizera izina rye, yabahaye ubushobozi bwo kuba abana b’Imana.”

keyNote.text: “Umwuka wa Kristo w’urukundo rwitangira abandi, niwo mwuka uranga ab’ijuru kandi uwo niwo munezero wabo. Uwo niwo mwuka abayoboke ba Kristo bazagira, niwo murimo bazakora.” — Kugana Yesu, p.77.

q.text: a. Ni iki kitamenywa n’umutima wa kamere, kandi se ingaruka iba iyihe?

note.text: “Imana niyo sōko y’ubugingo n’umucyo n’umunezero by’ibyaremwe byose. Umugisha uturuka kuri Yo ugera kubyo yaremye byose nk’uko amazi adudubiza ava mu isōko, cyangwa nk’uko imirasire y’umucyo ituruka ku zuba. Kandi iyo ubugingo bw’Imana buri mu mitima y’abantu, akabwo ntikiburira, bubabera amendeze yo gukunda abandi no kubahesha umugisha.” – Kugana Yesu, p.77.

q.text: b. Igihe urukundo rwa Kristo ruhawe umwanya mu mutima, mbese ni iki kizagaragarira mu mibereho?

note.text: “Iyo urukundo rwa Kristo rwagize umwanya mu mutima w’umuntu, nta wabasha kuruhisha, ni nk’uko umuntu wisīze umubavu atabasha kuwuzimanganya ngo abandi batabimenya. Imbaraga yarwo yera ihindura izagera no ku bandi bantu bose azahura na bo. Urukundo rwa Kristo iyo ruri mu mutima w’umuntu, rumera nk’isōko y’amazi idudubiriza mu butayu igahembura ibiyizengurutse byose. Urwo rukundo nirwo rukiza abagiye kurimbuka, rukabatera gushaka kunywa amazi y’ubugingo.” — Ibid., p.77.

“Nimureke ab’isi babone ko tudahugiye mu byo twishakiye, ahubwo ko dushaka yuko abandi na bo babona ku migisha n’amahirwe twabonye. Nimureke babone ko idini ryacu ritatugira abadafite impuhwe cyangwa abahutiraho. Nimureke abantu bose bavuga ko babonye Kristo, bakore nk’uko yakoraga kugirango babere abandi ingirakamaro.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.152.

q.text: a. Iyo twakiriye Yesu nk’Umukiza wacu, ni ubuhe bukene atumara?

note.text: “Abasangiye ubuntu bwa Kristo baba biteguye kugira ubwitange ubwo aribwo bwose, kugirango abandi bantu Kristo yapfiriye bashobore kugezwaho impano y’ijuru. Bazakora ibyo bashoboye byose kugirango isi batuyemo irusheho kuba nziza. Uyu mwuka niwo uranga umutima wahindutse by’ukuri. Umuntu ucyiyegurira Kristo, uwo mwanya yumva ashaka kumenyesha abandi iyo nshuti ye ihebuje izindi zose. Ntabona uko ahisha mu mutima we uko kuri gukiza kandi kweza. Turamutse twambaye gukiranuka kwa Kristo, tukuzuzwa umunezero n’amahoro by’Umwuka Wera utubamo, ntibyadushobokera ko duceceka. Niba twarasogongeye kandi tukabona ko Uwiteka agira neza, nibwo tugira icyo tubwira abandi. Nk’uko byagendekeye Filipo ubwo yabonaga Umukiza, niko natwe tuzararikira abandi gusanga Yesu.” – Kugana Yesu, p.78.

q.text: b. Igihe tugoswe n’ibibazo n’ibirushya, ni iyihe nama duhabwa n’intumwa Pawulo?

note.text: “Yesu azi ibyo abana Be bakeneye, kandi akunda kumva amasengesho yabo. Nimureke abana bagendere kure iby’isi ndetse n’ikintu cyose gishobora gukurura intekerezo zabo kikaziteshura ku Mana. Mureke kandi bajye bumva ko bihereranye n’Imana bari bonyine, kandi ko amaso Yayo areba imbere mu mutima agasoma icyifuzo cy’imbere mu bugingo, ndetse ko bashobora kuvugana n’Imana.” — Abahungu n’Abakobwa b’Imana, p.121.

q.text: c. Igihe tubaye abana b’Imana, ni irihe deni tuba tubereyemo abandi?

note.text: “Ni mu buhe buryo Pawulo yari arimo ideni Abayuda n’Abagiriki? Nk’uko bimeze kuri buri mwigishwa wese wa Kristo, Pawulo yari yarahawe uyu murimo: ‘Nuko mugende muhindure abantu bo mu mahanga yose abigishwa, mubabatiza mu izina rya Data wa twese n’Umwana n’Umwuka Wera, mubigisha kwitondera ibyo nababwiye byose. Kandi dore ndi kumwe namwe iminsi yose kugeza ku mperuka y’isi.’ Mu kwakira Kristo, Pawulo yari yemeye uwo murimo. Yasobanukiwe ko ahawe inshingano yo gukorera abantu bo mu nzego zose: Abayuda n’Abanyamahanga, abize n’abatarize, abari mu myanya yo hejuru n’aboroheje mu by’ubu buzima.” — Ellen G.White, Ubusobanuro bwa Bibiliya bw’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi, vol. 6, p.1067.

q.text: a. Iyo Umwuka Wera ari mu mitima yacu, ni iki duhita tubanza gukora?

note.text: “Dukwiriye gushaka uko twakwerekeza ibitekerezo by’abandi kuri Kristo tukagerageza uko dushoboye kose kubareshya ngo babone gutega amakiriro ku byiza bya Kristo bitazashira byo mu isi izaza. Dukwiriye kumaramaza dutwaranira kugera ikirenge mu cya Kristo. Dukwiriye kujya dukeburira amaso y’abatuzengurutse ku kureba ‘Mwana w’intama w’Imana ukuraho ibyaha by’abari mu isi.’ Yohana 1:29.

“Nitugira umuhati mu kugira ibyo dukorera guhesha abandi umugisha, bizatugarukira ari imigisha myinshi. Uwo niwo wahoze ari umugambi w’Imana mu kuduha kugira uruhare rwo kugira icyo dukora mu nama y’ugucungurwa. Imana yahaye amahirwe abantu yo gusangira kamere Yayo, kugirango babone guhesha bagenzi babo umugisha. Nta cyubahiro giheranije cyangwa umunezero w’agahebuzo Imana yaha abantu birenze gusangira kamere Yayo. Abashyira hamwe n’Imana bagakorana na Yo imirimo y’urukundo, nibo barusha abandi bose kwegerezwa Umuremyi wabo.

“Iyo Imana ibishaka yajyaga gutegeka abamarayika bo mu ijuru kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza no gukora imirimo yose y’urukundo yo gukiza abandi. Iyo ibishaka yajyaga gusohoza umugambi Wayo mu bundi buryo. Ariko kubw’urukundo Rwayo rutagira akagero, yahisemo kudutorera gukorana na Yo, kugirango dufatanye na Kristo n’abamarayika, dusangire umugisha n’umunezero no kuzahurwa mu by’umwuka, bizanywe n’uwo murimo utarangwamo kwikanyiza.

“Dukorana na Kristo binyuze mu gusangira na we imibabaro Ye. Buri gikorwa cyose cyo kwitangira abandi mu kubahesha ibyiza kidukomerezamo umutima wo kugira neza no kutwegereza Umucunguzi w’isi, ‘wari umutunzi, ariko agahinduka umukene ku bwanyu, kugirango ubukene bwe bubatungishe.’ 2Abakorinto 8:9. Nitugenza dutyo nibwo buryo rukumbi tuzasohoza umugambi Imana yari idufitiye mu iremwa ryacu kugirango ubugingo bushobore kutubera umugisha.” – Kugana Yesu, p.78 – 80.

q.text: b. Ni uruhe rugero rwa Kristo rugomba kutuyobora mu mubano tugirana n’abo dufitanye isano y’umuryango ndetse n’abaturanyi?

note.text: “Nimujya ku murimo nk’uko Kristo yabigeneye abigishwa Be, mukamushakira abihana, muzumva mushaka kugira ubunararibonye bwimbitse n’ubumenyi bw’ikirenga mu by’Imana, mugire inzara n’inyota byo gukiranuka. Muzatakira Imana kandi kwizera kwanyu kuzakomera, kandi imitima yanyu izanywera ku isōko y’amazi afutse y’agakiza. Kurwanywa n’ibigeragezo muzahura na byo bizabatera kwiga Bibiliya no gusenga. Muzakurira mu buntu no kumenya Kristo murusheho gushikama no gutungana.” — Ibid., p.80.

q.text: a. Vuga akaga kamwe gakomeye katwugarije twebwe abizera b’itorero muri iki gihe.

note.text: “Muri iki gihe akaga gakomeye [Abadiventisiti bakomeza Isabato] bafite ni uko birundanyirizaho ubutunzi. Bamwe muri bo bakomeza kongera ibyo bakora n’ibituma bahuga, basabwa gukora byinshi. Ingaruka y’ibi ni uko bagera aho benda kwibagirwa Imana n’ibikenewe mu murimo Wayo, urebye bapfuye mu by’umwuka. Basabwa gutambira Imana igitambo, kandi bakayizanira amaturo. Igitambo nticyiyongera, ahubwo kiragabanuka, ndetse kikagera ubwo gishira…. Ubwinshi mu butunzi bw’abantu bacu buri kubera igikomere gusa ababwizirikaho.” – Ibihamya by’Itorero, vol 1, p.492.

q.text: b. Ni izihe ngeso za Gikristo zifasha abizera gukurira mu buntu no kumenya Umwami Yesu Kristo?

note.text: “Amahirwe yahawe Aburahamu na Loti natwe ntitwayavutswa. Kubwo kugaragariza urugwiro abana b’Imana tubakira, natwe dushobora kwakira abamarayika b’Imana mu ngo zacu. No muri iki gihe abamarayika bari mu ishusho y’abantu binjira mu mazu y’abantu maze bakabacumbikira. Kandi n’Abakristo baba mu mucyo umurika uturuka mu maso y’Imana bahora iteka baherekejwe n’abamarayika batagaragara, kandi iyo ibyo biremwa byera bivuye mu miryango yacu bihasiga imigisha.” — Ibid., vol. 6, p.342.

q.text: c. Ni iki gikenewe kigomba gusohozwa n’abizera bo muri iki gihe?

note.text: “Abavugabutumwa b’abakorerabushake [Abalayiki] bari mu itorero ryacu bashobora gukora umurimo kugeza ubu benshi batari batangira. Abantu ntibari bakwiriye kwimukira ahantu hashya bajyanywe gusa no kwishakira inyungu z’iby’isi; ahubwo ahantu bashobora kugirira imibereho iboneye, nimureke umuryango umwe cyangwa ibiri ihajye ishikamye mu kuri, maze bakore umurimo nk’ababwirizabutumwa. Bakwiriye kwiyumvamo urukundo bakunda imitima y’abantu, bakiyumvamo umutwaro wo kugira umurimo babakorera, kandi bakiga uburyo bashobora kubageza ku kumenya ukuri. Bashobora kubaha ibitabo byacu, bagateranya amateraniro mu ngo, bakimenyereza abaturanyi babo, kandi bakabararikira kuza muri ayo materaniro. Bityo bashobora kureka umucyo wabo ukamurika binyuze muri iyo mirimo yabo myiza.” — Ibihamya by’Itorero, vol. 8, p.245.

“Imana yategereje igihe kirekire ko umwuka wo gukora umurimo wakuzura Itorero ryose kugira ngo buri wese ayikorere akurikije uko ubushobozi bwe buri. Igihe abizera bagize Itorero ry’Imana bazakora umurimo bashinzwe aho ukenewe hose haba iwabo cyangwa ahandi maze bagasohoza inshingano yo kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza, isi yose izaherako iburirwe maze umwami Yesu agaruke ku isi afite imbaraga n’icyubahiro cyinshi.” – Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa, p.111.

q.text: a. Ni iki cyitezwe ku bantu bose babikijwe Ubutumwa Bwiza, by’umwihariko abakozi?

note.text: “Kuba hafi y’Imana no kumvira Umwuka Wayo, ni amahirwe y’abarinzi bo ku nkike z’i Siyoni kugira ngo Imana ishobore gukorera muri bo maze bamenyeshe abagabo n’abagore akaga bashobora guhura nako kandi babayobore aho bagomba guhungira. Icyatumye batoranywa n’Imana, icyatumye bashyirwaho ikimenyetso cy’amaraso yo kuyiyegurira, kwari ukugirango bakize abagabo n’abagore ukurimbuka kubugarije. Baba indahemuka mu kubaburira ibyerekeye ingaruka zo gucumura kwabo kandi bakaba n’indahemuka mu kurinda inyungu z’Itorero.” – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.15.

q.text: b. Ni uruhe rugero Daniyeli aha urubyiruko rwo muri iki gihe?

note.text: “Uwiteka yashakaga ko tugira icyo twigira ku mibereho ya Daniyeli. Hari benshi bari guhinduka abagabo b’abanyembaraga iyo bishingikiriza ku Mana kugirango ibagire abaneshi, ibahe imbaraga n’ubushobozi mu mirimo bakora nk’uko byagenze kuri uyu Muheburayo w’indahemuka. Daniyeli yagaragarizaga urugwiro abakuru bamuruta ndetse n’urubyiruko rw’urungano rwe. Yahagaze ari umuhamya w’Imana, kandi mu migenzereze ye ntiyaterwaga isoni n’uko ijuru ryakumva amagambo ye cyangwa uko ryabona imirimo ye. Igihe Daniyeli yasabwaga kurira no kunywera ku meza y’umwami, ntiyahaye urwaho irari habe no kugaragaza icyo yari yiyemeje cyerekeye kurya no kunywa we yifuzaga. Atiriwe avuga ijambo na rimwe ry’agasuzuguro, icyari kimuhangayikishije yagituye Imana. We na bagenzi be bashatse ubwenge buturuka ku Uwiteka, nuko igihe bavaga mu masengesho bahise bafata umwanzuro. Afite umwete n’urugwiro bya Gikristo, Daniyeli yagejeje ikibazo cye ku mutware wari ubashinzwe, amusaba ko yajya abaha ifunguro ryoroheje gusa. Abo basore bumvaga ko amahame y’iyobokamana ryabo ari mu kaga, nyamara bishingikirije ku Mana bakundaga kandi bakoreraga.” – Ibihamya ku Bagabura, p.263.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni iyihe mimerere y’isi ituma biba ngombwa ko Imana iyimurikamo umucyo?
2. Ni iyihe mpinduka itangaje izagaragarira mu mibereho y’abizera?
3. Ni ryari umugisha wakirwa, kandi ni iki kigomba kuba inyikirizo?
4. Sobanura bumwe mu buryo buri wese muri twe ashobora gukoresha kugirango akorere abandi.
5. Ni gute ubudahemuka bwa Daniyeli ari urugero rwiza kuri njye?

lessons.title: Kumenya Imana
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Umunyabwenge wese azitegereza ibyo, kandi bazita ku mbabazi z’Uwiteka.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Umunyabwenge wese azitegereza ibyo, kandi bazita ku mbabazi z’Uwiteka.”

keyNote.text: “Kumenya Imana niyo sōko y’ubumenyi nyakuri bwose no gutera imbere nyako.” — Uburezi, p.15.

q.text: a. Ni ibiki kuri iyi si Uwiteka akoresha kugirango yireherezeho abantu?

note.text: “Imana ifite uburyo bwinshi ikoresha ishaka kutwimenyesha no kudutera gusabana na Yo. Ibyaremwe bihora bivugana n’intekerezo zacu ubudasiba. Umutima iyo wemeye, ubasha kureshywa n’urukundo rw’Imana n’ubwiza Bwayo, aribyo bigaragazwa n’imirimo y’amaboko Yayo. Uzi gutega amatwi, abasha kumva no kumenya icyo Imana ivugira mu bintu yaremye. Ari ubwatsi bumera, cyangwa ibiti binini by’inganzamarumbo, cyangwa imigengararo n’uburabyo, cyangwa igicu kigenda, cyangwa imvura igwa, cyangwa akagezi gasuma, byose uko bingana bivugana n’imitima yacu, bikaturarikira kumenyerana n’Uwabiremye byose.” – Kugana Yesu, p.85.

q.text: b. Ni iki Yesu yakoreshaga kugirango ashimangire mu ntekerezo z’ababaga bamuteze amatwi?

note.text: “Ibyigisho by’agahebuzo by’Umukiza wacu, yabyigishaga akoresheje ibyaremwe. Ibiti, inyoni, uburabyo bwo mu bibaya, imisozi, ibiyaga, n’isanzure rikeye, kimwe n’ibindi bihora biboneka iminsi yose bidukikije; nibyo yahuzaga n’ijambo ry’ukuri, agirango ibyo yigisha bigume mu ntekerezo z’abantu ndetse yemwe n’igihe bahugijwe n’amaganya y’iby’ubu bugingo bwuzuyemo imiruho.
“Imana ishaka ko abana Bayo banezezwa n’imirimo Yayo kugirango banezezwe n’ubwiza bw’ibintu byoroheje yarimbishishije isi yacu.” — Ibid.

q.text: a. Ni ikihe cyigisho dushobora kwigira ku byaremwe, urugero nk’indabo, inyoni, n’inyenyeri?

note.text: “Mu kwiga iby’ubuhanga buhanitse…. tuhakura kumenya Umuremyi. Ubumenyi bwa siyansi nyakuri ni ugusobanura inyandiko y’Imana mu byaremwe. Siyansi ikura mu bushakashatsi bwayo ibihamya bifatika bigaragaza ubwenge n’ubushobozi by’Imana. Gusobanukirwa neza n’igitabo cy’ibyaremwe ndetse n’Ijambo ry’Imana ryanditswe, bituma tumenya Imana binyuze mu kutwigisha iby’ubwenge n’amategeko yo kugira neza Imana ikoresha.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.599.

“Nituramuka duteze amatwi, ibyaremwe n’Imana bizatwigisha ibyigisho byiza byo kumvira no kwiringira. Uhereye ku nyenyeri zihora zigenda urugendo rwazo rwo mu kirere kuva kera kose, ukageza ku kantu gato kataboneshwa ijisho, ibyaremwe byose byumvira ubushake bw’Umuremyi. Imana yita kubyo yaremye byose aho biva bikagera, ikabikomeza.” – Kugana Yesu, p.85,86.

q.text: b. Iyo dutekereje ku bwiza n’umutuzo byarangaga ibyaremwe mbere yuko byangirika, ni iki tugomba kwibuka cyerekeranye n’isi nshya twasezeranyijwe?

note.text: “Reka ibitekerezo byawe bishushanye urugo rw’abakijijwe, kandi wibuke ko ruzaba rufite ubwiza buruta ubwo ushobora kwiyumvisha. Mu mpano zinyuranye Imana yaduhereye mu byaremwe tuzibonamo ubwiza Bwayo buheranije kandi burabagirana.” — Ibid., p.86,87.

“Itorero ry’Imana ryagiye rihishurirwa iby’umugambi uhoraho w’Uwiteka. Ubwoko Bwe bwagiye bwemererwa kureba hirya y’ibigeragezo ryabaga ririmo icyo gihe maze rikabona intsinzi zo mu gihe kizaza, ubwo urugamba ruzaba rusojwe, abacunguwe bagahabwa igihugu cy’isezerano. Ayo mayerekwa yerekeye ubwiza bw’ahazaza n’ibizaba byagaragajwe n’ukuboko kw’lmana bikwiriye gukundwa n’itorero ryayo muri iki gihe.” – Abahanuzi n’Abami, p.722.

“Muri Bibiliya, umurage w’abacunguwe witwa ‘gakondo.’ Abaheburayo 11:14,16. Muri iyo gakondo, Umwungeri wo mu ijuru ajyana umukumbi We ku masōko y’amazi y’ubugingo. Igiti cy’ubugingo cyera imbuto zacyo buri kwezi, kandi ibibabi byacyo ni ibyo gukiza amahanga. Ari imigezi idakama, itembamo amazi y’urubogobogo abonerana nk’ibuye ry’isarabwayi, kandi ku nkombe z’iyo migezi hari ibiti bifite amashami azana amahumbezi mu nzira zateguriwe abacunguwe n’Uwiteka. Aho ngaho, ibibaya bigari biri munsi y’udusozi tw’igikundiro kandi hagaragara impinga ndende z’imisozi y’Imana. Muri ibyo bibaya byuje amahoro, ku nkombe y’iyo migezi y’amazi y’ubugingo, niho ubwoko bw’Imana bwamaze imyaka myinshi ari abagenzi n’abimukira buzatura.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.675.

q.text: a. Ni ibihe byigisho by’agaciro kenshi dushobora kwigira ku bahanuzi, bikadutera imbaraga mu bihe byo gucika intege n’ibigeragezo?

note.text: “Dushobora kwigishwa n’ibitubaho ndetse n’ibidukikije mu mpinduka zitugeraho buri munsi, imitima yacu iramutse yugururiwe kubyakira…. [Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi] ‘bari abantu bameze nkatwe’. Yakobo 5:17. Muri Bibiliya dusangamo uburyo birwanagaho bacogoye nkatwe, uko bagwaga mu moshya nkatwe, bakongera gusubiza agatima impembero maze bakanesha binyuze mu buntu bw’Imana; kandi uko tubitekereza, turushaho kongerwa umwete wo gushaka gukiranuka.” – Kugana Yesu, p.87,88.

q.text: b. Niba Imana yita ku byaremwe ikabitunga, mbese abana Bayo ibarushirizaho bingana iki?

note.text: “Ibyaremwe n’ibyahishuwe byose bihamya urukundo rw’Imana. Data wa twese wo mu ijuru ni we sōko y’ubugingo, ubwenge n’umunezero. Nimwitegereze ubwiza bw’ibyaremwe n’uko bitangaje. Utekereje imikoranire yabyo itangaje, si ukugirango biheshe umuntu ibyo akeneye n’umunezero gusa, ahubwo ugera no ku byaremwe byose. Izuba ndetse n’imvura, binezeza isi bikanayihembura, udusozi, inyanja n’ibibaya; byose bitubwira urukundo rw’Umuremyi.” — Ibid., p.9.

q.text: c. Mbese isezerano ry’uko Imana itwitaho ritwerekeza ku gutekereza ku ki?

note.text: “Igihe twirundarundiraho ibyo dukwiriye gukora, maze tukishingikiriza ku bwenge bwacu bwite n’ubushobozi bwacu, tuba twihaye umutwaro tutategetswe n’Imana, tukagerageza kuwikorera tudafashijwe na Yo. Tuba twishyizeho inshingano y’Imana, tukaba twishyize mu mwanya Wayo rwose. Dushobora guhagarika umutima tukagira ibyago n’imibabaro kuko bitabura kutugeraho. Ariko igihe twiringira rwose yuko Imana idukunda kandi yishimira kutugirira neza, tuzareka kuganyishwa n’iby’igihe cy’ahazaza. Tuziringira Imana nk’uko umwana yiringira umubyeyi umukunda. Nibwo amagorwa yacu n’ibiturushya bizashira, kuko ubushake bwacu buzamirwa n’ubushake bw’Imana.” – Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.100,101.

q.text: a. Ni hehe Kristo yashyize amahishurwa asobanutse neza y’umugambi w’Imana kubw’agakiza k’abantu?

note.text: “Imana ivuganira natwe mu ijambo Ryayo. Muri ryo niho turushaho guhishurirwa imico Yayo itangaje, ibyo ikorera abantu, ndetse n’umurimo ukomeye wo gucungurwa.” – Kugana Yesu, p.87.

q.text: b. Ni iki kigomba gukorwa buri munsi n’abantu bose bifuza gukurira mu mbaraga z’Imana no mu bushobozi Bwayo?

note.text: “Insanganyamatsiko yo gucungurwa ni imwe mu zo abamarayika baba bifuza gusobanukirwa; kandi niyo abacunguwe bazahora baririmba iteka bageze mu ijuru. Mbese twebwe siyo dukwiriye gushishikarira kwiga no kumenya? Imbabazi zitagira akagero za Yesu n’urukundo Rwe, igitambo yatambiwe kubwacu, nibyo dukwiriye gutekerezaho mu buryo bwimbitse kandi tubyitondeye. Dukwiriye kwita cyane ku mico y’Umucunguzi wacu udukunda akaba ari n’Umuhuza wacu udusabira. Dukwiriye gutekereza ku murimo w’Uwaje gukiza ubwoko Bwe akabukura mu byaha.” — Ibid., p.88,89.

q.text: c. Ni gute dukwiriye kwakira ijambo ry’Imana mu mitima yacu?

note.text: “Nta muntu n’umwe ufite umwuka wo kunyurwa n’inyigisho za Bibiliya ushobora gusoma umurongo umwe muri yo ngo abure kuwungukiramo igitekerezo runaka kimwubaka. Ariko inyigisho y’ingirakamaro cyane Bibiliya yigisha ntushobora kuyibona uramutse wize Bibiliya rimwe na rimwe. Ntabwo ukuri guhebuje kuyirimo kwatanzwe ku buryo umuntu usoma hutihuti cyangwa usoma ntacyo yitayeho ashobora kugusobanukirwa. Umugabane munini w’ubutunzi buyirimo buhishwe mu ndiba yayo, kandi bushobora kugerwaho gusa binyuze mu gushakashakana umwete no kwihangana. Ukuri kubyara ukuri kwagutse kugomba gushakwashakwa kandi kugahuzwa, “Aha bikeya, hariya bikeya.” Yesaya 28:10.

“Uko kuri kose nigushakwa maze kukegeranywa, uzasanga nta kubangamirana guhari, ahubwo kuzuzanya rwose. Buri Butumwa bwiza bwuzuza ubundi, buri buhanuzi busobanura ubundi, kandi buri kuri usanga ari ubusobanuro burambuye bw’ukundi kuri. Ibyashushanywaga mu mateka y’Abayuda byasobanuwe neza n’ubutumwa bwiza. Buri hame ryavuzwe mu Ijambo ry’Imana rifite umwanya waryo, kandi igihamya gifatika cyatangiwe kurishyigikira. Bityo inyubako ishyitse haba mu itegurwa ryayo n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa, ihamya Umuhanzi wayihanze. Nta bwenge bw’umuntu bwabasha guhanga inyubako nk’iyo keretse ubwenge bw’Imana itarondoreka.” — Uburezi, p.123,124.

q.text: a. Ni iki cyahumurije Yeremiya kandi kiramufasha mu gihe yari arimo cy’umubabaro?

note.text: “Nta kintu gishobora kungura ubwenge bw’umuntu no kubwongerera imbaraga nko kwiga Ibyanditswe Byera. Nta kindi gitabo cyera kirabura cyazahura intekerezo zacu, kikazongerera imbaraga, tukagira ibitekerezo byagutse n’ubwenge, nk’ukuri kuboneka muri Bibiliya. Iyaba ijambo ry’Imana ryigwaga nk’uko bikwiriye, abantu bagira ubwenge bushyitse bureba kure, imico yabo ikabonezwa, kandi bakagira imigambi ihamye nubwo abameze batyo ari mbarwa muri iki gihe.” – Kugana Yesu, p.90.

“Umuntu wiga Ibyanditswe Byera ubudacogora, kandi akabikora asenga, azagira imyumvire mizima n’ibitekerezo bireba kure, nk’uwahindukiriye Imana bimugeza ku rugero ruhanitse rw’ubwenge.” – Intekerezo, Imico, n’Ubumuntu, vol 1, p.95.

q.text: b. Ni gute Ibyanditswe Byera bigomba kwigwa kandi uko kwiga Bibiliya bigomba kubanzirizwa n’iki?

note.text: “Ukuri kw’Imana kumeze nk’izahabu, ntikubonwa n’abaserura hejuru, ahubwo kuboneka gusa kubwo kukwigana umwete.” – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.76.

“Nk’uko umucukuzi w’izahabu abona umututu w’aho iri, akawukurikira akarinda awugeza mu kuzimu, kugeza ubwo ayicukuye akayimaramo, niko ushakashaka mu ijambo ry’Imana ubutunzi buhishwe butabonerwa amajyejuru akwiriye kugira umwete, akabona ukuri gukomeye rwose kwari guhishwe amaso y’ushaka atitonze. Amagambo ahumetswe n’Imana iyo tuyatekereje cyane mu mitima, ahinduka nk’umugezi utemba, uva mu masōko y’ubugingo, unetesha imitima yacu.

“Ntabwo bidukwiriye kwiga Bibiliya tutabanje gusenga. Mbere yuko tubumbura impapuro zayo zera, tujye tubanza duhombeke amaso imbere y’Imana, tuyisabe kutumurikishiriza Umwuka Wayo Wera kugirango adusobanurire kandi tuzamuhabwa…. Abamarayika baturutse mu isi y’umucyo bazabana n’umuntu wicisha bugufi agashaka kuyoborwa n’Imana.” – Kugana Yesu, p.91.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni ubuhe buryo bw’imyigishirize bwakoreshwaga n’Umukiza wacu kugirango agere ku bantu?
2. Ni mu buhe buryo Imana yakoresheje kugirango yihishurire abantu bose – harimo n’abadashobora kugera ku ijambo Ryayo?
3. Ni iki dushobora kwigira ku bugiraneza bw’Imana?
4. Sobanura inyifato tugomba kugira igihe tugiye kwiga Bibiliya nk’ihishurwa ry’Imana.
5. Ni ubuhe bunararibonye Yeremiya yagize ku Byanditswe Byera tugomba kugira natwe?

fso.title: Amaturo y’Isabato ya Mbere
fso.subtitle: Azagenerwa Ishuri ry’Ivugabutumwa ryo muri Filipine

paragraph.text: Mu gihe twibutswa iby’inshingano ikomeye yo kujya mu isi yose no guhindura abantu abigishwa, tugomba kugira icyo dukora. Ishuri Rihugura Abavugabutumwa rya Bibiliya ni ikigo kigamije gutegura no guha ibikoresho abakozi bo mu ruzabibu rw’Uwiteka. Kuva iryo shuri ryatangira muri Gashyantare 1984, ryabaye icyitegererezo cy’ukwizera, rigorora imitima n’ubwenge by’abantu bafite icyifuzo gikomeye cyo gukwirakwiza ubutumwa bwiza mu mahanga yose. Abanyeshuri benshi barangije porogaramu y’imyaka ibiri yo gutoza abavugabutumwa y’iryo shuri bagiye kuba abavugabutumwa mu mahanga, kandi abenshi muri bo ni abayobozi n’abagabura bakwirakwiza ubutumwa bw’agakiza mu birwa bya Filipine bituwe cyane.

Ishuri Rihugura Abavugabutumwa rya Bibiliya riri i Kabatanga, Tiyawongi, mu Ntara ya Kwezoni ho muri Filipine, ryagiye rikora ridacogora kugira ngo ritange urufatiro rukomeye rwo mu Byanditswe ku bantu bifuza kuba abavugabutumwa, haba muri Filipine no mu Karere kose ka Pasifika. Iyo nzu yatumye abanyeshuri babona aho kuba, bakiga Icyongereza, kandi bahabwa imyitozo yo kuba abavugabutumwa, ababwiririshabutumwa ibitabo, abakozi mu by’ubuzima n’abayobozi bakenewe cyane muri iki gihugu no mu bindi bihugu. Na none kandi, ni ahantu hashobora kubera amahugurwa, ibiterane by’urubyiruko n’amateraniro makuru.

Kubera ko umurimo wo kuvugurura ugenda waguka hirya no hino muri Filipine, ubu hakenewe kwihutirwa kwagura no kunonosora iyo nzu kugira ngo ikomeze kwita ku byo umurimo w’Imana ukeneye mu gihe kizaza. Dufatiye kuri ibyo bintu bikenewe, hari na gahunda zirimo gukorwa zo gutunganya neza ahantu hazakirirwa Ihuriro ry’Inteko Nkuru Rusange muri icyo kigo. Mbega ukuntu ari umugisha kwakira iryo teraniro ry’abizera, aho iyerekwa ry’ivugabutumwa n’ikangura mu by’umwuka bizaba ariyo ntumbero!

Ituro ry’Isabato ya Mbere mutanganye ubuntu uyu munsi, rizafasha mu kubaka iryo shuri rikeneye kwagurwa cyane. Mu gihe dutanga, nimutyo tujye twibuka amagambo yo mu 2Abakorinto 9:7, agira ati “Umuntu wese atange nk’uko abigambiriye mu mutima we, atinuba kandi adahatwa kuko Imana ikunda utanga anezerewe.”

Twifuza ko impano zanyu zatuma iryo shuri ryaguka, rigakomera ku nshingano yaryo, kandi rikabyara abakozi biteguye kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza bw’iteka ryose. Nimutyo dutange dufite ukwizera n’ibyishimo, tuzi ko amaturo yacu azera imbuto z’iteka ku bw’ubwami bw’Imana.
Murakoze, Uwiteka abahundagazeho imigisha mu gihe mutanga!

lessons.title: Amahirwe yo Gusenga
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Wehoho nusenga ujye winjira mu nzu ubanze ukinge urugi, uhereko usenge So mwihereranye. Nuko So ureba ibyiherereye azakugororera.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Wehoho nusenga ujye winjira mu nzu ubanze ukinge urugi, uhereko usenge So mwihereranye. Nuko So ureba ibyiherereye azakugororera.”

keyNote.text: “Gusenga ni ukugururira Imana umutima nk’uko twashyikirana n’incuti magara. Icyakora igituma dukwiriye kugenza dutyo, si ukugirango tumenyeshe Imana uko turi, ahubwo ni ukugirango itubashishe kuyakira. Gusenga ntikutumanurira Imana, ahubwo kuyitugezaho.” — Kugana Yesu, p.93.

q.text: a. Nk’Umwana w’Umuntu, ni iki Yesu yabonye ko ari ngombwa cyane?

note.text: “Itegereze Umwana w’Imana yubamye yicishije bugufi asenga asaba Se! Nubwo ari Umwana w’Imana, mu gusenga ni ho ukwizera kwe kwahererwaga imbaraga. Mu gusabana n’ijuru yahahererwaga imbaraga zo kurwanya umwanzi no gufasha abantu mu byo bakeneye. Nk’imfura mu baremwe, azi ibyo abantu bagishaka kumukorera bakeneye, nubwo bamwe bafite intege nke kandi bakaba bari mu isi y’ibyaha n’ibigeragezo. Azi neza ko abo abona bakwiriye gutumwa ari abanyantege nke, abantu bibeshya; ariko ku bantu biyeguriye umurimo We burundu abasezeranira ubufasha mvajuru. Urugero Rwe bwite ni icyemezo cyerekana ko gusaba Imana bivuye ku mutima, udacogora mu kwizera – ukwizera kuyobora umuntu ku kugengwa n’Imana burundu ndetse no kwirundurira mu murimo Wayo – bizazanira abantu ubufasha bw’Umwuka Wera mu rugamba barwanya icyaha.” – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.511.

q.text: b. Ni gute uburyo Yesu yasengaga bikwiriye kutubera icyitegererezo?

note.text: “Yesu ubwe, igihe yari atuye mu bantu, yahoraga asenga.” – Kugana Yesu, p.93.

q.text: a. Ni gute Yesu yigishije abigishwa Be gusenga?

note.text: “Yesu akiri mu isi, yigishaga abigishwa Be uburyo bwo gusenga. Yabayoboraga ku gushyira imbere y’Imana ibyo bakenera bya buri munsi, no kuyitura amaganya yabo yose kuko ibitaho. Ubwishingizi bw’iremamutima Yesu yabahaye bw’uko ugusaba kwabo kuzumvirwa, nibwo bwishingizi natwe dufite…..

“Asangira natwe intege nke zacu, ‘yageragejwe mu buryo bwose nkatwe’; ariko kuko azira icyaha, umutima We wazibukiraga ibibi ukabyitarura. Yihanganiraga amagorwa n’agahinda gasāze ari muri iyi si y’ibyaha. Kuko yenze akamero k’umuntu nicyo cyatumye yiyumvamo ko gusenga ari ngombwa ndetse ko ari amahirwe akomeye. Gusabana na Se kwamuzaniraga ihumure n’umunezero bitavugwa. Yemwe niba Umukiza w’abantu, akaba Umwana w’Imana, yarumvaga ko akwiriye guhora asenga, nkanswe twebwe b’abanyantege nke n’abanyabyaha bapfa!” – Kugana Yesu, p.93,94.

q.text: b. Ni gute Bibiliya isobanura uko Yesu yiyeguriraga Imana mu isengesho, n’impamvu ibyo byari ingirakamaro cyane?

note.text: “Kubera ko ubumuntu bwari muri We, yiyumvagamo ko akeneye imbaraga zivuye kuri Se. Yari afite ahantu yatoranyije ho gusengera. Yakundaga gushyikiranira na Se ahiherereye ku misozi. Muri uyu mwitozo, ubugingo Bwe bwera bwa kimuntu bwahabwaga imbaraga zo kumushoboza guhangana n’inshingano n’ibigeragezo bya buri munsi. Umukiza wacu yisanisha n’ubukene bwacu ndetse n’intege nke zacu, kuburyo yahindutse umuntu winginga, umunyamasengesho ya nijoro, agashaka guhabwa imbaraga nshya zivuye kuri Se, kugirango agende asubijwemo intege kandi agizwe mushya, yambaye intwaro zimushoboza gukora inshingano no gutsinda ibigeragezo. Ni We rugero rwacu muri byose.” – Ibihamya by’Itorero, vol 2, p.201,202.

“Nabonye ko nta n’umusore n’umwe mu basore makumyabiri waba uzi icyo iyobokamana rigaragarira mu mibereho y’umuntu ari cyo. Ibyo bakora babyikorera ubwabo, ariko bakavuga ko ari abagaragu ba Kristo. Nyamara umwuka ubariho nutamenagurwa ngo ubaveho, bidatinze bazabona ko umugabane bazahabwa ari uw’abica amategeko y’Imana. Naho kubwo kwitanga no kwiyanga kubera ukuri, bishakiye inzira yoroshye irenze ibyo byose. Ku byerekeye kwinginga bakomeje barira kandi batakambira Imana cyane bayisaba kugirirwa ubuntu Bwayo bubabarira ndetse n’imbaraga zo gutsinda ibishuko bya Satani, abasore babona ko atari ngombwa gushishikara no kugira umwete bene ako kageni. Bumva ko bashobora gutsinda ibyo bishuko badafite izo mbaraga. Incuro nyinshi Kristo, Umwami w’icyubahiro yajyaga ku misozi n’ahantu h’ubutayu akagenda wenyine ajyanywe no kubwira Se ibyifuzo byabaga biri mu mutima We. Nyamara umuntu w’umunyabyaha utagira imbaraga na mba atekereza ko ashobora kubaho adasenze cyane.” — Ibid., vol. 1, p.504,505.

q.text: a. Ni gute Yesu yatugaragarije inyifato ya Se mu guha abantu ibyo bakeneye?

note.text: “Data wa twese wo mu ijuru ategereje kudusukaho imigisha Ye itagabanyije. Ni amahirwe yacu gukundirwa kunywera ku isōko y’urukundo rutagira akagero. Mbega uburyo kugira ubute bwo gusenga ari akayobera! Imana yiteguye kandi irashaka kumva gusenga nyakuri k’umwana Wayo wese, nyamara nubwo bimeze bityo, dukunda gusengana ubuhanya kugirango tumenyeshe Imana ibyo dukennye.” – Kugana Yesu, p.94.

“Imana ni inyabwenge cyane ntijya iyoba, kandi ineza yayo nyinshi ituma itagira icyiza yima abagenda batunganye rwose. Nuko rero ntugatinye kuyiringira nubwo amasengesho yawe atahita asubizwa uwo mwanya. Ujye wiringira isezerano Ryayo rikomeye rigira riti: ‘Musabe muzahabwa.’ ” —Ibid., p.96.

q.text: b. Ni iki gituma amasengesho yacu atumvwa n’Uwiteka?

note.text: “Burya tubasha gutekereza [Imana]; tubasha gutekereza ku mirimo Yayo, imbabazi Zayo n’imigisha Yayo, ariko rero ibyo si ugusabana na Yo mu buryo bwuzuye. Kugirango dusabane n’Imana dukwiriye kugira icyo tuyibwira cyerekeye imibereho tubayeho.” —Ibid., p.93.

“Mbese abamarayika batekereza bate abantu batagira shinge na rugero b’abakene, bakunda gushukwa, iyo banze gusenga kandi bakagira kwizera kudashyitse; mu gihe Imana y’urukundo rutagira akagero iba yifuza kubaha ibirenze ibyo basaba n’ibyo bibwira? Abamarayika bo bakunda kuramya Imana, kandi bakunda kuyiba hafi. Nicyo gituma bishimira gusabana na Yo, bikabarutira byose. Nyamara abatuye mu isi bo, aribo cyane cyane bakeneye ubufasha butangwa n’Imana yonyine, basa n’aho banyuzwe no kubaho badafite umucyo w’Umwuka Wayo, n’ihirwe ryo gusabana na Yo.

“Umwijima w’umubi ugota abirengagiza gusenga. Ibyongorero by’ibishuko by’umwanzi bikabatera gukora ibyaha. Ayo makuba bayaterwa n’uko batita ku ihirwe Imana yabahaye, ariryo ryo gusenga.” —Ibid., p.94.

“Niba tugundira gukiranirwa ko mu mitima yacu, niba dukomeza kwizirika ku cyaha twiyiziho cyose, Uwiteka ntazadutega amatwi; nyamara isengesho ry’umunyabyaha wihana, kandi wizinutswe rizumvirwa. Amakosa yose azwi nakosorwa, dushobora kwizera ko Imana izasubiza amasengesho yacu. Ineza yacu ntabwo izaduhakirwa ku Mana, ahubwo ineza ya Yesu niyo yatugeza ku gukizwa, amaraso Ye niyo atweza, ariko hariho umurimo dukwiriye gukora watuma twuzuza ibisabwa kugirango twemerwe.” — Ibid., p.95.

q.text: a. Ni izihe ngingo z’ingenzi zigize isengesho ritsinda zitajya ziboneka ku isengesho ry’irinyantege nke ritagize icyo rimaze?

note.text: “Iyo tudahawe ibyo twasabye, ntitubihabwe ku gihe twabisabiye, tuba dukwiriye gukomeza kwizera yuko Uwiteka atwumva, tukizera kandi yuko azasubiza amasengesho yacu. Turi abantu bayobye kandi bahumye, nicyo gituma akenshi dusaba ibintu byatugwa nabi, nuko rero Data wa twese wo mu ijuru udukunda agasubiza amasengesho yacu kubwo kuduha ibyarushaho kutubera byiza, aribyo natwe twasaba turamutse dufite amaso amurikiwe n’Imana, abasha kubona ibintu byose uko biri koko. Iyo dutekereje ko amasengesho yacu adasubijwe, tuba dukwiriye kugundira isezerano; kuko igihe cyo gusubizwa kizagera nta kabuza kandi tuzahabwa umugisha dukeneye kurusha ibindi byose.” – Kugana Yesu, p.96.

q.text: b. Mbese dukwiriye gusengana uwuhe mutima kugirango isengesho ryumvwe n’Uwiteka?

note.text: “Igihe tuje gusaba Imana imbabazi n’umugisha, tuba dukwiriye kugira umwuka w’urukundo no kubabarira mu mitima yacu. Mbese nawe, twabasha dute gusaba duti: ‘Uduharire imyenda yacu, nk’uko natwe twahariye abarimo imyenda yacu’ kandi dufite imitima inangiye ituma twanga kubabarira bagenzi bacu? Matayo 6:12. Niba dushaka ko amasengesho yacu yumvirwa, natwe dukwiriye kubanza kubabarira abandi mu twifuza kubabarirwamo n’Imana.” — Ibid., p.97.

q.text: c. Ni iki twakwigira ku isengesho Eliya yasenze asaba imvura?

note.text: “Umugaragu yagumye kwitegereza ubwo Eliya yasengaga. Inshuro esheshatu zose yavaga kwitegereza ku nyanja akagaruka avuga ko ntacyo abonye, nta gicu, habe n’ikimenyetso cy’imvura. Ariko umuhanuzi ntiyigeze acika intege ngo acogore. Yakomeje kwisubiramo mu mibereho ye, kugirango arebe aho yasuzuguje Imana, yatura ibyaha bye, nuko akomeza kubabariza umutima we imbere y’Imana, mu gihe yari ategereje ikimenyetso cyerekana ko isengesho rye risubijwe. Ubwo yisuzumaga mu mutima we, mu bitekerezo bye ndetse no mu maso y’Imana yasaga n’aho adashyitse ndetse ko ari inyuma cyane. Kuri we yibonaga nk’aho ntacyo ari cyo, ahubwo ko Imana ari Yo byose, nuko ubwo yageraga ku ngingo yo kwizinukwa, akizirika ku Mukiza nk’imbaraga ze rukumbi no gukiranuka kwe, nibwo igisubizo cy’isengesho rye cyaje.” – Ellen G. White, Ubusobanuro bwa Bibiliya bw’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi, vol 2, p.1035.

q.text: a. Ni izihe nama z’ingirakamaro intumwa zitanga zerekeye ugusenga?

note.text: “Mukwiriye gusenga ubudasiba; ntimugire inkomyi. Mugire umuhati wo gusabana na Yesu mutagira ikibaziga. Mushake uburyo bwose bwo guteranira aho basengera. Abihatira gushyikirana n’Imana, ntibazabura kuboneka mu materaniro y’abasenga, bakora inshingano yabo mu budahemuka, bagira umurava, kandi bashishikarira kunguka uko bashoboye kose. Bazakoresha neza amahirwe babonye aho bashobora kubona imirasire y’umucyo uvuye mu ijuru.” – Kugana Yesu, p.98.

q.text: b. Nk’uko bigenda ku mubyeyi uwo ariwe wese, mbese Uwiteka ategereje ko abana Be bakora iki?

note.text: “Kristo yategetse abigishwa Be ati, musenge “Mu izina ryanjye”. Abayoboke ba Kristo bagomba guhagarara imbere y’Imana mu izina Rye. Bikomotse ku gitambo cyatanzwe ku bwabo, bafite agaciro kenshi imbere y’Imana. Bitewe n’uko bahawe gukiranuka kwa Kristo, bakirwa nk’abafite igiciro cyinshi. Binyuze muri Kristo, Uwiteka ababarira abubaha izina Rye. Ntabwo Imana ibabona nk’abandujwe n’icyaha. Ahubwo icyo ibona muri bo gusa ni Umwana Wayo, uwo bizera.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.667.

“Nta gihe cyangwa ahantu bidakwiriye ko umuntu yabwira Imana ibyifuzo bye. Nta kintu na kimwe gishobora kutubuza kuzamura imitima yacu mu buryo bw’umwuka ngo tuyiture Imana binyuze mu isengesho dusenganye umwete. Haba mu mbaga y’abantu mu nzira, haba mu mirimo itubyarira inyungu, dushobora kubwira Imana ibyifuzo byacu, kandi tugasaba kuyoborwa na Yo nk’uko Nehemiya yabikoze ubwo yasabaga ari imbere y’umwami Aritazerusi. Gusabana n’Imana bishobora gukorerwa ahantu aho ariho hose twaba turi.” – Kugana Yesu, p.99.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni uruhe rugero rwo gusenga iteka rwahawe abizera bose?
2. Ni ubuhe buhanuzi bugaragaza akamaro ko gusenga buri gitondo?
3. Ni ikihe kintu gikenewe kugirango isengesho risubizwe?
4. Ni ukubera iki dukwiriye kugumya gusenga mu gihe dutegereje igisubizo?
5. Mbese gusenga mu izina rya Yesu bisobanuye iki?

lessons.title: Uko Gushidikanya Kwagenzwa
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Ariko rero asabe yizeye ari nta cyo ashidikanya, kuko ushidikanya ameze nk’umuraba wo mu nyanja, ujyanwa n’umuyaga ushushubikanywa.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Ariko rero asabe yizeye ari nta cyo ashidikanya, kuko ushidikanya ameze nk’umuraba wo mu nyanja, ujyanwa n’umuyaga ushushubikanywa.”

keyNote.text: “Ntabwo Imana idusaba kwizera itabanje kuduha ibihamya bihagije byo gushingiraho ukwizera kwacu.” — Kugana Yesu, p.105.

q.text: a. Mbese ni iki dukwiriye kwibuka igihe tugeragereshejwe kugira imibereho yo guhindagurika bitewe no kwizera no gushidikanya?

note.text: “Isezerano [ry’Umukiza] ni iry’abantu bafite ubushake bwo gukurikira Imana badakebakeba. Imana ntihata ubushake bw’umuntu uwo ari we wese; bityo rero ntishobora kuyobora abantu bibona badashobora kwigishwa, bashaka kwikurikirira inzira yabo bwite. Umuntu w’imitima ibiri; - ushaka gukurikiza ubushake bwe kandi avuga ko akora ibyo Imana ishaka — Ibyanditswe bimuvugaho aya magambo ngo: ‘Umeze atyo ye kwibwira ko azagira icyo ahabwa n’Umwami Imana.’ Yakobo 1:7.” – Abakurambere n’Abahanuzi, p.384.

q.text: b. Ni iki Uwiteka yatanze kugirango umuntu aneshe ugushidikanya?

note.text: “Kwizera kwacu gukwiriye gushingira ku bihamya, atari ku magambo gusa. Abashaka gushidikanya ntibazabura uburyo, nyamara abashaka ukuri ntibazabura ibihamya byinshi byo gushyigikira ukwizera kwabo.” – Kugana Yesu, p.105.

“Imana yatanze ibihamya bihagije mu ijambo Ryayo bigaragaza imico y’ubumana Bwayo. Ukuri gukomeye kwerekeye gucungurwa kwacu kwarahishuwe. Kubwo gufashwa n’Umwuka Wera, wasezeraniwe abamushakana ukuri bose, uko kuri gukwiriye kumenywa n’umuntu wese ku giti cye. Imana yahaye abantu urufatiro rukomeye rwo kubakaho kwizera kwabo.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.526,527.

q.text: a. Mbese tugenza dute ubwiru Imana itasobanuye? Gutegeka kwa Kabiri 29:29;

note.text: “Ijambo ry’Imana rifite imiterere ihwanye n’iya Nyiraryo, kubera ko ririmo ubwiru budashobora gusobanukira abantu bapfa. Uburyo muri Bibiliya hagaragaramo uko icyaha cyaje mu isi, uko Kristo yambaye ishusho y’umuntu, kubyarwa ubwa kabiri, umuzuko, n’izindi nsanganyamatsiko nyinshi, byabaye amayobera arenze ubwenge bw’abantu kandi uretse kubisobanura, no kubyumva ntibabyumva neza mu buryo bwuzuye. Ariko rero, ibyo ntitwabigira urwitwazo rwo gutuma dushidikanya ijambo ry’Imana, tubitewe n’uko tudashobora gusobanukirwa ubwiru Imana yaduhishe.” – Kugana Yesu, p.106.

“Imana ntihatira abantu kureka kutizera kwabo. Imbere yabo hari umucyo n’umwijima, ukuri n’ibinyoma. Abantu nibo bagomba kwihitiramo icyo bazemera. Ubwenge bw’umuntu bwahawe ubushobozi bwo gutandukanya icyiza n’ikibi. Kandi Imana ntiyashatse ko abantu bahitamo bahubutse, ahubwo bakwiye guhitamo bagendeye ku bihamya, bakagereranya ibyanditswe n’ibindi byanditswe bitonze. Iyo Abayuda baza kureka kugendera ku marangamutima yabo, bakagereranya ibyanditswe mu buhanuzi n’ibyagaragaraga byarangaga imibereho ya Yesu, bari kubona ukuzuzanya kuboneye kwari hagati y’ubuhanuzi n’uburyo bwasohoreraga mu mibereho n’umurimo by’Umunyegalilaya wicishaga bugufi.

“Muri iki gihe abantu benshi bashukwa nk’uko byari biri ku Bayuda. Abigisha mu by’iyobokamana basoma Bibiliya bakurikije imyumvire yabo bwite n’imigenzo yabo; kandi abantu ntibishakashakira mu Byanditswe ngo bimenyere ukuri. Ahubwo bareka gukoresha gushyira mu gaciro kwabo maze imitima yabo bakayirundurira abayobozi babo. Kubwiriza no kwigisha ijambo ry’Imana ni bumwe mu buryo Imana yategetse bwo gukwirakwizamo umucyo; ariko Ibyanditswe Byera ni byo dukwiye kugerageresha inyigisho y’umuntu wese.” – Uwifuzwa Ibihe Byose, p.458,459.

q.text: b. Mbese tubwirwa n’iki ko muri Bibiliya harimo ibintu bigoye kubisobanukirwa?

note.text: “Ibigoye mu Byanditswe Byera byagiye bigaragazwa n’abahakanyi bakabikoresha nk’igitekerezo bifashisha barwanya Bibiliya; ariko ikigaragara aha ni uko ibyo bigoye bigize igihamya gikomeye ko byahumetswe n’Imana. Iyaba Ibyanditswe bitarimo inkuru ivuga Imana ariko dushobora gusobanukirwa mu buryo bworoshye; iyaba gukomera Kwayo n’ubuhangange Byayo byashoboraga kumvwa n’ubwenge bw’abantu bagira iherezo, icyo gihe Bibiliya ntiyaba igifite ibiyiranga bidashidikanywaho by’ububasha bw’Imana. Uko gukomera ndetse n’ubwiru bigize insanganyamatsiko zigaragazwa byari bikwiriye kudutera kwizera ko Bibiliya ari ijambo ry’Imana.” – Kugana Yesu, p.107.

q.text: a. Ni akahe kaga kadasanzwe kugarije abizera muri iyi minsi y’imperuka?

note.text: “Iyo Imana yoherereje abantu ubutumwa bwayo bw’umuburo ukomeye, bugatangwa nk’ubutangajwe n’Abamarayika bera baguruka baringanije ijuru, isaba umuntu wese ufite ubushobozi bwo gutekereza kwita kuri ubwo butumwa. Urubanza ruteye ubwoba ruzacirwa abasenga ya nyamaswa n’igishushanyo cyayo (Ibyahishuwe 14:9 – 11), rukwiriye gutera abantu benshi umwete wo kwiga ubuhanuzi kugira ngo bamenye ikimenyetso cy’inyamaswa icyo ari cyo, n’uburyo bakwirinda kuzakira icyo kimenyetso. Ariko abantu benshi biziba amatwi ngo batumva uko kuri, maze bagahindukirira imigani y’ibihimbano. Intumwa Pawulo atubwira gusubiza amaso yacu inyuma tukareba mu minsi yashize: “Igihe kizaza ubwo abantu batazihanganira inyigisho nzima.” 2Timoteyo 4:3. Icyo gihe cyamaze gusohora. Abantu benshi muri iki gihe ntibashaka ukuri kwa Bibiliya, kuko kunyuranyije n’ubushake bw’abakora ibyaha, n’umutima ukunda iby’isi; maze Satani na we, akazana ibishuko ahereye ku byo bakunda.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.594,595.

q.text: b. Ni iki cyahanuwe ku byerekeye inyifato y’amatsinda abiri mu minsi y’imperuka?

note.text: “Ariko Imana izaba igifite abantu Bayo ku isi basigasira Bibiliya, kandi yonyine, nk’urufatiro rw’inyigisho shingiro n’ipfundo ry’ubugorozi bwose. Ibitekerezo by’abanyabwenge cyangwa imyanzuro ya gihanga, itegeko cyangwa ibyemezo by’inama y’abakuru b’amadini, nk’uko ubwinshi no kudahuza ari nk’ibyo amadini bahagarariye, ubwinshi bw’amajwi sibwo bugomba gushingirwaho ku birebana n’ibyo kwizera kw’idini. Mbere yo kugira ihame cyangwa inyigisho iyo ari yo yose twemera, dukwiriye kubanza kwibaza niba bihuje n’iri jambo ngo ‘Uko niko Uwiteka avuga’. ” — Ibid., p.595.

“Umucyo mushya uturutse mu ijambo ry’Imana uzakomeza guhishurirwa umuntu ubeshejweho no kugirana umushyikirano na Zuba ryo Gukiranuka. Ntihakagire umuntu n’umwe ugera ku mwanzuro wo kuvuga ko nta wundi mucyo ugomba guhishurwa. Umuntu ugira umwete wo gushaka ukuri asenga, azabona imirasire y’umucyo w’agahebuzo imurika ituruka mu ijambo ry’Imana. Amabuye y’agaciro kenshi anyanyagiye muri icyo kirombe agomba gukusanywa kugirango abe umutungo w’ubwoko bw’Imana bwasigaye. Ariko umucyo ntiwatangiwe kongerera imbaraga abo mu itorero gusa, ahubwo watangiwe kugirango umurikire abari mu mwijima.” – Inama ku Murimo w’Ishuri ryo ku Isabato, p.34.

q.text: a. Ni gute dushobora gutandukanya iby’ingirakamaro n’iby’imburamumaro?

note.text: “Nubwo Imana yatanze ibihamya bikomeye byo kwizerwa, ntabwo izigera ikuraho inzitwazo zo kutizera. Abashaka imambo zo kumanikaho kutizera kwabo bazazibona. Kandi abanga kwemera no kumvira ijambo ry’Imana bategereje ko inzitizi zose zikurwa mu nzira, kandi nta gihe cyo gushidikanya kizaba kikiriho, ntabwo bazigera baza mu mucyo.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.527.

q.text: b. Ni uwuhe mugisha uzagera ku bantu bicisha bugufi?

note.text: “‘Ubukene bwose nari mfite bwarahagijwe, Yesu yamaze inzara yo mu mutima wanjye, nuko noneho Bibiliya yampishuriye Yesu Kristo. Mumbariza iki impamvu nizera Yesu? Ni ukubera ko yambereye Umukiza wavuye mu ijuru. Ni ukubera iki nizera Bibiliya? Ni ukubera ko nasanze ari ijwi ry’Imana rivugana n’umutima wanjye.’ Natwe dushobora guhamya dutyo, tukamenya neza tudashidikanya ko Bibiliya ari ukuri, kandi ko Kristo ari Umwana w’Imana. Nibwo tuzaba tumenye yuko tudakurikiza imigani yahimbwe n’ubwenge bw’abantu.” – Kugana Yesu, p.112.

q.text: c. Ni gute intumwa Pawulo asobanura imibereho y’umwizera muri iki gihe no mu gihe cy’ahazaza?

note.text: “Muri ubu buzima, dushobora gutangira gusobanukirwa n’insanganyamatsiko itangaje yo gucungurwa. Mu bwenge bwacu buke, dushobora kwita cyane ku isoni n’icyubahiro, ubugingo n’urupfu, ubutabera n’imbabazi, byose bihurira ku musaraba; nyamara umwete wose twakorana, ibitekerezo byacu ntibishobora kugera ku busobanuro bwuzuye. Uburebure n’umurambararo, ubugari, ubuhagarike by’urukundo rwaducunguye, tubimenyaho agace. Inama y’agakiza ntizasobanukira abacunguwe mu buryo bwuzuye, ndetse no mu gihe bazaba bareba nkuko barebwa, bakamenya nkuko bamenywe, ariko mu kubaho kw’iteka, ukuri gushya kuzabahishurirwa, bagutangarire kandi kunezeze imitima.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.651.

“Kubwo kwizera tubasha kurabukwa ibizaba, tugasingira isezerano Imana yadusezeranyije ry’uko izakuza ubwenge bwacu, kugirango butume ubushobozi bwacu bwa kimuntu bufatanya n’ubushobozi bw’Imana, maze buri mbaraga y’umutima ishobore kuzanwa Kuri Sōko y’umucyo. Ubwo nibwo tuzashobora kwishimira yuko dusobanukirwa n’ubugiraneza bw’Imana, ibyari biruhije gusobanuka tuzabisobanukirwa; kandi ibyaberaga urujijo ubwenge bwacu buke bizadufutukira rwose [1Abakorinto 13:12].” – Kugana Yesu, p.112,113.

q.text: a. Ni mu buhe buryo budasubirwaho Uwiteka akoresha mu guhishura ijambo Rye muri ibi bihe byegereza imperuka?

note.text: “Igitabo cyafatanishijwe ikimenyetso si igitabo cy’Ibyahishuwe, ahubwo ni wa mugabane w’ubuhanuzi bwa Daniyeli werekeje ku minsi y’impereka…. (Daniyeli 12:4). Igihe igitabo cyabumburwaga, humvikanye amagambo ngo, “Ntihazabaho igihe ukundi” (Ibyahishuwe 10:6). Noneho ubu igitabo cya Daniyeli gikuweho ikimenyetso, maze ihishurirwa Kristo yahaye Yohana rikagera ku batuye isi bose. Kubwo kugwira k’ubwenge ubwoko bw’Imana bugomba gutegurirwa guhaguruka mu minsi ya nyuma.” – Ubutumwa Bwatoranyijwe, vol 2, p.105.

“Abantu benshi bashyashyarije igitekerezo kivuga ko igitabo cy’Ibyahishuwe ari igitabo gifatanyishijwe ikimenyetso, maze ntibirirwe bafata igihe cyo kwiga ubwiru bukirimo. Bavuga ko bakomeza guhanga amaso ku bwiza bw’agakiza, kandi ko ubwiru bwahishuriwe Yohana ku kirwa cya Patimo bukwiriye kwitabwaho gake kuruta iyo nsanganyamatsiko y’agakiza. Ariko icyo sicyo Imana yageneye icyo gitabo…
“Igitabo cy’Ibyahishuwe cyereka ab’isi ibyabayeho, ibiriho, n’ibizabaho; nicyo gitabo kitwigisha ibizaheruka isi y’ahazaza. Kigomba kwiganwa ukwicisha bugufi twubashye….

“Umwami Yesu yahishuriye umugaragu We Yohana ubwiru bwo mu gitabo cy’Ibyahishuwe, kandi yari afite umugambi w’uko kigomba kubumburwa kikigwa n’abantu bose. Muri iki gitabo havugwamo ibyabaye mu gihe cyatambutse, ibiri kubaho ahatuzengurutse bifite inyungu z’iteka ryose; ubundi buhanuzi bugikubiyemo ntiburasohora mu buryo bwuzuye kugeza ku iherezo ry’ibihe, igihe hazabaho intambara ikomeye iheruka hagati y’abanyabutware b’umwijima n’Igikomangoma cy’ijuru.” – Ellen G. White, Ubusobanuro bwa Bibiliya bw’Abadiventisiti b’Umunsi wa Karindwi, vol 7, p.954.

q.text: b. Ni iki abizera bagomba gukora mu gihe biga Ibyanditswe Byera?

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni iyihe nyifato dukwiriye kugira yatubashisha gusobanukirwa ukuri?
2. Sobanura impamvu imigabane yose y’Ibyanditswe Byera idashobora gusobanuka mu buryo bwuzuye.
3. Ni ukubera iki abantu benshi badashaka kwakira ukuri kwa Bibiliya?
4. Mbese abantu baba bashaka gushidikanya, bahora bashingira ku ki?
5. Ni ukubera iki kugira ubushake bwo kumvira ari ngombwa kugirango dusobanukirwe ukuri?

lessons.title: Kwishimira mu Mwami
lessons.keyTextVerse: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Ahubwo munezezwe n’uko mufatanije imibabaro ya Kristo, kugira ngo muzanezerwe mwishima bihebuje, ubwo ubwiza bwe buzahishurwa.”

keyText.text: ISOMO RYO KUZIRIKANWA: “Ahubwo munezezwe n’uko mufatanije imibabaro ya Kristo, kugira ngo muzanezerwe mwishima bihebuje, ubwo ubwiza bwe buzahishurwa.”

keyNote.text: “Uwiteka yifuza ko abahungu n’abakobwa Be bose, banezerwa, bakaba amahoro, kandi bakumvira.” — Kugana Yesu, p.124.

q.text: a. Ni iyihe nshingano Yesu yavuze ko abigishwa Be bafite muri iyi si?

note.text: “Abakristo bashyiriweho kuba abatwaramucyo bamurikira inzira igana mu ijuru. Bakwiriye kumurikishiriza ab’isi umucyo Kristo yabaviriye. Imibereho yabo n’imico yabo ikwiriye kuba iyo gutuma abandi bamenya Kristo n’umurimo We.” – Kugana Yesu, p.115.

q.text: b. Ni iki abizera bagomba gukorera abantu bose?

note.text: “Umwana w’Imana wese Yesu yamugize urwandiko atuma ku b’isi. Niba uri umuyoboke wa Kristo, ubwo uri urwandiko atuma ku muryango wawe, mu mudugudu w’iwanyu, no ku musozi w’aho utuye. Yesu uri muri wowe, yifuza kuvugana n’imitima y’abatamuzi. Byashoboka ko batajya basoma Bibiliya, cyangwa ko batajya bumva ijwi rivuganira na bo mu mpapuro zayo, ntibabonera urukundo rw’Imana mu byo yaremye. Niba uhagarariye Yesu by’ukuri, ntibazabura gusobanukirwa n’ineza Ye binyuze muri wowe, kandi ibyo bizabarehereza ku kumukunda no kumukorera.” — Ibid., p.115.

q.text: c. Ni ubuhe buryo rukumbi byadushobokera gusohoza iyo nshingano?
a. Ni ikihe kintu gihanitse kigaragaza urukundo Imana ikunda abana Bayo?

note.text: “Iyo tubaye nk’abashidikanya urukundo rw’Imana kandi ntitwiringire amasezerano Yayo, tuba tuyisuzuguye kandi tubabaza Umwuka Wayo Wera. Mbese umubyeyi yakumva ameze ate aramutse abonye abana be bahora bamugaya, bakamwinuba nk’aho abifuriza nabi kandi ahora akora uko ashoboye kose ngo abagirira neza no kubaha ibibanezeza? Mbese bashidikanyije ko abakunda ntibyamumena umutima? Ese ubundi umubyeyi uwo ariwe wese wagirirwa atyo n’abana be yakumva ameze ate? None se Data wa twese wo mu ijuru we mugirango amera ate iyo dushidikanyije urukundo Rwe, kandi arirwo rwatumye atanga Umwana We w’ikinege kugirango tubone ubugingo? Intumwa Pawulo yaranditse ati: ‘Mbese ubwo itimanye Umwana wayo ikamutanga ku bwacu twese, izabura ite kumuduhana n’ibindi byose?’ Abaroma 8:32. Nyamara ni bangahe bagaragariza mu byo bakora ko batizera iryo sezerano? Bakibwira mu mitima yabo bati: ‘Ibyo Umwami ntabinyifuriza. Ahari akunda abandi, naho njyewe ntankunda.’ ” – Kugana Yesu, p.118,119.

q.text: b. Ni iki gihamya ko Imana ishaka guha abana Bayo ibintu byose?

note.text: “Wowe wiyumvamo ko udakwiriye hanyuma y’abandi, ntutinye kubwira Imana ikikubabaje. Igihe Imana yitangiraga muri Kristo kubera ibyaha by’abari mu isi, yitaye ku kibazo cya buri muntu wese. ‘Mbese ubwo itimanye Umwana wayo ikamutanga ku bwacu twese, izabura ite kumuduhana n’ibindi byose?’ Abaroma 8:32. Mbese ntizasohoza isezerano ry’ubuntu ridukomeza kandi rikatwongeramo imbaraga?
“Nta kindi kintu Kristo yifuza kirenze gucungura umurage We akawuvana mu butware bwa Satani.” – Imigani ya Kristo, p.174.

q.text: c. Ni gute uru rukundo rwagaragarira muri twe?

note.text: “Abakozi b’Abakristo bagera ku ntego yabo mu mihati bagira bagomba kumenya Kristo; kandi kugira ngo bamumenye, bagomba kumenya urukundo Rwe. Ukuba bakwiriye mu murimo wabo mu ijuru nk’abakozi, bipimirwa ku bushobozi bwabo bwo gukunda nk’uko Kristo yakundaga no gukora nk’uko yakoraga.

“Intumwa Yohana iravuga iti: “Twe gukundana urumamo mu magambo cyangwa ku rurimi, ahubwo dukundane mu byo dukora no mu by’ukuri.” (1Yohana 3:18). Ukuzura kw’imibereho ya Gikristo kugerwaho iyo imbaraga ihatira umuntu gufasha abandi no kubahesha umugisha ihora itemba imuturukamo. Umwuka urangwa n’uru rukundo rugose umutima w’umwizera ni wo utuma aba impumuro y’ubugingo izana ubugingo kandi ugatuma Imana ihira umurimo we.” – Ibyakozwe n’Intumwa, p.551.

q.text: a. Ni iki cyaranze imibereho ya Kristo mu murimo We wo guhesha agakiza abantu?

note.text: “Imibereho [ya Kristo] yarangwaga no kwitanga igihe cyose. Nta hantu ho kuba yari afite muri iyi si, keretse gusa igihe incuti ze zamugiriraga neza zikamucumbikira nk’umugenzi wihitira. Yaje kubaho imibereho y’umukene uri hanyuma y’abantu ku bwacu, yagendereraga kandi agakorera abakene n’imbabare. Yagendagendaga mu bantu yabakoreraga byinshi, ntibamumenye kandi ntibamwubahe.” – Ababwiriza b’Ubutumwa Bwiza, p.42,43.

“Nubwo [Umwana w’Imana] yari azi akaga kamutegereje ntabwo yiririraga ubwe. Imbere ye yahabonaga Getsemani, ahantu yari ategereje kubabarizwa bikomeye. Yarebaga kandi irembo ry’intama ryari rimaze imyaka myinshi rinyuzwamo ibitambo, kandi na We akaba ari ryo yari kuzanyuramo igihe yagombaga kumera “nk’umwana w’intama bajyana kubaga.” Yesaya 53:7. Hafi aho hari Karuvali, ahabambirwaga abantu. Inzira Kristo yari hafi kunyuramo yagombaga kubudikwaho n’umwijima uteye ubwoba mu gihe yari kwitangaho igitambo cy’icyaha. Nyamara ntabwo gutekereza kuri ibyo bintu ari cyo cyamuteye kwijima mu maso muri icyo gihe abandi bari bafite ibyishimo. Ntabwo gutinya umubabaro wendaga kumugeraho urenze uwo kamere ya muntu yakwihanganira ari byo byari bigose umutima We utikunda. Yarizwaga n’akaga kari gategereje abantu ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bari batuye i Yerusalemu. Akaga kari guterwa n’ubuhumyi no kutihana kw’abo yari yaje guhira no gucungura.” – Intambara Ikomeye, p.18.

q.text: b. Mu mibabaro Ye n’ibigeragezo Bye, ni iki cyatumye Yesu agira umwete wo gusohoza umurimo We?

note.text: “Ingaruka z’intambara Umukiza yarwanye n’imbaraga z’umwijima ni umunezero w’abazaba bacunguwe, bambaye ubwiza bw’Imana ibihe bidashira. Kandi ako niko gaciro k’umuntu Data wa twese azanyurwa nawe kubera igiciro cyatanzwe; na Kristo ubwe abonye imbuto zivuye mu gitambo Cye gihebuje, aranyurwa.” — Ibid., p.652.

“Bivugwa kenshi ko Kristo yariraga, ntagire ubwo amwenyura. Icyakora koko Umukiza wacu yabaye Umunyamibabaro wamenyereye intimba, abitewe n’uko yikoreye amakuba n’amahano yacu yose. Ariko nubwo yigomwaga atyo kandi agahorana umubabaro, umutima We ntiwigeze ushenguka. Ntiyahoraga akambije agahanga, ngo yirirwe aboroga, ahubwo yahoranaga umutuzo urangwamo amahoro. Umutima We wari isōko y’ubugingo; kandi aho yajyaga hose yagendanaga ituze n’amahoro, n’umunezero no kwishima.” – Kugana Yesu, p.120.

q.text: a. Igihe ibigeragezo byugarije umwizera, ni iki cyatanzwe cyamushoboza kunesha muri iyi ntambara y’iby’umwuka?

note.text: “Abantu bose bagira ibibagerageza, ibibahangayikisha, n’ibishuko bigoye gutsinda. Ariko rero aho kubiganyira bagenzi bawe bahwanyije nawe kugira intege nke, ubiture Imana mu isengesho. Ubigire ihame kutagira ubwo uvuga ijambo na rimwe ryo gushidikanya cyangwa gucogora. Hariho byinshi wabasha gukora byakomeza abandi no kubongerera imbaraga kubwo kuganira na bo amagambo y’ibyiringiro n’iremamutima.” – Kugana Yesu, p.119,120.

q.text: b. Ni ukubera iki benshi bahera mu rungabangabo ku byerekeye kwizera no gushidikanya igihe bageragejwe? Mbese ni iki bagomba gukora?

note.text: “Hariho abantu benshi bakirana n’ibibagerageza, hakaba ubwo benda kudohoka igihe barwanya inarijye n’imbaraga z’ikibi. Ntukagire ubwo uca intege umuntu umeze utyo mu rugamba rugoye aba ari kurwana. Ahubwo umukomereshe amagambo y’ubutwari n’ibyiringiro, kugirango amutere gukomeza urugendo. Ni muri ubwo buryo umucyo wa Kristo ushobora kumurika uguturutseho. ‘Nta muntu muri twe uriho ku bwe.’ Abaroma 14:7. Kubw’icyitegererezo tugira ku bandi, bashobora kongererwa umwete n’imbaraga, cyangwa bashobora gucibwa intege no gukurwa kuri Kristo no mu kuri.

“Hariho benshi bagira ibitekerezo bifutamye ku mibereho n’imico ya Kristo. Bibwira ko Yesu yanenaga abantu bamwe, ngo ntiyakundaga gufatanya n’abandi, ngo ntiyasekaga, bakavuga ko yari umunyamwaga, uhorana igitsure, utanezerwa. Inshuro nyinshi imibereho y’iyobokamana yahindanyijwe n’ibyo bitekerezo byijimye.” – Ibid., p.120.

q.text: c. Ni gute inzira y’umukiranutsi irabagiranira mu bigeragezo?

note.text: “Inzira ishobora kuba mbi kandi izamuka ku gacuri; hashobora kuba imikuku y’isuri iburyo n’ibumoso, dukwiriye kwihanganira imiruho mu rugendo rwacu; igihe turushye, igihe tunaniwe, dukwiriye kwihanganira umuruho; igihe ducogoye, turwane inkundura, igihe ducitse intege, dukwiriye gukomeza kugira ibyiringiro; ariko kuko Kristo ari umuyobozi wacu, amaherezo ntituzananirwa kugera ku cyambu twifuza kugeraho. Kristo ubwe yatubanjirije kugenda muri iyo nzira kandi yaringanije aho tuzanyura.
“Ku nzira izamuka ku gacuri ijya ku bugingo buhoraho hari amariba y’amasōko y’ibyishimo atuma abarushye bagarura ubuyanja.” — Ibitekerezo byo ku Musozi w’Umugisha, p.140.

q.text: a. Ni irihe sezerano rya Yesu ryakagombye kudutera umunezero no guhimbaza Data wa twese wo mu ijuru?

note.text: “Imana ntishaka ko abantu Bayo baheranwa n’amaganya. Nyamara Umwami wacu ntabwo adushuka. Ntabwo ashobora kutubwira ati: ‘Ntugire ubwoba, nta kaga kari mu nzira yawe.’ Azi ko hariho ibigeragezo n’amakuba, nicyo gituma abitubwira mu buryo bweruye. Ntabwo ahirimbanira gukura ubwoko Bwe mu isi y’icyaha n’umubi, ahubwo aberekeza mu buhungiro bwuje amahoro.” – Kugana Yesu, p.122,123.

q.text: b. Vuga andi masezerano y’agahebuzo y’amahoro n’umunezero Yesu yatanze.

note.text: “Nubwo tuzi ko tuzaterwa n’ibindi byago bishya mu ntambara igiye kuza, dukwiriye gusubiza amaso inyuma, tukareba ibyo mu gihe cyashize tukitega ibigiye kutubaho, maze tukavuga duti: ‘Uwiteka yaratuzahuye.’ ‘Kandi uko iminsi yawe ingana, niko intege zawe zizangana.’ 1Samweli 7:12; Gutegeka kwa Kabiri 33:25. Ntabwo tuzigera tugeragereshwa ibigeragezo biruta ibyo dushoboye. Nuko rero, nimutyo dukore umurimo aho tuwuboneye, twizeye yuko uko bizaba kose, tuzahabwa imbaraga ihagije yo gutsinda.

“Hanyuma amarembo yo mu ijuru niyugururirwa abana b’Imana, tuzumva umugisha uvuye mu kanwa k’Umwami w’ubwiza, ugwe mu matwi yacu umeze nk’indirimbo y’agahozo, igira iti: “Nimuze abo Data yahaye umugisha, muragwe ubwami bwabatunganirijwe uhereye ku kuremwa kw’isi.” Matayo 25:34….

“Kubw’umurage w’ubwiza buheranije umuntu abasha kubona, ‘ese yatanga iki gucungura ubugingo bwe?’ Matayo 16:26… Umuntu wacunguwe kandi akezwaho ibyaha, witangiye umurimo w’Imana akawukoresha imbaraga zibonejwe, afite agaciro karuta byose; kandi mu ijuru haba umunezero mwinshi imbere y’Imana n’abamarayika bera iyo umuntu umwe akijijwe, uwo munezero ukagaragazwa no kuririmba indirimbo zera zo kunesha.” — Ibid., p.125,126.

reviewQuestions: 1. Ni gute abantu bose, ndetse n’abatazi Bibiliya, bagerwaho n’ukuri?
2. Ni gute Uwiteka agaragariza abantu urukundo Rwe rutagira umupaka?
3. Ni iyihe sōko ya Yesu y’ubwishingizi igihe yasakiranaga n’imibabaro n’urupfu?
4. Ni irihe sezerano tugomba kwibuka igihe duhanganye n’ibigeragezo?
5. Ni iki umwizera agomba guhora azirikana mu mibereho ya buri munsi?
